title: Account Executive, DACH, Commercial (Existing Business)
description: <h1>Account Executive, DACH, Commercial (Existing Business)</h1> <h2><strong>About Stripe</strong></h2> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Commercial Grower team works with the most ambitious and fastest growing companies in the Commercial segment. Our Commercial segment includes businesses typically processing $20M–$50M in annual payment volume. Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and growth opportunities for these businesses. The Commercial Grower team supports our users to increase their domestic presence whilst expanding into new territories and unlocking new revenue streams. This is a role that can be based out of our Dublin or Berlin office or Germany remote. </p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will deepen and expand partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing companies in EMEA by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop territory and account plans for winning and expanding business with the Commercial segment.</li> <li>Own the renewal and retention strategy for your territory, proactively identifying and mitigating churn risk.</li> <li>Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well.</li> <li>Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses</li> <li>Orchestrate cross-functional teams including Solutions Architects, Customer Success, and Product Specialists to deliver technical value and drive activation</li> <li>Contribute to shaping our Commercial strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models.</li> <li>Develop strategies for growing wallet share, driving multi-product adoption, and defending/expanding existing revenue for your named account list.</li> <li>Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process</li> <li>Engage with internal Product and Engineering teams to help drive product and DACH market strategy.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are a top class salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal. You are naturally curious and analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Fluent in German</li> <li>7+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance</li> <li>Experience moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner, understanding strategies and applying value proposition</li> <li>Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment</li> <li>Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies</li> <li>Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements and cost models</li> <li>Superior verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Highly curious with a strong interest in technology </li> </ul> <h3>Preferred requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/Software company</li> <li>Experience in fintech/payments is a plus, but not prerequisite</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Design Manager (Mensch) New Business
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p>WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das bieten wir dir:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Work-Life-Balance</strong>: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.</li> <li><strong>Vacation mode on</strong>: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing first: </strong>Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.</li> <li><strong>Practice makes perfect</strong>: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job</strong>: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself</strong>: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das bewegst du:</strong></h2> <p>Als <strong>Senior Design Manager (Mensch)</strong> bist du Teil unseres 6-köpfigen Design-Teams innerhalb der WPP Media Growth-Unit. Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg*innen aus New Business, Marketing, Strategie und Responsible Media übersetzt du strategische Kernbotschaften in visuell bestechende Geschichten und trägst maßgeblich zu erfolgreichen Pitches sowie hochkarätigen Vorstandspräsentationen bei.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Pitch- & Vorstands-Design:</strong> Du entwickelst und gestaltest wirkungsstarke, erstklassige Präsentationen (Schwerpunkt PowerPoint) für nationale und internationale New-Business-Pitches sowie Entscheidungsvorlagen auf GF- und Vorstandsebene.</li> <li><strong>Motion & Video Content:</strong> Du konzipierst und produzierst bewegte Inhalte, Animationen und Video-Assets (z. B. Case-Videos oder dynamische Pitch-Intros) mithilfe von Adobe Premiere und After Effects.</li> <li><strong>KI-Integration & Innovation:</strong> Du nutzt moderne generative KI-Tools (z. B. für Bild-, Konzept- und Content-Erstellung) eigeninitiativ im Arbeitsalltag, um kreative Prozesse zu bereichern und Workflows zukunftssicher weiterzuentwickeln.</li> <li><strong>Brand- & Kampagnengestaltung:</strong> Du verantwortest die visuelle Umsetzung von Marketingmaterialien und Initiativen – von digitalen Kampagnen bis hin zu Assets für den Bereich Responsible Media.</li> <li><strong>Schnittstelle & Sparring:</strong> Innerhalb der Growth-Unit arbeitest du eng auf Augenhöhe mit den Fachbereichen (New Business, Strategie, Marketing) zusammen und berätst Stakeholder stilsicher von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Master-Folie.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das zeichnet dich aus:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Berufserfahrung:</strong> Du bringst mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung im Präsentations- und Kommunikationsdesign mit – idealerweise gesammelt im Agenturumfeld oder in einem dynamischen, pitch-getriebenen Setup.</li> <li><strong>PowerPoint-Exzellenz:</strong> PowerPoint ist dein kreatives Zuhause. Du beherrschst das Tool bis ins Detail und beweist, dass anspruchsvolles Design und PowerPoint Hand in Hand gehen.</li> <li><strong>Adobe Creative Suite:</strong> Du bist absolut versiert im Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud – insbesondere mit Photoshop, Illustrator und InDesign sowie Premiere und After Effects im Bewegtbildbereich.</li> <li><strong>KI-Affinität:</strong> Du brennst für neue Technologien, experimentierst aktiv mit aktuellen Generative-AI-Tools und verstehst es, diese produktiv und qualitätsbewusst in deine Designprozesse zu integrieren.</li> <li><strong>Fundierte Ausbildung:</strong> Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Design / Kommunikationsdesign oder eine vergleichbare qualifizierte Ausbildung (z. B. Mediengestaltung).</li> <li><strong>Kommunikations- & Sprachkompetenz:</strong> Du bewegst dich stilsicher und verhandlungssicher in deutscher sowie englischer Sprache (in Wort und Schrift).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Darüber hinaus bist du:</strong> <strong>#kreativ #lösungsorientiert #eigeninitiativ #stressresistent</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</strong></h2> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.<br> <br>WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen. #LI-Promoted (ID:13706)</p> <p>Bitte lies unsere <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">Datenschutzerklärung</a> für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz, um weitere Informationen darüber zu erhalten, wie wir die von dir bereitgestellten Daten verarbeiten. </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.</p> <p>We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.</p> <p>You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.</p> <p>We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.</p> <p>We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.</p> <p>We hope that's you.</p></div><p class="p1"><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p class="p2">We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will help our UK business understand performance, make better decisions and improve how quickly we learn. You'll work directly with leaders across Growth, Product, Operations and Finance, owning important commercial questions from problem framing through diagnosis, recommendation and measurement.</p> <p class="p3">This isn't primarily a reporting role. We want someone who notices when something changes, works out why, and helps the business act. You'll also turn recurring questions into reliable, reusable analytical capabilities, contributing to our move towards proactive monitoring, automated diagnosis and trusted self-service insights. You'll collaborate with analytics colleagues across Eucalyptus and Hims & Hers while remaining close to UK business priorities.</p> <p class="p3"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li class="p1"><strong>Diagnose performance. </strong>Investigate movements in acquisition, conversion, retention and revenue. Validate the signal, quantify the drivers, distinguish correlation from causation, and identify the controllable levers behind the change.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Drive decisions. </strong>Work backwards from commercial objectives, challenge assumptions and turn ambiguous questions into focused analysis. Recommend concrete actions, explain trade-offs and follow up to establish whether the decision worked.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Measure impact. </strong>Design and evaluate experiments, launches and operational changes. Use statistical reasoning, cohort analysis and appropriate causal methods to make credible claims, including when evidence is incomplete.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Build repeatable capabilities. </strong>Turn frequent investigations into trusted metrics, models, monitoring, diagnostic workflows and self-service tools. Help strengthen shared definitions and reusable approaches across markets rather than rebuilding the same analysis repeatedly.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Work AI-natively. </strong>Use AI to accelerate exploration, coding, validation and repetitive investigation, and help develop increasingly automated analytical workflows. Maintain ownership of assumptions, evidence and correctness: faster answers only matter when they can be trusted.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Ship and learn quickly. </strong>Deliver useful intermediate answers early, make uncertainty visible, seek stakeholder feedback and iterate. Balance speed with rigour rather than waiting for a polished, one-off analysis.</li> <li class="p2"><strong>Raise the analytical bar. </strong>Review work constructively, share methods openly, question weak conclusions and contribute to a team culture of curiosity, clarity and high standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <ul> <li class="p1"><strong>Strong foundations. </strong>Around 5+ years in analytics, ideally in a consumer, subscription, e-commerce or digital business. Advanced SQL and practical Python skills; comfortable with complex datasets, modelling and analytical validation.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Commercial and analytical judgment. </strong>You can structure messy problems, identify what matters to the business and separate meaningful drivers from noise. You know when further precision is worth the time.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Sound measurement. </strong>Experience with funnels, cohorts, experimentation and statistical inference. You understand the limits of observational data and communicate confidence and uncertainty accurately.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Ownership and influence. </strong>You independently lead important analyses, build productive relationships with senior stakeholders and communicate recommendations clearly, including when you need to challenge the prevailing view.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Systems mindset. </strong>You look for patterns in repeated requests and create durable solutions. Experience with semantic metrics, BI or data modelling is valuable; you do not need to be a platform engineer.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Curiosity about AI. </strong>You already use or actively explore AI-assisted workflows and can explain both where they create leverage and where human judgment and verification remain essential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What success looks like in your first six months</strong></p> <ul> <li>Become a trusted analytical partner to UK stakeholders and independently own material commercial questions</li> <li>Deliver evidence-backed diagnoses that lead to clear actions, with impact or follow-up measurement</li> <li>Improve the reliability or usability of a core UK metric, model or analytical workflow</li> <li>Replace at least one recurring manual investigation with a reusable, appropriately validated capability</li> <li>Demonstrate faster learning cycles through early delivery, iteration and thoughtful use of AI tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why join us?</strong><br><br>You'll work on consequential problems spanning patient journeys, growth, retention and healthcare operations, with the autonomy to influence decisions and the support of a global analytics organisation. We're actively evolving the craft of analytics: improving foundations, shortening the path from signal to action and building tools that let people answer better questions at scale. You'll help shape that evolution through practical work, not just presentations.<br><br>We welcome candidates from different backgrounds and can discuss reasonable adjustments during recruitment.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director of Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.</p> <p>We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.</p> <p>You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.</p> <p>We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.</p> <p>We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.</p> <p>We hope that's you.</p></div><h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Our largest and fastest-growing markets are staffed and operated from our London hub, and we need a technology leader to join our UK leadership team. This role will be based at our London HQ, following a 3-day hybrid schedule. You will bring together two engineering organisations into one unified team, lead engineering in London, and serve as the primary engineering partner for our UK commercial and product leaders. Reporting to the CTO, you will work closely with executives in London and have the autonomy to make the engineering calls for the UK business.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Unify two orgs into one.</strong> The team is 35 engineers across two engineering organisations. You will manage six to eight direct reports (engineering managers and staff engineers) and establish a unified standard for how both teams plan, build, ship, and hold each other accountable.</li> <li><strong>Drive platform consolidation.</strong> We run several platforms across our international markets today. You will help decide how they become one, and what we keep.</li> <li><strong>Run the London engineering site.</strong> Serve as the senior engineering voice in the building, including dotted-line support for US-focused teams based in London. That means setting the tone, facilitating local leadership forums, and making London a place where exceptional engineers join and stay.</li> <li><strong>Translate commercial outcomes.</strong> Partner directly with UK commercial, clinical, and product leaders as a true peer. You hold strong opinions and change them when someone makes a better case.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to Have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience in regulated sectors (such as healthtech, fintech or gaming), finding creative paths forward inside compliance constraints rather than being stopped by them.</li> <li>Experience navigating post-acquisition organisational integration and the messy alignment work that follows.</li> </ul> <h3>Why join Eucalyptus</h3> <ul> <li><strong>What's next</strong> - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer, launching into new conditions, demographics and geographies.</li> <li><strong>Build something world-changing</strong> - We're on the path to becoming the world's largest international digital healthcare company. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><em>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p> <p><em> </em></p> <p><strong>A propos de WPP Media :</strong></p> <p><strong><em>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. </em></strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie. <br>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing. <br>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Le contexte</strong> :</p> <p>Au sein de StudioM, l’agence de brand content de WPP Media, vous rejoindrez la Business Unit dédiée à une marque leader de la grande consommation (FMCG) et contribuerez à ses stratégies d’influence en France.</p> <p>Aux côtés de l’équipe Influence, en lien avec les équipes clients, média, créatives et les agences partenaires, vous participerez à des campagnes pour des marques iconiques, entre création de contenu, entertainment et pop culture : musique, gaming, sport, food ou lifestyle.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Contribuer aux stratégies d’influence :</strong> participer à la construction des recommandations stratégiques et créatives, proposer des idées d’activation et assurer une veille sur les tendances, la culture Gen Z, les usages des plateformes sociales, les créateurs émergents et les activations concurrentes.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Participer au casting des</strong><strong> créateurs de contenu :</strong> identifier des profils, de la nano-influence aux célébrités, et analyser leurs performances, leurs audiences, leur univers éditorial et leur affinité avec les marques.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Accompagner le suivi opérationnel des campagnes :</strong> participer à la rédaction des briefs, au suivi des agences partenaires, à la préparation des scripts et contenus soumis à validation, aux rétroplannings ainsi qu’au suivi budgétaire, administratif et contractuel.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Participer aux activations et aux productions de contenus :</strong> accompagner l’équipe lors des tournages, événements, expériences immersives et activations terrain avec les créateurs de contenu.</li> <li><strong>Contribuer à la mesure des performances et à l’innovation :</strong> suivre les KPI organiques et paid, notamment via CreatorIQ, participer aux bilans de campagne et aux pistes d’optimisation, et explorer l’apport des outils d’intelligence artificielle dans nos réflexions et méthodes de travail.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Formation Bac +4/+5 en communication, marketing ou publicité, à la recherche d’une alternance.</li> <li>Un vif intérêt pour l’influence, l’entertainment et la pop culture, et une bonne connaissance des créateurs de contenu et des plateformes sociales (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, Snapchat).</li> <li>Curiosité, créativité, réactivité, rigueur et sens de l’organisation pour suivre plusieurs sujets en parallèle.</li> <li>Aisance rédactionnelle et relationnelle, esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, bonne maîtrise de PowerPoint et d’Excel, et bon niveau d’anglais (B2 souhaité).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Un plus :</strong> la connaissance d’outils de marketing d’influence (comme CreatorIQ) et de social listening.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribuer à des campagnes d’influence d’envergure nationale pour des marques iconiques à dimension internationale.</li> <li>Évoluer au sein d’une Business Unit dédiée, dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire.</li> <li>Travailler aux côtés de créateurs de contenu, d’agences partenaires et d’experts média et créatifs.</li> <li>Acquérir une vision complète du marketing d’influence, de la stratégie à la mesure de la performance.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ce que nous offrons :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une <strong>expérience professionnelle unique</strong> au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.</li> <li>L'opportunité de travailler avec des <strong>clients de premier plan</strong> et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.</li> <li>Un <strong>accompagnement personnalisé</strong> pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas !</li> <li><strong>Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks</strong> ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.</li> <li>Un <strong>campus</strong> à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3 !</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Process de recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.</li> <li>Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste.</li> <li>Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.</li> </ul> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <p> </p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW22719

title: Senior Paid Marketing Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3> <p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p><span class="s1" style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands</span></span></p> <h3>About the role</h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Strategist to help us rethink how Typeform approaches paid acquisition.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll own and grow key channels including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads, while helping us test new opportunities across areas such as audio and CTV.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">This is a hands on role with real ownership. You’ll manage significant media budgets, build channel strategy, develop campaigns, work closely with our creative teams, and help us understand the true business impact of our investment through MMM, incrementality testing and other measurement approaches.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll join the Acquisition team within Marketing and partner closely with Creative, Product Marketing, Data, RevOps and Finance.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul data-spread="true"> <li>Own the strategy and day to day performance of key paid social and display channels, including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads.</li> <li>Build a multichannel strategy that helps Typeform reduce its reliance on paid search and find new sources of efficient growth.</li> <li>Manage six figure monthly media budgets, making decisions based on customer acquisition, revenue, CAC and LTV to CAC performance.</li> <li>Build, launch and optimise campaigns that drive Typeform signups and new paid customers.</li> <li>Turn creative ideas into campaigns by briefing and partnering closely with copywriters and designers.</li> <li>Run A/B tests across creative, copy, landing pages, placements, audiences and bidding strategies.</li> <li>Explore and test new channels such as audio and CTV.</li> <li>Own and develop our paid marketing measurement approach, including Marketing Mix Modelling, incrementality studies and alternative measurement frameworks.</li> <li>Design experiments that help us understand the incremental impact of our campaigns rather than relying solely on traditional attribution.</li> <li>Work closely with our Tracking and Data teams to strengthen our measurement capabilities as digital advertising continues to change.</li> <li>Share insights, results and recommendations across Marketing and the wider business.</li> <li>Contribute to Typeform’s broader full funnel acquisition strategy across demand creation and demand capture.</li> </ul> <h3>What we’re looking for</h3> <ul data-spread="true"> <li>Around six or more years of hands on and strategic experience in performance marketing and media buying.</li> <li>Strong experience managing paid social and video channels, ideally including TikTok, YouTube and Meta.</li> <li>Experience owning campaigns from initial idea and creative brief through implementation, optimisation and measurement.</li> <li>A track record of managing six figure budgets and delivering efficient performance.</li> <li>Experience working with MMM, incrementality testing or other measurement methods beyond traditional attribution.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and confidence working with campaign performance, conversion funnels, CAC and LTV.</li> <li>A strong understanding of digital measurement, from tagging and attribution through to incrementality.</li> <li>Experience developing creative and UGC assets for paid social channels.</li> <li>The ability to balance creative thinking with strong commercial judgement.</li> <li>Curiosity and a willingness to figure things out. When you do not know the answer, you know how to find it, whether that means speaking to the right person, digging into documentation or using AI tools.</li> <li>Confidence working across teams and influencing partners in Creative, Product Marketing, Data and Finance.</li> <li>Comfort operating with uncertainty. You are happy testing ideas, learning from the results and changing direction when the data tells you to.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul data-spread="true"> <li>Experience working in SaaS or B2B lead generation.</li> <li>Experience across sales technology or marketing technology.</li> <li>Experience managing external agencies or digital production partners.</li> <li>Experience with ad servers and campaign trafficking.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We <strong>move as one team</strong>, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters <strong>strong bonds</strong> grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We <strong>champion our diverse customer base</strong> by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we<strong> hold high expectations </strong>for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.</p> <p>We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale. Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation. You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. The <strong>Director, Alliances EMEA (GSI)</strong> will work closely with Onapsis field sales teams, regional leadership, and partner practice leads to align partner-led activities to the company’s strategic goals.</p> <h3><strong>What you will be doing, your legacy: </strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead and coordinate all commercial, executive, and business development aspects of Onapsis’ strategic GSI alliance partners across EMEA (Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, CAPGemini, IBM), facilitating joint planning and aligning resources internally and externally.</li> <li>Build a portfolio of joint solution offerings and repeatable use cases with GSI partners, embedding Onapsis into partner-led SAP digital transformation practices (S/4HANA migrations, RISE with SAP) and driving GTM execution.</li> <li>Drive and manage partner-sourced and partner-influenced co-sell pipelines with GSI partners and Onapsis field sales teams, tracked and managed through Salesforce CRM.</li> <li>Enable partner-led implementation and managed services delivery models (MSSP / QuickStart packages), maximizing GSI service revenue opportunities around Onapsis platform deployments.</li> <li>Coordinate and execute joint marketing initiatives, executive roundtables, and ABM campaigns with GSI partner marketing teams across target EMEA regions.</li> <li>Contract negotiations</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Required Skills and Experience:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>7+ years of experience in enterprise software sales, business development, or alliance management </strong>at a cybersecurity or enterprise software company, with at least <strong>5+ years directly managing GSIs </strong>(Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, CAPGemini, IBM) across EMEA.</li> <li>Deep existing network and executive relationships within the cybersecurity and SAP practices of major GSIs across key EMEA markets (UK&I, DACH, France, Nordics).</li> <li>Proven track record of building joint GTM playbooks and driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline in co-sell models.</li> <li>Expertise and acumen in forging initiatives, go-to-market and pipeline development plans with business partners.</li> <li>Experience in selling in an overlay role in conjunction with field sales teams</li> <li>Familiarity with the SAP ecosystem (S/4HANA migrations, RISE with SAP, SAP BTP) and partner-led services delivery frameworks.</li> <li>Past relationships with top national and regional VARs</li> <li>Demonstrated success in exceeding revenue targets with partners</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills (both verbal and written). Able to position technical solutions as business value to ‘owners’ of Security Services offering portfolio in partner organizations.</li> <li>Experience with Solution Selling/Consultative Selling methodologies.</li> <li>Delivery of comprehensive business plans with a multi-year outlook.</li> <li>Strong analytical competencies and ability to communicate and present at an executive level.</li> <li>Self-disciplined team player that can work in a fast-paced dynamic start-up environment remotely.</li> <li>B.S. or equivalent experience. Masters or MBA a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location: Remote in Germany. </strong></p> <h3><strong>What We Offer:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation & Perks: An attractive salary package and extensive lifestyle benefits, including JobRad, Focus Fridays, and more.</li> <li>Ultimate Flexibility & Balance: 30 days of paid vacation, flexible working hours, and the ability to work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.</li> <li>Family-First Support: Dedicated backing for parents, including subsidized childcare (up to primary school age) and 5 fully paid sick days per child.</li> <li>Continuous Growth & Development: A tailored onboarding experience with a dedicated buddy program, alongside comprehensive professional training and English language courses. </li> <li>Empowering Culture: High autonomy and creative freedom within a solution-oriented environment, featuring flat hierarchies, respectful communication, and an innovative workplace.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Onapsis:</strong></h3> <p>Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, UK)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><div class="posting-editor"> <div class="postings-description preview"> <p class="section page-centered" style="text-align: left;"><em>This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK, Spain or Ireland.</em></p> <div class="section-wrapper"> <h2>The Opportunity</h2> <h3>About our platform</h3> <p>Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.</p> <p>The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.</p> <h3>About the Infrastructure group</h3> <p>We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.</p> <p>You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.</p> <p>We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.</p> <h3>How we work</h3> <p>Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.</p> <p>Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.</p> <h2>What You'll Be Doing</h2> <ul> <li>Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.</li> <li>Own your squad's roadmap and quarterly objectives: help decide what the squad works on, what it defers, and why, across a broad remit where demand always exceeds capacity.</li> <li>Take platform changes from design to fleet-wide adoption: staged rollouts, migration paths, and clear communication, so changes land well for the teams who depend on them.</li> <li>Partner with the other Infrastructure squads on work that spans them, and with the teams across Foundations and the rest of Engineering whose work depends on yours.</li> <li>Help shape how the group works as a whole, including planning, on-call, and the ownership model between squads.</li> <li>Own the squad's intake. Requests, reviews, and support from application teams arrive continuously; keep them triaged and visible so that planned work still moves.</li> <li>Keep on-call healthy: ensure a sustainable load and support incident response.</li> <li>Work across team boundaries, contributing beyond your squad's scope where Foundations needs it.</li> </ul> <p>We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.</p> <p>We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always paired with strong code review and quality standards.</p> <h2>What Makes You a Great Fit</h2> <ul> <li>Experience managing engineers, ideally a team that builds and operates production CSP infrastructure, security, networking and/or storage</li> <li>Hands-on depth in at least one area of platform engineering, such as cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes, infrastructure security and access, or observability. You can challenge a design in your area on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.</li> <li>Fluency with infrastructure as code and with running Kubernetes in production.</li> <li>A track record of landing internal engineering/developer platform changes at scale. You've driven a migration or a rollout across many teams or many clusters, and you know what makes one stall.</li> <li>The ability to explain platform engineering to very different audiences (platform engineers, application teams, product management and business leadership) and to make the case for what the squad should and shouldn't take on.</li> <li>Be comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment, using clear, written communication to build trust and psychological safety.</li> <li>You're a motivated self-starter with a strong bias toward action and ownership, able to navigate ambiguity in a complex problem space.</li> <li>Comfort with AI-assisted tooling. We embrace AI and agentic development, so we expect you to be curious and comfortable using AI-powered tools, and ideally to have practical experience folding them into a team's workflow.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points For</h2> <ul> <li>Experience across more than one of the group's areas: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure security, and observability</li> <li>Hands-on depth in cloud infrastructure security: cloud IAM, Kubernetes security, secrets, and workload identity on at least one major cloud provider. You can challenge a threat model or an access design on its merits, and the engineers on your team will expect you to.</li> <li>Building self-service infrastructure for application teams</li> <li>Running observability for a production platform at scale</li> <li>Operating across more than one of GCP, AWS, and Azure</li> <li>You've worked in or on open source, or other community-based projects. At Grafana Labs, "OSS is in our DNA"</li> </ul> <p>In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is £<span data-sheets-root="1">107,077 - £128,493</span><span data-sheets-root="1">.</span> Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-Remote</span></span></p> </div> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. title: Lead Instructor, EMEA
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. About TRM TRM Labs is on a mission to build a safer world by fighting crime and protecting the people who investigate it. We started as a blockchain intelligence company, helping law enforcement, government agencies, financial institutions, and businesses detect, investigate, and disrupt crypto-enabled crime. Today our platform reaches well beyond the blockchain: we fuse on-chain data with cyber and open-source intelligence (OSINT) so investigators can move from a single crypto address to the full story behind a criminal network. Our blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms turn fragmented signals into fast, defensible investigative leads for the teams protecting public safety and national security every day. TRM Academy delivers training and certification for the global community of investigators, analysts, and compliance professionals who detect and prevent fraud and financial crime involving cryptocurrencies. Learners get live and virtual courses, practical exercises, and a community of the world's experts in blockchain, crypto compliance, and financial crime investigations. About the Role As the Lead Instructor, EMEA , you will own the design and delivery of TRM Academy training across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, with blockchain intelligence and crypto investigations at the core of what you teach. You will turn complex on-chain concepts into practical, mission-ready skills for law enforcement, national security, and government audiences, and you will be equally comfortable teaching crypto businesses, exchanges, and financial institutions. Cyber and OSINT tradecraft is the complement: you will show investigators how to pair it with on-chain tracing to build a complete case. EMEA is a region where we win by showing up. You will deliver in person, in the room, with customers across the UK, DACH, the Nordics and Baltics, France, and beyond, and you will work closely with our regional sales, value engineering, and customer success teams so that training drives adoption and opens the next conversation. You will join a Training Team of master instructors who can command a room, build engaging content, and speak to every level of expertise. We know how our products are used in the real world and help our customers become humble masters too. This is also a build role. EMEA training is a growing opportunity, and you will help shape how it is scoped, packaged, and delivered as the region scales. Please note: this role requires travel of 50-75%, primarily across EMEA. The Impact You'll Have Here Program manage and deliver live, in-person, and virtual blockchain intelligence training to law enforcement, national security, and government learners across EMEA. Teach crypto fundamentals through advanced investigations on TRM's blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms, helping investigators trace funds and build complete, defensible cases. Develop and maintain curriculum, labs, and practical exercises that stay current with the crypto threat landscape, including fraud, scams, ransomware, hacks and exploits, terrorism finance, sanctions evasion, and money laundering typologies. Adapt content for regional legal frameworks, case types, and audience maturity, from first-time crypto investigators to experienced national security analysts. Pair on-chain tracing with cyber and OSINT techniques in courses and case walkthroughs, so learners can pivot from off-chain signals to blockchain activity. Partner with sales, value engineering, and customer success to scope training engagements, support onboarding and enablement, and turn training into adoption and expansion. Build relationships with law enforcement and industry partners across the region to grow the TRM Academy cadre and learner community. Develop train-the-trainer materials and instructor guides so the Academy can scale in EMEA and coach other instructors as the team grows. What We're Looking For 3-5+ years of experience instructing courses, leading trainings, or delivering technical instruction. Blockchain, cryptocurrency, or digital assets subject matter expertise (core requirement), ideally from hands-on on-chain investigations or crypto-enabled crime casework. Law enforcement or government experience, or a proven track record training these audiences. Police and financial crime investigators are especially welcome. Eligibility to obtain a government security clearance in the UK or another EMEA country. Fluent English, written and spoken. Experience building coursework, curriculum, labs, and appropriate testing. Comfortable training private-sector audiences, such as crypto businesses/VASPs, exchanges, and financial institutions. Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to command the room. Willingness and ability to travel 50-75% across EMEA. AI fluency (part of our performance review process and of the interview process). Nice to Have Professional fluency in German (strongly preferred, given the size of our DACH opportunity). Fluency in French , or in a Nordic, Baltic, or Eastern European language. An existing national security clearance. Experience in or alongside a national security, intelligence, or financial intelligence unit. Working knowledge of cyber investigations , OSINT , and/or cyber threat intelligence (CTI) tradecraft. Relevant certifications (for example GIAC credentials such as GCTI or GOSI, or similar cyber and OSINT credentials). A Nordic, Baltic, or Eastern European background in crypto, particularly with national security experience. A Note on AI Fluency TRM is an AI-native company. We expect our instructors to already be using AI tools in their day-to-day work to accelerate research, author and refine training content, and speed up investigative and analytical workflows. AI fluency is not awareness or interest; it is production usage. It is evaluated in our interview process and is part of our performance review process. Why This Role Matters Investigators and analysts across Europe are facing crypto-enabled crime at growing scale, from fraud and ransomware to sanctions evasion and terrorism finance. By teaching them to trace funds on TRM's platforms and combine that with cyber and OSINT tradecraft, you directly increase how quickly and confidently they can detect, investigate, and disrupt the threats that put people at risk. Every cohort you train turns abstract concepts into concrete skills they can apply to active cases that week, and you will help define how TRM Academy shows up across EMEA. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly Operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. title: Senior Platform Engineer, Replicate
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | London, UK (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <h3 data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">Role Summary</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="1">Replicate is now part of Cloudflare, and we are bringing its AI inference platform onto Cloudflare's global network and Workers AI. We are looking for an engineer who thrives in complex production environments, brings pragmatic architectural judgment, and elevates the engineering bar through strong code, thoughtful design reviews, and technical mentorship.</p> <h3 data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Role Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong data-path-to-node="3,0,0" Architect and execute the technical migration of Replicate models and live inference traffic to Workers AI, building translation layers, dual-routing/shadowing pipelines, API compatibility adapters, and graceful fallback mechanisms with zero customer disruption.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="3,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Optimize Performance, Scale, and Cost:</strong> Profile and improve system throughput, cold-start latency, and GPU utilization across multi-cloud Kubernetes clusters and Cloudflare's edge infrastructure.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="3,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Ensure Production Reliability:</strong> Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, lead triage and mitigation during live production incidents, author thorough post-incident reviews, and build automated remediation and observability tooling.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="3,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Raise the Technical Bar:</strong> Author clear technical design documents (RFCs), conduct thorough code and architecture reviews, and mentor fellow engineers on distributed systems best practices and operational excellence.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="3,5,0" data-index-in-node="0">Cross-Team Technical Collaboration:</strong> Partner directly with Workers AI, networking, storage, and security engineering teams across Cloudflare to integrate Replicate’s platform primitives into Cloudflare’s broader AI stack.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="4"><strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="0">Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="5,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="5,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Distributed Systems Experience:</strong> 5+ years of software engineering experience data-path-to-node="5,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Strong Programming Proficiency:</strong> Deep hands-on proficiency in Go, Python, or TypeScript, with experience writing clean, concurrent, maintainable, and well-tested backend services.</li> <li data-path-to-node="5,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="5,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Cloud & Container Orchestration:</strong> Extensive production experience with Kubernetes (custom controllers/operators, scheduling, networking, CNI/CSI) and multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or bare-metal environments).</li> <li data-path-to-node="5,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="5,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Migration & Zero-Downtime Delivery:</strong> Proven track record of re-architecting live systems, executing large-scale data or traffic migrations, and maintaining strict API backwards compatibility under load.</li> <li data-path-to-node="5,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="5,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Operational Excellence:</strong> Hands-on experience operating tier-1 production services, including observability (metrics, distributed tracing, structured logging), capacity planning, staged rollouts, and incident response.</li> <li data-path-to-node="5,5,0"><strong data-path-to-node="5,5,0" data-index-in-node="0">Clear Technical Communication:</strong> Ability to write fast cold starts.</li> <li data-path-to-node="8,1,0">Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Workers AI, or edge/serverless compute platforms.</li> <li data-path-to-node="8,2,0">Familiarity with high-performance networking, load balancing, and multi-region traffic routing.</li> <li data-path-to-node="8,3,0">Experience working on developer-facing APIs, usage-based billing/metering pipelines, or multi-tenant sandboxing and workload isolation.</li> </ul> <h3><br><br></h3><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript / Node.js)
description: Hi, we are Storyteq! Storyteq helps marketing and creative teams in top brands scale their creative production and gain control over their marketing campaigns. Through our platform, our clients streamline campaign workflows, automate their creative production through templates and AI, and activate engaging campaigns that go to market faster. We believe creativity takes time, but creative production shouldn’t. Since 2016 our mission has been to revolutionize the way creative assets are created and used. Magic happens when we let technology empower creativity. Our endless curiosity and relentless commitment to our customers lies at the heart of our problem-solving approach. This shared mission is woven into our values: we dream big, think differently, and are stronger together. About the job: About the job You will be part of the Templating domain, where we enable global enterprises to scale up their content creation efficiently. Content comes in from sources like Photoshop, Figma and After Effects, or is designed in our AI-enabled, web-based editor, and then taken to the next level. You will work directly with other developers, designers, quality engineers, DevOps engineers and product owners to deliver the best platform for our users. This is a full stack role with TypeScript and Node.js at its core. Most of your time goes into backend services, APIs and data models, and you are just as comfortable picking up a Vue.js frontend task when the feature needs it. You don’t hand work over a wall between backend and frontend: you take a feature from the data model to the screen. AI is part of how we build and part of what we build. You use AI coding assistants and agents in your daily work, and you help shape how AI-powered capabilities reach our product. We want people who embrace it, measure what it gives us, and stay in charge of the quality of what ships. Key responsibilities Build and ship robust backend services and frontends with real product impact Ensure systems are scalable, performant and easy to maintain Model business domains into clean, performant data structures Collaborate across teams to integrate services and deliver end-to-end value Coach and mentor other engineers on best practices to help them grow Collaborate with other engineers and lead technical delivery on initiatives within a domain or project Lead by example in engineering excellence, pragmatism and shared ownership Requirements What we’re looking for Must have: 5+ years of hands-on, production experience delivering full-stack products with TypeScript and JavaScript, with Node.js as your main backend A positive attitude to AI, backed by experience: you already use AI tools and agents in your daily work, and you want to push the team further with them. Core: Hands-on experience with Vue.js (or another modern frontend framework), and no fear of working in the frontend Solid experience designing and integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs Proficiency in data modeling and working with SQL and NoSQL databases Comfortable working in monorepo environments and modular architectures Familiar with testing practices, performance tuning and scalable design principles Confident in making architectural decisions and communicating trade-offs Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English You are proactive, result-driven, and excited to work in a fast-growing tech scale-up What makes you senior for this role: You own outcomes, not just tasks, and see work through from problem to production.
