title: Engineering Manager
description: <p>We’re on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.</p> <p>With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we’re Europe’s largest student rental platform. You’ll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.</p> <p>As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.</p> <p>We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.</p> <p><strong>Our Tech Stack</strong></p> <p>At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your role</strong></p> <p>In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery</strong>: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. </li> <li><strong>Direction</strong>: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.</li> <li><strong>Talent</strong>: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.</li> <li><strong>Culture</strong>: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.</li> <li><strong>Craft</strong>: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.</li> <li><strong>AI-first engineering</strong>: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team’s standards high while the way of working changes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.</li> <li>Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.</li> <li>Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.</li> <li>Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.</li> <li>Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!</li> <li>Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).</li> <li>Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!</li> <li>1,000 EUR personal development budget.</li> <li>Complete coverage for commuting.</li> <li>Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.</li> <li>Gym membership discount with Wellhub.</li> <li>Dutch/English classes budget.</li> <li>Variable pension scheme.</li> <li>Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).</li> <li>Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. </li> <li>Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Embedded Android Engineer- Hardware
description: <h2><strong>Team description</strong></h2> <p>SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Support system bring-up for the new Android embedded platform, from bootloader through to kernel and framework</li> <li>Integrate and maintain kernel modules and drivers, including power management and connectivity components</li> <li>Contribute to build system integration across the platform</li> <li>Debug hardware and software issues at the protocol level and help resolve critical issues found during testing</li> <li>Carry out testing and validation to confirm the platform is stable and secure before release</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You'll be great for this role if…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting</li> <li>Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services</li> <li>Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO</li> <li>Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage</li> <li>Comfort working with Qualcomm Snapdragon or MediaTek platforms, and expert-level C programming for embedded Linux environments</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why you should join SumUp</strong></h2> <p>🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels.</p> <p>In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live.</p> <p>Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashOS. You will own the systems, numbers and operating rhythm that turn a multi-product strategy into predictable revenue, across all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo markets in EMEA.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2> <p>As the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations for DashOS EMEA, you will partner directly with DashOS commercial leadership to co-own the go-to-market plan and run the operating cadence for the sales and account management teams selling DashOS. This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder: you will set up the tracking and planning foundations, then use them to make the sales organisation measurably better.</p> <p><strong>Day-to-day in this role you'll:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the revenue tracking infrastructure:</strong> own our CRM setup and the data flows into our BI stack, so pipeline, activities and revenue for every DashOS product live in one place</li> <li><strong>Run the commercial operating cadence,</strong> including pipeline tracking, pacing and weekly forecasting with sales and account managers, and own the DashOS commercial narrative to EMEA leadership</li> <li><strong>Own sales planning across markets:</strong> set targets and quotas through bottom-up and top-down allocation, and design books of business, territories and coverage models that match our growth goals</li> <li><strong>Turn sales performance data into action</strong> by building dashboards that act as the single source of truth for account-level performance and risk, and surfacing insights that managers and sellers can act on</li> <li><strong>Design and roll out incentive systems,</strong> including MBOs, SPIFFs and variable compensation, together with Finance, so sales and account managers own DashOS revenue alongside marketplace revenue</li> <li><strong>Make DashOS part of the core commercial motion,</strong> so it shows up in every account manager's book of business, account plans and business reviews rather than running on the side</li> <li><strong>Automate and scale with AI,</strong> removing manual work for sellers and managers (e.g. pre-populated account plans, automated pipeline views) so teams spend their time with merchants</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Significant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations or a similar commercial role,</strong> ideally in a fast-growing tech company. A management consulting background is a plus.</li> <li><strong>A track record in sales planning:</strong> quota and target setting, territory and book-of-business design, and forecasting cadences for a multi-market sales organisation.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on with data and systems.</strong> You are comfortable with SQL and BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) and have worked deeply in a CRM such as Salesforce. You build things yourself rather than only writing specs.</li> <li><strong>Experience designing incentive models,</strong> variable pay structures, SPIFFs and performance tracking across commercial teams.</li> <li><strong>A builder and generalist</strong> who is comfortable with ambiguity, can take a broad mandate and turn it into concrete outputs, and doesn't need a fully built stack to deliver.</li> <li><strong>A clear communicator and trusted partner to senior leaders,</strong> able to translate data into a commercial narrative and build alignment across Sales, Finance and Product.</li> <li><strong>Strong understanding of distinct sales motions,</strong> including Enterprise Sales, SMB Sales and Account Management. Experience with multi-product or platform sales is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Bonus:</strong> experience using AI and automation to scale commercial operations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why join us</strong></h2> <p>You will do work that matters and help build one of DoorDash's next big bets. Working here, you can expect to:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Make a visible impact every day,</strong> directly improving how merchants run and grow their business.</li> <li><strong>Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment,</strong> with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.</li> <li><strong>Build a career, not just a role,</strong> as DashOS grows across EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Deliver together</strong> in an inclusive, diverse and values-driven culture, with big hearts and small egos.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Next steps</strong></h2> <p>If you are excited about building a new business from an early stage and taking real ownership, click below to apply, add your CV and get the conversation going! title: Product Analytics Team Lead
description: HEY THERE You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half. Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else. You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for. Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide! This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK. YOUR MISSION Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll: Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions YOUR PROFILE You'll feel at home here if: You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it Bonus points for: Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play) A strong statistics background Dagster or Airflow for scheduling Data catalogues like DataHub OUR CORE TECH STACK Here's what we run in production: Warehouse: Snowflake Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster Experimentation: GrowthBook Self-service analytics: Omni ML workflows: Prefect GenAI: Claude If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back. WHY US? An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back! A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. READY TO JOIN US? Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us: Your CV in English Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio) Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Team Atlas
description: About the Role Banks and fintechs use Taktile to automate critical decisions, like credit and risk, in real time. We're building the infrastructure that makes financial institutions truly AI-native, and the backend is where the hard problems live. We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banking and insurance, and we're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join Team Atlas : a small, high-ownership team focused on the data infrastructure powering our feature computation platform. You'll own critical systems end-to-end, and your decisions will shape the product. What You'll Do Build and operate backend services in Python on AWS — Lambda functions, DynamoDB, Aurora, and event-driven pipelines that handle real production traffic. You'll leverage agentic AI tools as part of your daily workflow. Tackle hard backend problems — latency, reliability, and scale are everyday concerns. Own your systems end-to-end: from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and incident response. Make key architectural decisions — you'll have real authority over how things are built, not just what gets built. Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, mentoring, and improving our development tooling and processes. Work directly with Product and Design to shape what we build next. Requirements At least 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading complex projects in a senior capacity (2+ years). Deep expertise building backend systems on cloud platforms, we use AWS. Strong system design skills — you're comfortable making architectural trade-offs and defending them. Depth in at least one of these areas: data pipelines and storage, event-driven architectures, caching and performance, or serverless systems. You don't need all of them. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders on a shared vision. The ability to work in a hybrid model from our Berlin HQ, the London office, or the Iasi hub. Please note that relocation assistance is not provided for this role. Ideal, But Not Required Python, FastAPI, Apache Iceberg, AWS Athena, AWS Glue, or Apache Spark Streaming / real-time data pipelines (Kinesis) Multi-level caching strategies (Redis, DynamoDB, in-memory) Serverless at scale (Lambda, SAM, CloudFormation) Our Offer Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here. Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo. Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe. Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package. Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes. Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up. Our Stance We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply. We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears. About Us Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. title: Lead Business Development Representative (m/f/d)
description: YOUR JOB Ready to lead from the front and still get your hands dirty? We are looking for ambitious BDR Leader who has mastered outbound and now wants to build, coach and carry a BDR team - while still owning a personal number. Start-up mode: you write the playbook, not just follow it. In this role, you will build and lead our BDR Team qualified pipeline for our Upper Mid-Market segment through targeted outbound, account-based prospecting, multi-touch sequencing, and close collaboration with Marketing and Account Executives. This is a true player-coach role: roughly half your time goes into your own outreach, the other half into making the team around you better: hiring, onboarding, call coaching, 1:1s and setting the standards. No layers, no lengthy approval loops - you test fast, share what works and own the team's results, from activity to pipeline. As the team grows, so does your scope: this role is the springboard into a full BDR leadership position. WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Lead, coach and motivate a team of BDRs (stand-ups, call reviews, 1:1s) and lead by example by creating qualified pipeline yourself for our Upper Mid-Market segment through structured outbound prospecting, cold calling, email, LinkedIn, social selling and other creative engagement tactics. Execute marketing-owned outbound and ABM motions, including targeted account research, multi-touch sequencing and personalised outreach. Use tools such as Gong Engage, Salesforce and other sales technologies to manage sequences, track activity, improve messaging and prioritise the right accounts. Research target accounts, understand buying signals and create relevant first conversations with senior stakeholders. Qualify opportunities based on fit, urgency, business need and buying potential, then work closely with Account Executives to ensure a high-quality handover. Own and evolve the BDR playbook: test new messaging, account angles and prospecting approaches where you see opportunity. Set and track team KPIs, keep CRM data clean and use insights to steer prioritisation and individual performance. Help hire and onboard new BDRs, and collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations and Enablement to improve outbound strategy, messaging, conversion and feedback loops. WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN The proper tools and capacities to build up and lead an ambitious, international team with diverse skill sets Enjoy the freedom and trust to bring in and execute your ideas with a quick pace, autonomy, and the ability to make impactful decisions. Gain strategic insights into management topics with the opportunity to actively contribute, working closely alongside leadership and executive peers. Rapid development opportunities, attractive performance bonuses, and the opportunity to strengthen your leadership skills and business expertise Step into a stable, forward-looking role within a dynamic scale-up poised to shape the fast-growing Security & Compliance industry THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD 2+ years’ experience as a BDR/SDR, ideally in B2B SaaS, with a consistent track record of hitting or beating quota. Outbound fundamentals you could teach in your sleep, including cold calling, email sequencing, account research, objection handling and qualification. Confidence engaging with decision-makers and creating meaningful first conversations. Strong written and verbal communication skills in German and English. A builder mindset: you create structure where there is none and balance your own pipeline with the team's priorities. Lead-by-example energy: resilience, accountability and a strong drive to hit ambitious team targets. Comfort using sales tools, CRM systems and modern outbound technologies to improve productivity and quality. Interest in Security, Compliance, SaaS and AI-enabled sales approaches. First experience coaching, onboarding or mentoring peers – and the ambition to grow into people leadership. LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS: No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you! #LI-DNI Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Applied AI Engineer (all genders)
description: Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock. As Applied AI Engineer (all genders), you work like a forward deployed engineer, embedded with our internal teams. AI is reshaping how we work: you find where it has the highest impact, decide what is worth building, and then build it. You work closely with team leads across departments and within our Data & AI team. The role combines discovery and hands-on engineering: you split your time between working with teams and building the solutions yourself. User pain points are often vague at first, and priorities change as we learn which use cases hold up. Once a solution works, you hand it over and move on to the next problem. Pure coding, pure advisory work or polishing a single system for months are not part of the job. If turning unclear problems into working AI solutions is your thing, you’ll feel at home here. As we are looking for a hands-on engineer, a coding interview is an integral part of our interview process. What to expect Discovery: Shadow processes and interview the people doing the work. Quantify and validate where time and quality are lost. Prioritization: Prioritize use cases across departments by impact, not by what is easiest or needs the most advanced tooling, and say no to the ones that don’t hold up. Make or buy: Test existing tools and new AI providers against our use cases before building. Build and ship: Build the solution yourself: LLM based systems, traditional ML, rule based automation, or a combination, depending on the problem. Ship a first usable version within weeks, integrated into the tools people already use, and iterate based on feedback. Measure success: Define success upfront: business outcome, adoption and metrics that measure output quality. Own the outcome: Own each solution until it has a clear outcome: handed over to our Platform team or the domain team, or shut down. Platform: Build on our AI & Data platform and feed back what it needs next. Inspire us by Background: 3-5 years in software engineering, data science or ML engineering, including at least 1 year shipping LLM based products. Scale-up experience and close work with business teams such as operations or sales are a plus. Discovery experience: You have found and scoped problems yourself, working directly with users, and turned them into a quantified case for or against solving them. Technical skills: Good Python skills and a solid understanding of core GenAI concepts and building blocks, including RAG, tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, and evaluation (Evals). Experience with traditional machine learning techniques (e.g., XGBoost) and SQL is a plus. End-to-end delivery: You have taken at least one AI project from an unclear business problem to production, implemented it end to end and can show how you measured its output quality. Analytical thinking & communication: You bring structure to ambiguous problems and explain technical trade-offs to non technical teams. You defend your decisions on which use cases to pursue and work as an equal with stakeholders. Mindset: Proactive and comfortable driving topics in unclear situations. You don’t wait for requirements, you find the problem worth solving. Language skills: Fluent English (C1); German is a plus. What we offer Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday) Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move Measurable goals: Our agile methods allow you to directly measure your impact on our product and company success Team Culture & Networking: Real connections – also beyond the day-to-day. Celebrate successes with us at legendary team events and OKR parties Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance Health & Balance: Stay in balance with EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club – access 1,000+ gyms and wellness spots across Germany Top Equipment & Ergonomics: Mac or Windows, in the office or remote – we make sure you’re set up for efficiency and comfort Dress Code? Your Code: What you do matters more than what you wear – dress in whatever makes you feel your best Innovation through diversity Regardless of your background, origin, gender identity, or individual circumstances, it's your personality that interests us. That's why we're committed to building a culture of collaboration and respect, where every team member has a voice, can grow, and feels valued with us. Still here? Then we might be the perfect match! It’s best to apply through our application portal - this way, your application lands directly with our team and we can review it quickly and easily. Ready to own (y)our growth? title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive . Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: Team's mission Upvest's core product is an API: the execution layer that moves securities for our clients. Upfront extends into the layer above it. It's Upvest's operational service panel for enterprise clients, giving their operations, support and compliance staff the ability to handle first-line requests themselves: looking into an end-user's account, checking what happened to an order, answering the question in front of them. Today their options are to ask Upvest support or to build a service panel of their own, which most of them won't do. Our mission is to prove that financial institution customers can replace their fragmented operations with Upfront. That case isn't settled yet, and this team is the one making it. Our users do this work all day, so a clumsy interface is how a task turns back into a ticket for us. Our clients are already asking what AI can do for their operations teams. Agentic operations, exposed over MCP, is where we think this goes. What it should look like in Upfront is still open, and we'd like the person in this role to help define it. Upfront is part of the Clients Tribe at Upvest. Together with the Public API and Tooling Apps teams we enable Upvest’s business to scale efficiently, accelerate our client’s time-to-market and embed intelligence and automation into client processes. Your mission You’ll focus on building what actually creates value for our clients. While our OKRs set the destination, we expect you to help map the route. We prioritize impact and shipping speed over a perfectly groomed backlog. Because you're on a client-facing team, the quality of your output directly impacts client trust – especially since we are handling their customers' money. In our domain, the bar is high: anything touching client funds must be correct and auditable, or it's an incident. We will give you the client context, access, and autonomy to figure out what needs building, rather than just handing you a rigid spec. We also expect you to challenge our internal processes if they are slowing down your efficiency or shipping speed. What you’ll do: Take operational problems from concept to production, working across our React/TypeScript frontend and Go backend services. Own modern interface security. Upfront is where external users act on real end-user data, so you will tackle per-client isolated environments, least-privilege access, and Auth0 integrations in a regulated space. Expand the operational surface across Upvest's internal domains and develop a deep understanding of how our core systems piece together. Help define how software delivery works in an AI-enabled company by pushing AI tooling to its limits to maximize quality and speed while staying compliant. Build agentic operations as we move toward exposing Upfront over MCP. Every action requires a strict audit trail, so you will solve real design problems around what an agent can do autonomously versus what requires human intervention. Work in weekly cycles with bi-weekly retrospectives to prioritize high-quality, high-frequency shipping. What you bring: A strong product engineering mindset where you care about the "why" just as much as the "how" and proactively bring ideas to the table. Solid backend experience in Go, Java, or Kotlin (we build in Go but will give you time to ramp up). Practical experience building modern client-facing interfaces using React and TypeScript. Experience building products that require per-customer configuration without devolving into a custom fork per client. Deep knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices. A strong focus on quality, extensibility, and automated testing. True end-to-end ownership across containers, CI/CD pipelines, and relational data modeling. A working understanding of event-driven architectures. A pragmatic approach to engineering and the ability to make smart tradeoffs under constraints. Real-world experience using AI tools to drive software engineering workflows, not only writing code snippets . The ability to navigate undefined problems and align other teams without needing formal authority. It’s great if you have: Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general. Experience building operational or back-office tooling for business users. Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, or with multi-tenant isolation. Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing). How we Upvest in you: Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market. Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest. Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it. Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose. Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program. Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements. Inclusion : We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies. Our Values: Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions. Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection. Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together. Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others. Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
description: <h2><strong>Kurz und knapp</strong></h2> <p>Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen?<br><br>Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in <strong>Falkensee</strong> bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der <em>Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation</em> bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.<br><br><strong>Sei von Anfang an dabei:</strong> Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/erdeY5trkMA" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Teamleitung: </strong>Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 5 Lead Shoppers und über 150 Shoppers.</li> <li><strong>Schichtleitung: </strong>Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.</li> <li><strong>Abwechslung:</strong> Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1 Tag pro Woche).</li> <li><strong>Prozessoptimierung: </strong>Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.</li> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.</li> <li>Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).</li> <li>Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) mit.</li> <li>Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.</li> <li>Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Starte durch - mit uns:</strong> Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Zeit zum Auftanken:</strong> Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung für Gewinner:</strong> Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Individuelle Mobilität:</strong>  Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung. Dazu bieten wir ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.</li> <li><strong>Lebensmittelretter:</strong> Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!</li> <li><strong>Lerne & wachse:</strong> Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.</li> <li><strong>Absicherung für morgen:</strong> Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Unser erfolgreiches Konzept wird durch Investoren wie die Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation gestützt. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams und bringe deine analytischen und organisatorischen Stärken ein, um die Lager-Performance zu steigern und das Einkaufserlebnis unserer KundInnen zu verbessern.<br><br><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/o1FOzeb4YYs" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Teamführung: </strong>Du bist der zentrale Anker und die erste Ansprechperson für dein Team - leite, motiviere, fördere und inspiriere täglich ein Team aus Teamleitenden und über 100 Lagermitarbeitenden.</li> <li><strong>Schichtleitung: </strong>Du steuerst den täglichen Betrieb im FC und sorgst während deiner Schicht mit Struktur und Sorgfalt dafür, dass alle operativen Aktivitäten priorisiert und zuverlässig abgeschlossen werden.</li> <li><strong>Prozessoptimierung: </strong>Übernimm die Verantwortung für eigene, standortbasierte Optimierungsprojekte - du bringst pragmatische Lösungen ein und verbesserst gemeinsam mit dem Team stetig unsere logistischen Abläufe.</li> <li><strong>Vielseitigkeit: </strong>Meistere den spannenden Balanceakt zwischen operativer Führungsaufgabe (3-4 Schichtleitungstage) und strategischer Arbeit (1-2 Officetage) - für eine abwechslungsreiche und erfüllende Tätigkeit.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Du hast ein Studium (Bachelor/Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich erfolgreich abgeschlossen.</li> <li>Du bist affin für Logistikthemen und hast idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrung im Lagerumfeld sammeln können (z.B. in Form von Praktika, Werkstudium oder Ähnlichem).</li> <li>Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.</li> <li>Du bist bereit, im Rahmen einer Vollzeit-Position abends und teilweise samstags zu arbeiten.</li> <li>Deine Fähigkeit, plötzlich auftretende Probleme schnell zu erfassen und zielgerichtete, praktikable Lösungen zu finden, zeichnet dich aus.</li> <li>Du arbeitest selbstständig, gründlich und bist zielorientiert mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität.</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</strong></h2> <p><strong></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Starte durch - mit uns:</strong> Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Zeit zum Auftanken:</strong> Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung für Gewinner:</strong> Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Individuelle Mobilität:</strong> Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung.</li> <li><strong>Lebensmittelretter:</strong> Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!</li> <li><strong>Lerne & wachse:</strong> Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.</li> <li><strong>Absicherung für morgen:</strong> Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.</li> </ul> <p><strong></strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Chef d'équipe logistique (H/F)
description: <h2>En bref</h2> <p>Picnic grandit vite, et notre centre de préparation de commandes de Fretin a besoin de pilotes pour porter cette ambition. En tant que Captain, tu n'es pas juste un(e) chef(fe) d'équipe : tu es le moteur de l'entrepôt. Ton défi ? Manager environ 20 Shoppers (préparateur(rice)s de commandes) en direct, garantir une sécurité totale et transformer chaque shift en succès collectif avec +100 Shoppers sur le terrain. Si tu aimes l'action et que tu sais fédérer une équipe dans la bonne humeur, ce rôle est pour toi.</p> <h2>Tes missions</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Manager et coacher ton équipe</strong> : Tu supervises une vingtaine de Shoppers au quotidien, en veillant à leur motivation, leur sécurité et au respect des bonnes pratiques.</li> <li><strong>Piloter la performance</strong> : Tu garantis que chaque commande est prête, complète et à l'heure, en suivant de près nos indicateurs de qualité.</li> <li><strong>Coordonner les flux du FC</strong> : Tu travailles main dans la main avec les autres Captains pour fluidifier les opérations et ajuster les ressources en temps réel.</li> <li><strong>Assurer la polyvalence opérationnelle</strong> : Réception, gestion des stocks (sec, frais, surgelé) ou départ des camions... tu navigues entre les zones selon les besoins du planning.</li> <li><strong>Gérer l'humain et le terrain</strong> : Tu es le point de contact privilégié pour ton équipe, capable de recadrer avec pédagogie comme de féliciter les réussites.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Organisation du temps de travail :</strong></p> <ul> <li>35 heures travaillées réparties sur 4 jours par semaine.</li> <li>3 jours de repos chaque semaine.</li> <li>Travail le week-end, dimanche inclus, à raison de 3 semaines par mois.</li> <li>Des shifts tournants selon les besoins de l'activité.</li> </ul> <h2>À propos de toi</h2> <ul> <li>Tu as entre 1 et 5 ans d'expérience dans un environnement dynamique (logistique, retail, restauration ou ligne de production) avec une première gestion d'équipe réussie.</li> <li>Tu maîtrises le français (l'anglais est un plus) et tu es parfaitement à l'aise avec les outils digitaux de pilotage.</li> <li>Tu es véhiculé(e) pour rejoindre facilement l'entrepôt de Fretin.</li> <li>Tu n'as pas peur de mettre la main à la pâte. Tu aimes l'action et tu sais prendre des décisions rapides pour débloquer des situations opérationnelles.</li> </ul> <h2>Avantages Picnic</h2> <p data-path-to-node="1">🍴 <strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="3">Rémunération et restauration</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="2">Une rémunération fixe<strong> </strong>à partir de 2 322 € brut par mois (sur 12 mois, évolutive selon ton expérience) ainsi que la majoration de tes heures de nuit. Dans ton FC, tu disposeras également d’une variété de déjeuners, de dîners, de snacks et de boissons sains, préparés fraîchement sur place par notre chef !</p> <p data-path-to-node="5">👨‍⚕️ <strong data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="6">Santé et repos</strong></p> <p id="p-rc_c2e6c6af48e90552-27" data-path-to-node="6"><span class="citation-254 citation-end-254">Tu disposeras de 5 semaines de congés payés par an. De plus, grâce à nos partenariats avec SideCare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratique</span>s.</p> <p data-path-to-node="3">🎫 <strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="3">Sorties et divertissement</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Un accès à des offres et avantages exclusifs via notre CSE et partenaire Swile (bons d'achats, places de concert, cinéma, et plus encore). Tu seras aussi convié(e) à nos événements récurrents comme notre très convoitée Summer Party !</p> <p data-path-to-node="7">✍️ <strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="3">Développement personnel et professionnel</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="8">Tu auras l’opportunité de développer tes compétences, non seulement au travers de projets stimulants, mais aussi grâce à des<strong> </strong>formations dédiées au leadership avec des modules développés par notre équipe Learning and Development.</p> <p> </p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/FSwRUFqnISA" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Staff System Architect -SNSPD Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><span class="s1"><span class="TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0"><strong>What to expect</strong></span></span></span></p> <p>We are looking for a Staff System Architect to be fully dedicated to the SNSPD product line, with a strong focus on leading the technical architecture and roadmap for our next-generation rack-mountable SNSPD (Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector) platform. This role is critical to defining and guiding the technical evolution of our cutting-edge cryogenic photon detection systems, ensuring architectural coherence across hardware, software, and integration domains while supporting our product vision and market requirements.</p> <p>We are looking for a proven architect of complex, multi-domain instruments, whether from space systems, astronomical instrumentation, scientific or medical imaging, electron or advanced optical microscopy, semiconductor equipment, or comparable fields who can bring that system-level rigour to our platform.</p> <p><span class="s1"><span class="TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0"><strong><span class="TextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0">What you'll be doing</span></span></strong></span></span></span></p> <p>In this role, you will be an integral part of the development process for IDQ's SNSPD platform, with applications across quantum computing, networking, and sensing. You will be at the intersection of quantum photonics, cryogenic systems engineering and embedded systems to create scalable, maintainable architectures for autonomous 24/7 detector operations.</p> <p>You will take ownership of the end-to-end system architecture of the SNSPD platform, ensuring alignment with a shared long-term product vision while translating product requirements into clear system-level designs and specifications. This includes defining system structure, interfaces, and key architectural decisions, as well as driving critical trade-offs across performance, cost, scalability, and integration. You will also align engineering execution with the architectural vision, guiding system integration and resolving complex cross-domain design challenges.</p> <p>In addition, you will play a key role in shaping the technology roadmap and driving the evolution of the platform, continuously evaluating and introducing new technologies where relevant to maintain innovation and competitiveness.</p> <ul> <li>Lead system architecture, design decisions, and cross-functional alignment to ensure a scalable and high-performing SNSPD platform</li> <li>Drive technology roadmap, integration, and innovation by evaluating and implementing new technologies</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="s1">What you'll bring</span></strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced professional with a Master's degree (PhD preferred) in physics, electrical engineering, photonics, or a related field, and 7+ years of experience in the design of complex, multi-domain systems, with demonstrated ownership of system architecture. The ideal candidate has architected instruments or platforms of comparable complexity, combining optics or photonics with electronics, mechanics or thermal design, and embedded or software components and has proven experience integrating these technologies into cohesive, high-performing products.</p> <p>You will demonstrate strong technical leadership across multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to clearly communicate complex system architectures to a wide range of stakeholders. This includes ensuring alignment, supporting informed decision-making, and driving successful collaboration across functions to deliver robust and scalable system designs.</p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in system architecture and multi-domain integration, with strong system-level thinking</li> <li>Proven technical leadership and communication skills, enabling alignment and effective decision-making across diverse teams</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="s1">You'll be a great fit with</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in domains of comparable complexity: space instrumentation, astronomy, high-end microscopy or imaging, semiconductor or scientific equipment</li> <li>Experience with photonics, low-noise electronics, cryogenics, or vacuum systems</li> <li>Experience with SNSPDs, single-photon detection, or quantum systems</li> <li>Experience bringing industrialized or rack-mountable systems to market</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p> </p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply! </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

You will be the senior authority for this classical and hybrid layer, working alongside our PQC architecture leadership. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p>You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2/SHA-3, HMAC/KDF constructions), RSA/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A/B/C). IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> Oxford, UK<br><strong>Office commitment:</strong> Hybrid</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>Quantum is now, and it's built here. Oxford Ionics, now part of IonQ, is pioneering the next generation of quantum computing. Using our world-leading trapped-ion technology, we're building the most powerful, accurate and reliable quantum systems to tackle problems that today's supercomputers cannot solve.</p> <p>We're looking for an enthusiastic and highly technical Senior Software Engineer for our non-realtime controllers team who will thrive in our dynamic cross-disciplinary environment. You will be working closely with our skilled software engineers, our systems teams who operate the physical quantum computers, and our world-leading quantum scientists to build and operate the software that controls the hardware surrounding our quantum computers. Previous exposure to quantum systems is not required.</p> <p>You will own areas of the hardware control surface end to end, from the device protocol up to a service running reliably across our fleet. This is a hands-on engineering role and stays that way as you grow.</p> <p>A working quantum computer is far more than the ion trap and its real-time control electronics. It depends on a fleet of supporting hardware, including cryogenic compressors, vacuum pumps, power supplies, lasers, temperature controllers, wavemeters and cameras, that has to be kept observable, controllable and reliable. The timing-critical operations such as gate waveforms and ion transport run on dedicated real-time FPGA systems, while this team owns everything that does not need hard timing guarantees. We're looking for someone who can own a problem area with little supervision and judge where robustness is worth the effort.</p> <p>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li>Strong systems engineering skills. Our controllers are written in Rust, so either solid Rust experience or deep proficiency in another systems language and the appetite to work in a Rust codebase, including async programming.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating networked services such as gRPC or REST, with a real grasp of error handling, observability and failure modes.</li> <li>Experience of hardware and instrument protocols and interfaces such as SCPI, Modbus, serial and Ethernet.</li> <li>Comfortable owning the production behaviour of what you build, not just its correctness in test.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills both within software and across disciplines, and an interest in helping other engineers get better at the craft without wanting to stop building yourself.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. title: Commercial Lead, DACH
description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. There’s already momentum: clinicians using the product, customers recommending us and healthcare organisations coming to us with interest. You’ll build on that foundation by closing strategically important deals, creating new pipeline and turning individual adoption into broader organisational relationships. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a broad commercial remit. You’ll personally own opportunities from first conversation to signed agreement, while helping us develop partnerships, strengthen our market presence and figure out where to focus next. You might spend one day building a business case with a hospital group, the next prospecting into a priority account, and another working with a potential partner or helping shape a local event. You’ll bring the judgement to choose what matters and the follow-through to make it happen. title: People Partner - Paris France
description: Job Title: People Partner - Paris France Location: Hybrid About Radiant Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments. We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software . As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace. Job Summary: You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle for our team in France . Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices in line with French employment law across our Paris office and global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale. Key Responsibilities: What you'll do Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, working time and leave (forfait jours, congés payés, RTT) and performance management. Managing employee relations under French law and the applicable convention collective, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on. Serve as the local first line of defence for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to French labour law (Code du travail), the applicable collective bargaining agreement (convention collective), site-specific contracts and health and safety obligations, including keeping the DUERP (workplace risk assessment) up to date. Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive or high-impact situations, monitor recurring issues and operational risks, and ensure that incidents are resolved at their root cause, with appropriate care for the employees involved. Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the Paris office. Draft, review and interpret French employment contracts, amendments (avenants), non-compete clauses with their required financial compensation, and working time arrangements such as forfait jours for cadres. Manage hiring formalities and onboarding under French law, including the DPAE, the registre unique du personnel, the initial occupational health visit (visite d’information et de prévention), and probation periods (périodes d’essai) and their renewal. Support pre-litigation and litigation before the Conseil de prud’hommes, working closely with our external employment lawyers (avocats en droit social). Review, update and maintain Radiant’s French people policies.Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows. Ensure compliance with French employment legislation, collective agreements, internal policies and regulatory requirements. Partner with our external payroll provider on monthly payroll and DSN filings, and manage mandatory benefits, including the mutuelle and prévoyance schemes, and occupational health (médecine du travail) follow-up. Manage training obligations, including the plan de développement des compétences, working with our OPCO, and supporting employees’ use of their CPF (compte personnel de formation). Compliance Help ensure compliance with French employment law and best practice across France and the wider EU, in consultation with the UK-based People team and external French employment counsel as needed. Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet French employment law, GDPR and CNIL requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes. Monitor headcount thresholds (11, 50 and 250 employees) and prepare Radiant for the obligations each one triggers, such as the CSE, the règlement intérieur, gender equality reporting and mandatory profit-sharing (participation). Act as the main point of contact for the labour inspectorate (inspection du travail) and the occupational health service, and keep mandatory registers and workplace notices (affichages obligatoires) up to date. Employee representation (CSE) Set up the CSE once the Paris office reaches 11 employees for 12 consecutive months, including negotiating the protocole d’accord préélectoral and organising professional elections. Run information and consultation processes with the CSE on reorganisations, policy changes and other matters that require it, and set up the BDESE once we reach 50 employees. Immigration and visas Advise on global mobility as we expand across Europe, including UK–France moves, secondments and posted worker (détachement) requirements. Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale, including the CSE consultation and French legal requirements that apply to any reorganisation. Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance (insuffisance professionnelle) through fair, well-documented processes that would stand up before the Conseil de prud’hommes. Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions. Qualifications: 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role in France, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business. Deep, current knowledge of French employment law (Code du travail, conventions collectives, CSE obligations, working time rules) and confidence applying it to real situations.
