procedures, and support operation on site close to Munich WHO YOU ARE A team player who loves challenges and is not afraid to experiment, take risks and learn from mistakes A proven track record of We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped. At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners. You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind. This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem. Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners. Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm. Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables. Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform. Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity. Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery. Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly. Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers. What You Bring Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment. Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders. Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers. Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum. Together, you'll be designing, shipping and running AI agents and assistants that transform how 330+ engineers, Product Managers, Designers and QAs work every day.</p> <p><em>Please note this role requires to be based 4 days at the office, per week.</em></p> <h2><strong>Your Impact</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Build agents and assistants as products</strong> - across the full software development lifecycle (code review, tech design, maintenance, incident response), from first prototype to tools teams genuinely rely on every day.</li> <li><strong>Define and expand AI delegation safely</strong> - set the human control points, guardrails and evaluation frameworks; measure the autonomy rate per task type and extend what agents handle as trust builds over time.</li> <li><strong>Turn team pain points into working software</strong> - sit with engineers, PMs, QAs and designers to find the real friction, prototype fast, pilot with volunteer squads, and scale what works.</li> <li><strong>Build the knowledge infrastructure agents consume</strong> - along with tooling for usage, cost and impact monitoring, leveraging the Data & Agentic Platform and DevExp foundations rather than rebuilding them from scratch.</li> <li><strong>Make every product measurable</strong> - adoption rate, time saved, quality, cost: nothing ships without its metrics.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You'll Bring to the Role</strong></h2> <p><strong>Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, Developer Productivity, or related fields</li> <li>Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, with experience building reliable, maintainable and production-ready systems</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and operating AI-powered products, using LLMs, RAG and AI Agents</li> <li>Experience applying AI to software development workflows, such as code review, technical design, testing, documentation, maintenance or incident response</li> <li>Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and integrating developer tools, code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, issue trackers or documentation platforms</li> <li>Experience evaluating AI systems and improving their reliability, quality and level of autonomy, through appropriate evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop mechanisms</li> <li>Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments</li> <li>Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate closely with engineers and cross-functional teams</li> <li>Curiosity, pragmatism and a strong product mindset, with a passion for turning real developer pain points into useful AI-powered solutions</li> <li>Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can better understand what you have built and worked on!</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2><strong>Tech Stack</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Java, Python, TypeScript</li> <li><strong>Agentic stack</strong>: Coding Agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, pi.dev) , MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source models), evaluation frameworks</li> <li><strong>Infrastructure</strong>: GitHub Actions/CI, Kubernetes, Datadog</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2><strong>Our Hiring Process</strong></h2> <p>We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.</p> <p>Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.</p> <p><strong>Interview steps:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>30/45-minute call</strong> with someone from the recruitment team to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details</li> <li><strong>45-minute technical interview</strong> on Google Meet with a member of our Labs teams to discuss our technical stack and assess your knowledge</li> <li><strong>1-hour business discussion</strong> with Benoit, to have a better understanding of the team and its stakes </li> <li><strong>2 x 45-minute STAR interviews</strong> to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders you'll be interacting with </li> </ol> <p>More information about our recruitment philosophy 👉<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/3-tips-pour-briller-en-entretien-star-chez-mirakl-kauffmann-0ojzf/"> 3 tips to shine in STAR interviews at Mirakl</a></p> <h2><br><br></h2><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. title: HRBP (x/f/m)
description: Rejoindre Doctolib en tant que HR Business Partner pour les équipes Customer Care en France, c'est rejoindre une équipe RH et travailler en binôme sur ce périmètre. Vous serez le/la partenaire RH de confiance des responsables Customer Care, en étroite collaboration avec votre binôme, avec pour mission d'aider à façonner l'organisation, pas seulement de la soutenir, et de faire avancer la transformation de manière pragmatique et terrain. Ce fonctionnement en binôme nécessite un fort esprit d'équipe, une réelle capacité de collaboration et l'envie de construire ensemble des solutions adaptées aux enjeux du business. Ce rôle offre une combinaison rare d'influence stratégique et de proximité opérationnelle réelle. Vous travaillerez directement avec les managers et responsables Customer Care sur les sujets qui définissent la performance et la croissance durable : design organisationnel, coaching managérial, talent et succession, cycles de rémunération et situations individuelles complexes. Si vous êtes stimulé(e) par des environnements où les priorités évoluent vite et où les décisions se prennent avec données et discernement, vous trouverez ici la portée et l'autonomie pour avoir un impact visible. En tant que HR Business Partner, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'une des phases de transformation les plus importantes de Doctolib. Rattaché(e) directement à la HR Director France, vous travaillerez auprès d'une population Customer Care dans un environnement international et en mouvement constant. Vous serez à la fois stratégique et opérationnel(le) : vous façonnerez le design organisationnel, piloterez des projets de transformation à grande échelle et accompagnerez les managers dans leurs défis de croissance. Vous bénéficierez d'une réelle autonomie pour laisser votre empreinte sur la façon dont nous construisons et développons l'excellence au sein de nos équipes Customer Care. Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à : Transformation business & efficacité organisationnelle Collaborer avec les managers et responsables Customer Care pour influencer les décisions clés en matière de design organisationnel, de gestion de la performance et d'initiatives de changement, pas seulement les exécuter Allier conseil stratégique et soutien opérationnel, en restant proche du terrain tout en accompagnant les managers dans la complexité et en pilotant des transformations significatives Conseil RH & gestion du changement Piloter des programmes de conduite du changement en local Coacher et guider les managers pour améliorer l'efficacité collective et la santé organisationnelle de leurs équipes Gérer les situations individuelles complexes avec le support juridique, en garantissant conformité, agilité business et équité Excellence RH Développer une compréhension approfondie du business et de la culture Doctolib, et être l'ambassadeur(rice) du modèle opérationnel et des produits People Contribuer à la meilleure expérience collaborateur possible en apportant un soutien RH de premier plan aux équipes Customer Care Piloter les cycles RH de bout en bout, performance, revues de talent, rémunération, avec rigueur ; élaborer les plans de développement, de rétention et de succession qui élèvent le niveau sur l'ensemble du périmètre Construire et entretenir des relations solides avec les équipes transversales, TA, L&D, C&B, Juridique, tout en assurant l'alignement entre les besoins locaux et les initiatives People globales Les qualités attendues en tant que HRBP Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler. Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous : Maîtrisez le français et l'anglais, niveau professionnel, pour évoluer dans notre environnement international, avec une solide connaissance du droit social français Justifiez d'au moins 4 ans d'expérience RH, dans des environnements de transformation ou en forte croissance, avec une pratique du partenariat business Excellez dans l'influence sans autorité : vous construisez de vraies relations partenariales au-delà de la simple application des politiques RH, challengez vos interlocuteurs de façon constructive et pilotez le changement grâce à des insights data-driven Vous vous épanouissez dans des environnements rapides et ambigus, avec de solides compétences en gestion du changement et la capacité à piloter des projets complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes Faites preuve d'un solide sens du business et d'une orientation terrain : vous comprenez les dynamiques organisationnelles, parlez le langage des responsables Customer Care et savez concilier conformité et solutions pragmatiques favorisant la performance Ce serait fantastique si : Vous avez une expérience dans des fonctions Customer Care ou commerciales, et comprenez les enjeux spécifiques de talent et de performance de ces équipes Vous avez un parcours démontré dans la conduite de transformations à grande échelle, en pesant sur les décisions stratégiques dès leur conception Notre offre Une mutuelle avantageuse prise en charge à 100 % par Doctolib, régime de base, pour les employés et leurs enfants 25 jours de congés payés et 12 à 14 jours de RTT par an Un programme de santé mentale et de coaching personnalisé gratuit avec notre partenaire Moka.care 10 jours par an de télétravail à l'étranger possible Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 8,50 € par jour, dont 4,50 € pris en charge par Doctolib Une subvention du comité d'entreprise pour le remboursement partiel d'adhésions à des activités sportives ou de loisirs Un remboursement à 50 % de l'abonnement aux transports en commun Programme ParentCare : bénéficiez d'un congé de naissance couvert par Doctolib à 100 % le premier mois et à 75 % le deuxième mois Pour les salariés en situation de handicap ou proches aidants, un package comprenant une adaptation du télétravail, des jours d'absence autorisée payés pour les rendez-vous médicaux et un soutien évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences avec nos besoins. Rencontre avec la manager : une exploration de vos compétences à travers des mises en situation concrètes et une présentation de notre équipe et mission. Échange avec votre futur binôme : un échange sur votre manière de collaborer. L'objectif sera de vérifier que le fit est bon, car vous travaillerez en binôme au quotidien sur le périmètre Customer Care. title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own the delivery of scoped customer implementations and help turn real-world business needs into production-grade agentic automation solutions . You’ll partner closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to design, build, integrate, and iterate on AI-enabled workflows, balancing speed, reliability, and maintainability. You’ll contribute practical field insights back to the organization, helping refine solution patterns, reusable assets, and implementation playbooks. Unlike traditional software engineers who build a single product for many customers, FDEs ship tailored solutions directly in customer environments, making the platform real for specific business processes and systems. You’ll operate with increasing independence, drive execution on well-defined workstreams , and collaborate with senior FDEs and product teams to align with broader technical direction. What you'll do at UiPath Design and build AI-driven workflows, agents, and automations, aligned with UiPath's architecture and platform standards without requiring regular guidance. Build AI Agents using UiPath technologies, including Maestro or Agent Builder Apply practical prompt engineering skills to reliably guide agent behavior and understand model tradeoffs (capability, latency, cost) when selecting LLM providers for customer use cases. Extend platform functionality using APIs, SDKs, and connectors to address unique customer requirements. Debug across systems including AI inference, data pipelines, orchestration layers, and integration points, resolving most issues independently. Contribute to internal libraries, reusable components, or frameworks that enhance consistency across customer deployments. Anticipate delivery risks and communicate blockers, delays, and scope issues proactively to teammates and stakeholders. Use telemetry, insights, and traces to identify optimization opportunities and failure patterns independently. What you'll bring to the team 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent) delivering production software. Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (or similar modern languages). Experience building and shipping integrations using APIs and working with cloud services or enterprise systems. Comfort operating in customer-facing environments with strong written and verbal communication. Ability to independently drive scoped projects, manage risks, and deliver against deadlines. Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed. Our core principles Customer Centric: Stay close to customer users and stakeholders; anchor decisions in outcomes, adoption, and long-term success. Breaking Silos: Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customer teams to unblock delivery and align on the right solution. Improving Agility: Prototype, test, ship, observe, and iterate—treat deployments and feedback loops as the fastest way to learn. Dealing with Ambiguity: Make progress with incomplete information; clarify requirements through discovery, iteration, and pragmatic tradeoffs. Building Focus: Prioritize the highest-impact workstreams, manage scope actively, and deliver durable solutions that customers can run and evolve. Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned. Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy . title: Founding sales lead
description: Who are we? The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable. Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction : detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them. We sell to navies and coast guards , and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy. Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk. ⚡ What is at stake in the coming months Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators. Deploy and sign our first paid pilots. Sign our first contracts. By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows. 🎯 Your mission Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy. Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts. Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together. Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia. title: Senior Optical Design Engineer
description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. Overview We are expanding our optomechanical capabilities, and the success of our projects depends on optical designs that are precise, manufacturable, and verified through rigorous analysis and testing. As a Senior Optical Design Engineer, you will own optical designs from concept through lab validation, turning requirements into lens designs and optical assemblies that perform reliably in the real world. This position reports to our Responsible Engineer, Optical Systems, and is based in our Toulouse, France office. Our working language is English. What you will be doing Design and optimize lenses and optical systems, from first-order layout to detailed optimization with ray tracing and physical optics propagation (POP). Carry out tolerance analysis and Monte Carlo simulations to predict manufacturing and assembly yield, and define realistic tolerances with suppliers. Conduct STOP (Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance) analysis with mechanical engineers, verifying performance and margins across operating conditions. Conduct stray light analysis. Produce lens and optomechanical drawings, and work with mechanical engineers to ensure designs are manufacturable and assemblable. Define assembly, alignment, and bonding procedures, and support their implementation in clean room environments. Plan and execute lab assembly and test, covering alignment, characterization, and performance verification of prototypes and flight-representative hardware. Characterize components and assemblies through optical metrology, and identify discrepancies . D rive root-cause investigations and design iterations. Work with suppliers on design for manufacturing, tolerancing, inspection, qualification, and pre-production runs. What you bring to this role A Master’s degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field, with a strong foundation in geometrical and physical optics. 5+ years of experience in optical design, including lens and optical system design , optimization and STOP analysis. Proficiency in Zemax OpticStudio, including sequential ray tracing and optimization. Hands-on lab experience in optical assembly and test, with working knowledge of metrology instruments such as interferometers, wavefront sensors, MTF benches, autocollimators, and centration measurement tools. Experience with spaceborne optics or qualification to space-relevant standards, such as ECSS. Selection of adhesives, coatings and optics materials. Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot problems across simulation and hardware. A proactive mindset and a commitment to high standards of quality and performance. Bonus points Experience with free space optical communication systems . Python and ZOS-API skills for automating analysis or processing data. Experience with ANOVA methodology, including Gauge R&R studies and statistical post-processing in tools such as JMP. Practical knowledge of cleanroom practice, optics cleaning, adhesive bonding . title: Lead Mechanical Engineer H/F Heat Pumps - France
description: Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need loads more people to help us make our vision a reality. We're recruiting our first Lead Mechanical Engineer to supervise the installations of our Air Source Heat Pumps. We're looking for passionate people who have experience installing heating systems and are willing to help us grow this activity in France This is a field based role covering the Amiens area, but you’ll also be expected to work from home or from our Lille office when required. What you'll do You’ll help us set up the technical arm of our heat pump department in France You’ll ensure the quality and proper functioning of the installations carried out by our local partners You’ll be out in the field visiting construction sites to ensure they are running smoothly You’ll be able to provide technical support to resolve any issues identified on site directly You’ll have a “troubleshooter” mindset to find solutions to challenges and resolve them You’ll use your knowledge and experience of heat pump installations to ensure a seemless and outstanding experience You’ll share low carbon advice with our customers You’ll review and collaborate on technical specifications and mechanical drawings What you'll need 3+ years of experience installing and maintaining air source heat pump systems Happy to travel around the Amiens region You’ll be an experienced plumbing and heating engineer with knowledge of heating system design and the ability to fault find You’ll have experience of reviewing and challenging technical specifications & mechanical drawings Qualifications Clean French Driving licence CAP/BEP, or VAE level You previously worked within companies with RGE & Qualibat certifications (or owned them if you were self-employed) Technical English proficiency (B1) BR NF C18-510 electrical habilitation It would be great if you had some of the below too: Happy using computers, including Excel Some experience with the electrical side of heat pumps BR electrical qualification What we offer Salary : €2900 a month Insurance company participation Additional salary for overtime/on-call 10€ per working day lunch vouchers (“Tickets-restaurants”) Share options in Octopus Energy Use of company tools Uniform and all PPE Company Vehicle and fuel If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you. title: Systems Engineer - Network Data Plane Software
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England, Atlanta GA, Washington DC, </strong></p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. Cloudflare's network runs in hundreds of cities on general-purpose Linux servers, not dedicated routers, so the routers, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies that carry our customers' traffic are software that we write, ship, and operate ourselves.</p> <p>Our Packet Processing team builds and operates that software: high-performance code that processes customer traffic at the packet level as it moves through Cloudflare's network, in every Cloudflare data center. That includes the L4 load balancer at the front door of every server, a per-customer routing and forwarding data plane, a stateful network firewall, and a TCP/UDP reverse proxy (the engines behind products like Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall, and Spectrum).</p> <p>We are a team of engineers who obsess over performance, correctness, and reliability at massive scale. We own what we build in production, a lot of our work happens close to the kernel and the NIC.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>We're looking for engineers who want to build the software that forwards, filters, and load-balances packets for a meaningful fraction of the internet. If you've worked on routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, or SDN data planes, and you'd like to do that in software, at Cloudflare's scale, this is the role.</p> <p>We're moving towards a unified data plane platform that all of our L3/L4 products share. Instead of each product having its own data path, with its own configuration, performance work, and failure modes, we build a feature once and every product gets it.</p> <p>Some of the things you'd work on:</p> <ul> <li>The shared platform: packet I/O, a graph of processing stages, per-core steering, per-customer isolation, and upgrades that don't drop traffic</li> <li>A userspace forwarding plane that gives each customer their own routing and forwarding, with traffic arriving and leaving over tunnels (GRE, IPsec) and direct connections</li> <li>A stateful packet firewall written in Rust: rule evaluation, rate limiting, intrusion detection, packet capture, and dual-stack IPv4/IPv6</li> <li>An XDP-based L4 load balancer that touches nearly every connection into Cloudflare and forwards packets between servers and between data centers</li> <li>A fast path that uses XDP and eBPF to forward very large single flows at multiple Gbps</li> <li>Host networking: classifying each packet once and using that result everywhere on the server, instead of separate configs that can disagree</li> <li>Chasing down packet drops, latency, and throughput problems across a fleet of servers in hundreds of cities</li> </ul> <p>We write mostly Go and Rust (plus C for eBPF) on Linux, and the work ranges from XDP and the kernel network stack to userspace packet pipelines and the control planes that configure them.</p> <p>You'll build, deploy, and operate these systems on top of one of the largest edge networks in the world. You'll partner with some of the best engineers and product managers, on our team and across Cloudflare, to solve big problems that have a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and users.</p> <p>We're looking for curious, empathetic engineers who are excited to join us in changing the way networking is done!</p> <h2>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</h2> <ul> <li>Systems programming experience in Rust, Go, C, or C++</li> <li>A solid understanding of L3 and L4 networking: IP, TCP, UDP, routing and forwarding, tunneling (GRE, IPsec), NAT, connection tracking, and anycast</li> <li>Experience building data plane software: routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN gateways, or SDN/NFV systems</li> <li>Linux networking: eBPF/XDP, tc, netfilter/nftables, network namespaces, sockets, etc.</li> <li>High-performance packet processing in user space or the kernel (e.g., AF_XDP, DPDK, VPP)</li> <li>Debugging, profiling, and optimizing systems where throughput and latency matter</li> <li>Building and operating large-scale, reliable, distributed systems</li> <li>Operating what you build: on-call, incident response, and root cause analysis</li> <li>Reading unfamiliar code and safely evolving systems that have been in production for years</li> <li>Owning work end to end, from design through deployment, and working across teams to land shared solutions</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication; Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England, Atlanta GA, Washington DC, </strong></p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. We own what we build in production, a lot of our work happens close to the kernel and the NIC.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>For us, performance is a product feature. description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You would own Mews' relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day.</p> <p>You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to <strong>Unleash the Potential</strong> of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.</p> <p>We work with over 5,800 teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  </p> <p>Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. </p> <h4><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> to help build the Perch camera system, </p> <p>Based in Europe (remote), you will work across platform, perception, and ML systems. You will help us improve how we collect, process, and analyze performance data at scale, spanning from devices collecting real-time to backend services and ML infrastructure. All of which will have a direct impact on customers and their experiences with the product.</p> <p>This role suits a strong generalist who has seen many parts of engineering. You might have worked on any of the following: high-throughput systems, computer vision, robotics, ML infrastructure, or other complex applications. Our ideal candidate brings strong engineering judgment, good technical range, and the ability to learn quickly.</p> <p>You will be hands-on, working in Python and C++ on devices and services in use by our customers every day.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO </strong></p> <ul> <li><em>Design and implement algorithms for 3D object tracking, segmentation, and motion recognition on embedded hardware.</em></li> <li><em>Train and iterate on ML models — from dataset curation through training, evaluation, and deployment to edge devices.</em></li> <li><em>Help bring ML, computer vision, or signal-processing systems into production with tight performance constraints</em></li> <li><em>Build reliable application features and services that customers use in real environments.</em></li> <li><em>Analyze production data to find system limits, product issues, and opportunities for improvement.</em></li> <li><em>Collaborate closely with the embedded platform team on model optimization and inference performance, and with the applications team on how tracking data becomes product features.</em></li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong></h4> <ul> <li><em>4+ years of software engineering experience in production systems.</em></li> <li><em>Strong skill in Python and backend engineering.</em></li> <li><em>Working knowledge of C++ or a strong reason to be effective in performance-critical code.</em></li> <li><em>Experience with data-intensive systems, distributed systems, parallel processing, or efficient data pipelines.</em></li> <li><em>Exposure to ML, ML infrastructure, signal processing, real-time systems, computer vision, or related applied technical areas.</em></li> <li><em>A track record of shipping reliable software, not only prototypes.</em></li> <li><em>Strong debugging skills and the ability to find the root cause of complex system behavior.</em></li> <li><em>Clear communication and good judgment when tradeoffs are not simple.</em></li> <li><em>Curiosity, adaptability, and the desire to learn new technical areas.</em></li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to have — and what would make you exceptional:</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience with computer vision, depth cameras, pose estimation, tracking, or 3D data.</li> <li>Experience with ML model deployment, feature pipelines, evaluation systems, or data quality tools.</li> <li>Experience with streaming data, event systems, real-time processing, or low-latency applications.</li> <li>Experience with numerical methods, signal processing, filtering, state estimation, or robotics.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE</strong></p> <ul> <li>In 6 months time, you understand the main systems, ship reliable changes, and help improve a meaningful data or product workflow. You give valuable technical input towards solving problems across backend, data, and perception systems.</li> <li>In 12 months time, you have made a measurable impact on system reliability, product capability, or data quality. You own important parts of the architecture and help the team make better technical decisions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>WHY CATAPULT? </strong></h4> <ul> <li>We have amazing people. We promise you’ll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.</li> <li>We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. </li> <li>We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.</li> <li>Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  </li> <li>We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.</li> </ul> <p>Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! </p> <p>Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.</p> <p>All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Establish clear ownership and drive flawless follow-through across complex, multi-stakeholder engagements.</li> <li><strong>Evangelize & Enable the Field:</strong> Turn your account experience into scalable workload blueprints, deal patterns, and playbooks. These accounts push products harder and at greater scale than anyone else. Make sure Product hears those signals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years in enterprise technology sales or GTM leadership, with a dedicated focus on strategic/major accounts in developer platforms, cloud computed, or infrastructure companies.</li> <li>Deep Developer Fluency: You understand developer workloads, platform architecture, and infrastructure decision-making, allowing you to engage credibly with CTOs and VPs of Engineering on technical substance, not just commercial terms.</li> <li>Proven Revenue Driver: A documented track record of growing consumption and revenue in large, complex, highly technical accounts over consecutive years.</li> <li>Executive Presence: High credibility with C-level and VP audiences at top-tier technology companies. You are comfortable leading both deep technical discussions and complex business negotiations. </li> <li>Complex Deal Expertise: Extensive experience structuring multi-year commits, consumption-based agreements, successfully navigating engineering, procurement, finance, legal, and security stakeholders. </li> <li>Data-Driven Operator: Highly analytical, comfortable utilizing usage telemetry and Sheets/SQL-level analysis to size opportunities, track account health, and measure impact.</li> <li>Builder’s Mindset: You lead through influence, excel at cross-functional execution without relying on formal hierarchy, and bring strict operational rigor to your GTM motion.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling to or working inside frontier AI labs or AI-native companies.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI infrastructure workloads such as inference, agents, sandboxed code execution, large-scale storage, and globally distributed applications.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with Cloudflare's Developer Platform.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $286,000 - title: DFT Engineer
description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do As DFT Engineer, you will define and own the Design-for-Test strategy of our next-generation SoC from the ground up. This is not a role where you inherit an existing flow, scripts, or team — you build it. You will work closely with RTL design, physical implementation, and our test partners to make our chips manufacturable, testable, and ready for volume production. Required Skills and Experience 10+ years in DFT, with at least one full SoC tape-out owned end-to-end — not just one slice of a large team effort. Strong hands-on experience with one major DFT suite: Siemens Tessent, Synopsys TestMAX / DFTMAX / TetraMAX, or Cadence Modus. Scan insertion and test compression (EDT / DFTMAX / Modus-type). MBIST and memory repair integration. JTAG / IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), IEEE 1500 wrappers. ATPG pattern generation (stuck-at, transition, path delay), coverage analysis and improvement. DFT verification: gate-level simulation of patterns, timing-aware checks. Test-mode SDC / STA understanding. Scripting: Tcl, Python. Experience in silicon bring-up and ATE debug. Language: English at a proficient level. Responsibilities Define DFT architecture and test strategy — coverage targets, test time, pin budget — in collaboration with Siemens experts and our design team. Implement hands-on: scan insertion, compression, MBIST, JTAG/IJTAG/IEEE 1500 wrappers, ATPG, sign-off. Drive DFT verification: gate-level simulation of test patterns and timing-aware checks. Support physical design and STA for test modes — constraints, scan timing closure. Be the bridge between RTL design, physical implementation, and the ATE / test house for silicon bring-up. Deliver patterns to ATE and debug failing patterns with the test house. Contribute to DFT tool evaluation and set up a reusable, scalable flow. Preferred Qualification Experience at advanced nodes (7nm and below). Experience with large AI/HPC or multi-core SoCs, NoC-based designs. Hierarchical DFT on large designs. Has participated in a DFT tool selection or flow setup from scratch. Logic BIST, in-system test, or functional safety (ISO 26262) exposure. Yield analysis and diagnosis (e.g. Tessent Diagnosis, YieldInsight). title: AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other. About the Role As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models. Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work. Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming. Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg. We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes. Requirements At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before. As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor. Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful: Test Driven Development (TDD) Trunk based development Continuous integration Domain Driven Design Nice-to-haves Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase. Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes. We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus. What we offer Become part of an AI revolution! 30 days of paid vacation Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub Mental health support through nilo.health Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket Budget for additional technical equipment Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model JobRad® Bike Lease Note: We welcome applicants at every stage of their career. Your drive and willingness to learn are far more important to us than strict experience requirements. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Executive Assistant – Bilingual English (CDI)

Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information, visit www.mirakl.com . title: Senior Social & AI Marketeer
description: Jouw impact als Senior Social & AI Marketeer Als Senior Social & AI Marketeer bij Indicia ben je het strategische aanspreekpunt voor grote klanten en vertaal je hun commerciële doelstellingen naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën. Je combineert strategisch advies met een hands-on aanpak en ontwikkelt en optimaliseert campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok. Daarbij werk je met grote mediabudgetten en krijg je volop ruimte om impact te maken. AI speelt een belangrijke rol in jouw werk. Je benut slimme tools en automatisering om campagnes, content en processen continu te verbeteren. Daarnaast signaleer je proactief commerciële kansen bij klanten en deel je jouw kennis en ervaring met junior marketeers. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan het succes van klanten, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team en de dienstverlening van Indicia. Over Indicia Indicia is een onafhankelijk tech, data en AI-bureau dat sinds 1996 organisaties helpt om digitaal te groeien. Vanuit de overtuiging dat succesvolle digitale oplossingen beginnen bij een goed begrip van de business, combineert Indicia technologie, data en ondernemerschap om organisaties verder te brengen. Met ruim 250 digitale specialisten biedt Indicia een breed scala aan diensten, waaronder online marketing, webdevelopment, HubSpot, AI en design. Van het ontwikkelen van websites en digitale platforms tot het realiseren van effectieve marketingcampagnes en slimme automatiseringen. Indicia bedient klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en richt zich steeds meer op grotere organisaties en langdurige samenwerkingen. De organisatie bevindt zich in een fase van verdere professionalisering, waarbij de focus ligt op het verdiepen van specialismen, het versterken van de strategische klantrelaties en het realiseren van meetbare resultaten. AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Indicia ontwikkelt eigen AI-tools om processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten, waardoor meer ruimte ontstaat voor strategisch advies, innovatie en klantontwikkeling. De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, familiair en ondernemend. Collega's werken nauw samen, krijgen veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en worden gestimuleerd om zich zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd groeit de ambitie om resultaatgerichter te werken en als organisatie verder te professionaliseren. https://www.indicia.ai/ Jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Ontwikkelen en presenteren van socialmediastrategieën voor grote klanten, waarbij je commerciële doelstellingen vertaalt naar concrete campagnes en meetbare resultaten; Actief bijdragen aan commerciële voorstellen, pitches en pre-salesgesprekken, waarbij je klanten adviseert over de mogelijkheden van social advertising; Fungeren als strategisch en inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, waarbij je periodiek campagneresultaten presenteert en proactief kansen voor upsell en cross-sell signaleert; Zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van paid social campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok, inclusief het bewaken van instellingen, KPI's en budgetten; Analyseren van campagneresultaten, uitvoeren van A/B-testen en continu verbeteren van performance, conversies en rendement; Samenwerken met het interne AI-lab om AI en automatisering slim toe te passen binnen campagnes, contentcreatie, budgetoptimalisatie en werkprocessen; Signaleren en toepassen van nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen social advertising en AI, waarbij je ook de verbinding legt met andere online marketingdisciplines, zoals SEO en SEA; Coachen en begeleiden van junior social marketeers, kennis delen en bijdragen aan hun professionele ontwikkeling; Aanbrengen van structuur, stimuleren van eigenaarschap en bewaken van de kwaliteit binnen het social team. Jouw plek binnen de organisatie: Als ervaren collega ben je een vraagbaak en sparringpartner voor de junior social marketeers. Je deelt je kennis over social en AI, en helpt hen zo verder te groeien. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Sophie Mees, Delivery Manager Online Marketing. Requirements Je bent een enthousiaste en ondernemende persoonlijkheid die energie brengt, initiatief neemt en het team weet mee te nemen in nieuwe ideeën. Je voelt je thuis in een informele en familiaire werkomgeving en draagt met jouw commerciële drive en resultaatgerichte instelling bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met paid social advertising, bij voorkeur binnen een groter marketingbureau, waarbij je gewend bent te werken met aanzienlijke mediabudgetten; Uitgebreide kennis van advertentieplatforms zoals Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok en ervaring met het zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van campagnes; Een analytische instelling en aantoonbare ervaring met campagneanalyse, A/B-testen en performanceoptimalisatie; Een sterke strategische en commerciële blik, waarbij je businessdoelstellingen vertaalt naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën en kansen voor klantgroei signaleert; Ervaring als strategisch gesprekspartner voor klanten op management- en directieniveau, gecombineerd met sterke communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden; Een AI-minded en tech-savvy instelling, waarbij je AI actief inzet voor contentontwikkeling, campagneoptimalisatie en het automatiseren van werkprocessen; Ervaring met het coachen en begeleiden van junior collega's en het delen van vakinhoudelijke kennis; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Benefits Bij Indicia kom je terecht in een informele en ambitieuze werkomgeving waar je de vrijheid krijgt om initiatief te nemen en écht impact te maken. Je werkt voor aansprekende klanten, krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren met de nieuwste AI-tools en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de dienstverlening. Een passend salaris; Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week; 25 vakantiedagen, aangevuld met extra vrije dagen voor gezamenlijke bedrijfsactiviteiten; Arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd; Pensioenregeling 100% bijdrage door werkgever; Reiskostenvergoeding voor zowel auto als openbaar vervoer; Laptop van de zaak (MacBook of Windows); Dagelijks lunch, regelmatig leuke borrels, en de (buitenlands) bedrijfstrip! title: Content Creator / Videograf (m/w/d) – Fußball & Vereinsleben
description: Werkstudententätigkeit, Nebenjob, freie Mitarbeit oder Festanstellung Zeig die Geschichten hinter unseren Stickeralben Eine Mannschaft hält zum ersten Mal ihr eigenes Stickeralbum in den Händen. Kinder entdecken sich auf einem Sticker. Am Spielfeldrand wird getauscht, gesammelt und diskutiert, wer noch fehlt. Genau diese Momente möchten wir zeigen. Wir bei stickerfive entwickeln und produzieren individuelle Stickeralben für den Amateur- und Profisport sowie für Unternehmen und besondere Themenwelten. Für unsere Videos und Social-Media-Inhalte suchen wir Menschen, die solche Geschichten erkennen und mit der Kamera erzählen können. Dabei möchten wir mit mehreren Creatorn in verschiedenen Regionen Deutschlands zusammenarbeiten. Vielleicht begleitest Du einzelne Projekte in Deiner Nähe. Vielleicht suchst Du einen regelmäßigen Nebenjob, eine Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine Festanstellung mit größerem Aufgabenbereich. Schreib uns, was zu Dir passt. Du hast Dich bereits bei uns beworben? Durch ein Versehen bei der Verwaltung sind uns leider einige Bewerbungen verloren gegangen. Wenn Du weiterhin Interesse an einer Zusammenarbeit hast, bewirb Dich bitte noch einmal bei uns. Entschuldige den zusätzlichen Aufwand! Das kannst Du bei uns machen Vereine begleiten: Du besuchst Fotoshootings, Kick-Offs, Verkaufsstarts und Tauschbörsen und fängst die Stimmung vor Ort ein. Content aufnehmen und produzieren: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Ideen für Reels, TikToks und Stories und drehst das passende Material. Wenn Du selbst schneidest, kannst Du fertige Videos liefern. Genauso ist es möglich, uns Deine Aufnahmen zu übergeben, damit unser internes Team Schnitt und Veröffentlichung übernimmt. Menschen zu Wort kommen lassen: Du führst kurze Interviews mit Vereinsmitgliedern, Fans und Verantwortlichen und zeigst, was die Sammelaktion für sie bedeutet. Eigene Formate entwickeln: Ob erste Reaktionen auf die Sticker, Einblicke hinter die Kulissen oder Geschichten aus dem Vereinsleben: Deine Ideen sind gefragt. Projekte eigenständig vorbereiten: Du stimmst Termine und Inhalte mit unserem Team und den Vereinen ab und sorgst dafür, dass aus dem Dreh veröffentlichungsfähiges Material wird. Drehs und Inhalte organisieren: Du stimmst Dich mit unseren Vereinen sowie mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb ab. Du planst Termine und kümmerst Dich rechtzeitig um die Informationen und Materialien, die Du benötigst. Was du mitbringst Du hast bereits Videos oder Social-Media-Inhalte erstellt und kannst uns Beispiele zeigen. Ob für ein Unternehmen, einen Verein, Deinen eigenen Kanal oder ein privates Projekt, ist dabei zweitrangig. Uns interessiert, was Du selbst umgesetzt hast. Außerdem wünschen wir uns: Einen sicheren Umgang mit Smartphone oder Kamera. Ein Gespür für spannende Momente, gute Bildausschnitte und Geschichten aus dem Vereinsleben. Interesse am Sport sowie Freude daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen. Zuverlässigkeit bei Absprachen, Terminen und der Übergabe Deiner Aufnahmen. Bereitschaft zu Drehs vor Ort, je nach Veranstaltung, meistens am Wochenende. Videoschnitt ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wenn Du mit CapCut, Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve arbeitest, kannst Du Deine Aufnahmen selbst schneiden. Du kannst uns aber auch das aufgenommene Material übergeben. Schnitt und Veröffentlichung übernimmt dann unser internes Team. Eine bestimmte Ausbildung, ein Studium oder eine große eigene Followerschaft setzen wir nicht voraus. Erfahrung mit Werbeanzeigen oder Performance Marketing brauchst Du für diese Rolle ebenfalls nicht. So kann unsere Zusammenarbeit aussehen Wir suchen deutschlandweit und möchten ein Netzwerk aus Creatorn aufbauen, die unsere Projekte in ihrer jeweiligen Region begleiten. Du musst deshalb nicht in der Nähe unseres Büros in Gräfelfing bei München wohnen. Je nach Deiner Verfügbarkeit und unserem Bedarf kommen unterschiedliche Formen der Zusammenarbeit infrage: Freie Mitarbeit: Du übernimmst einzelne Drehs oder Projekte auf Honorarbasis. Nebenjob oder Minijob: Du unterstützt uns regelmäßig mit einem überschaubaren Stundenumfang. Werkstudententätigkeit: Du sammelst neben Deinem Studium praktische Erfahrung in der Content-Produktion. Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: Du begleitest regelmäßig unsere Projekte und entwickelst Inhalte und Formate gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter. Welche Aufgaben Du übernimmst und welcher Umfang passt, besprechen wir gemeinsam. Auch wenn Du zunächst nur einzelne Einsätze übernehmen möchtest, kannst Du Dich melden. Die Drehs finden bei unseren Partnervereinen statt. Vorbereitung und gegebenenfalls Schnitt können nach Absprache von zu Hause erfolgen. Vor jedem Einsatz klären wir, welche Aufnahmen wir benötigen und ob Du Rohmaterial oder fertig geschnittene Videos lieferst. Was Dich erwartet Du bekommst Zugang zu Geschichten aus dem Amateur- und Profisport und kannst eigene Ideen direkt umsetzen. Unser Team unterstützt Dich bei der Abstimmung mit den Vereinen und stellt Dir die nötigen Informationen zu den Projekten bereit. Vergütung, Ausstattung und mögliche Reisekosten klären wir passend zur jeweiligen Zusammenarbeit vorab. Bei regelmäßigen Einsätzen planen wir gemeinsam, welche Termine mit Deinem Studium, Hauptjob oder anderen Projekten vereinbar sind. Zeig uns, was Du machst Schick uns einen kurzen Überblick über Dich und ein paar Arbeitsproben. Besonders interessieren uns Videos oder Aufnahmen, die Du selbst gemacht hast. Sie müssen nicht fertig geschnitten sein. Bei gemeinsamen Produktionen schreib bitte dazu, welchen Teil Du übernommen hast. Sag uns außerdem: Wo Du wohnst und in welcher Region Du Drehs übernehmen kannst. Welche Form der Zusammenarbeit und welchen zeitlichen Umfang Du suchst. Ob Du Deine Aufnahmen auch selbst schneiden möchtest. Ob Du lieber hinter der Kamera arbeitest oder auch selbst davor stehen möchtest. Wann Du starten könntest und welche Vergütung Du Dir vorstellst. Bewirb Dich direkt hier über die Plattform. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Arbeiten und darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: People Operations Specialist, Tokyo (12-months contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What You Would Do Here:</strong></p> <p>Our focus is getting the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented People Operations Specialist to join our team and champion this mission within the APJC region. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for our employees, ensuring their journey is smooth and positive. You will be instrumental in creating a seamless experience by resolving inquiries, managing data with precision, and ensuring our People processes are efficient and effective. This is an exciting opportunity to provide exceptional support to our internal teams and contribute to building a world-class employee experience as our organization expands.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Champion key employee lifecycle process:</strong> Take ownership of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes across APJC, including onboarding, internal transfers, organizational changes, and offboarding, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and positive experience for employees throughout the APJC region.</li> <li><strong>Be a subject-matter expert for employee inquiries:</strong> Provide timely, high-quality support to employee inquiries through Zendesk. Act as a trusted liaison between employees and People/Payroll teams, resolving issues efficiently with empathy and accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the employee experience through cross-functional collaboration:</strong> Act as a proactive liaison between employees and specialized teams such as Payroll, Benefits, and Legal to address and resolve complex issues efficiently and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Ensure data integrity and governance: </strong>Maintain and update employee records across People/Payroll systems, performing regular and ad hoc audits to guarantee 100% data accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements.</li> <li><strong>Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence:</strong> Analyze employee feedback and process metrics to identify opportunities for process enhancements. Partner with regional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve the overall People Operations function across APJC.</li> <li><strong>Support strategic HR initiatives and projects:</strong> Contribute to HR system implementations, vendor management, and regional programs such as annual performance and compensation cycles, benefits enrollment, and year-end Payroll preparation, making them easy to understand and navigate for our employees.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills/experience</strong> </p> <ul> <li>2+ years in HR administration and comfortable handling sensitive employee information with discretion.</li> <li>Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills. </li> <li>Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.</li> <li>Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.</li> <li>Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.</li> <li>Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.</li> <li>Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job.
