title: Senior Sales Operations Manager (South EMEA)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p>As a Senior Sales Operations Manager, you will support the EMEA South Go-To-Market team as a trusted advisor to sales leaders, enabling consistent, predictable, and repeatable hyper-growth through sales discipline, streamlined processes, and a strong operating cadence. You will partner with the EMEA South Leadership Team on GTM design, business analysis, and metrics while managing the day-to-day rhythm of the business, with field productivity as your north star. This role is based in Amsterdam, Prague, or Milan, and is ideal for someone who wants to be an active voice driving change rather than a passive spectator.</p> <h3>What Will You Do?</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Serve as the EMEA South Operations Lead and trusted advisor to key sales leaders, actively participating in the EMEA forecasting process, advising on changing pipeline dynamics, and challenging forecasts to ensure accuracy, predictability, and transparency.</li> <li>Manage Area business metrics including performance, trends, headcount, and investment models, and lead the development of key sales metrics and business review materials, monitoring performance and taking action to optimize business results.</li> <li>Drive the annual sales planning process, including Area, Regional, and District goal assignments, territory management updates, and sales compensation plan changes.</li> <li>Identify gaps in the infrastructure needed to support Sales and develop solutions, with a strong focus on AI, that align to the team’s overall vision, while educating and training teams on key sales processes.</li> <li>Act as an active voice that drives change with Area leadership, and align with the Global Revenue Operations team to represent the needs of the field.</li> </ul> <h3>What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?</h3> <p>Ideal candidates will have:</p> <ul> <li>7 to 10 years of experience in Sales, Revenue, or Field Operations supporting sales teams, with a strong emphasis on enabling teams to be hyper-productive, ideally within organizations selling subscription security software.</li> <li>Experience designing and scaling processes that support a hyper-growth business model, including documenting key processes in a publicly traded environment.</li> <li>Proven analytical ability to turn disparate datasets into insightful analytics, including developing messaging, data visualizations, and executive-level presentations.</li> <li>Solid experience with a key tech stack including Salesforce, Clari, Tableau, MS Office, G-Suite, and AI tools.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence sales teams, build collaborative relationships across functions, and translate the complex needs of the field. A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Management, Technology, or Economics is required, and an MBA is a plus.</li> </ul> <h3>Why SentinelOne?</h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity & Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off & Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance & Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Insurance and medical allowance</li> <li>Pension scheme</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks & Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Commuter or work-from-home allowance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellness & Lifestyle</strong></p> <ul> <li>Wellness benefit</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles. </span></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our <a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt53c99b43892c2378/bltca86b3b84e902400/AI-in-Hiring-SentinelOne.pdf">AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Embedded Android Engineer- Hardware
description: Team description SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads. What you'll do Support system bring-up for the new Android embedded platform, from bootloader through to kernel and framework Integrate and maintain kernel modules and drivers, including power management and connectivity components Contribute to build system integration across the platform Debug hardware and software issues at the protocol level and help resolve critical issues found during testing Carry out testing and validation to confirm the platform is stable and secure before release You'll be great for this role if… Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional setting Strong knowledge of the Android OS architecture, from bootloader (U-Boot, Little Kernel) and kernel through to framework and services Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage Comfort working with Qualcomm Snapdragon or MediaTek platforms, and expert-level C programming for embedded Linux environments Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days 🌈 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 38 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. title: Director, Alliances EMEA (GSI) (m/f/d)
description: About the job We are looking for a sales-oriented Alliance & Channel Professional with experience and expertise in cybersecurity to lead, expand, and manage Onapsis' Global Systems Integrator (GSI) partner ecosystem across EMEA. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of building, driving, and scaling joint go-to-market strategies with top-tier GSIs and global consulting firms, specifically Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, Capgemini , IBM. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping our EMEA GSI alliance as a major commercial growth engine - translating partner relationships into co-sell pipeline, deal velocity, and measurable revenue contribution across European markets. The Director, Alliances EMEA (GSI) will work closely with Onapsis field sales teams, regional leadership, and partner practice leads to align partner-led activities to the company's strategic goals. What you will be doing, your legacy: Lead and coordinate all commercial, executive, and business development aspects of Onapsis' strategic GSI alliance partners across EMEA (Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, CAPGemini, IBM), facilitating joint planning and aligning resources internally and externally. Build a portfolio of joint solution offerings and repeatable use cases with GSI partners, embedding Onapsis into partner-led SAP digital transformation practices (S/4HANA migrations, RISE with SAP) and driving GTM execution. Drive and manage partner-sourced and partner-influenced co-sell pipelines with GSI partners and Onapsis field sales teams, tracked and managed through Salesforce CRM. Enable partner-led implementation and managed services delivery models (MSSP / QuickStart packages), maximizing GSI service revenue opportunities around Onapsis platform deployments. Coordinate and execute joint marketing initiatives, executive roundtables, and ABM campaigns with GSI partner marketing teams across target EMEA regions. Contract negotiations Required Skills and Experience: 7+ years of experience in enterprise software sales, business development, or alliance management at a cybersecurity or enterprise software company, with at least 5+ years directly managing GSIs (Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, CAPGemini, IBM) across EMEA. Deep existing network and executive relationships within the cybersecurity and SAP practices of major GSIs across key EMEA markets (UK&I, DACH, France, Nordics). Proven track record of building joint GTM playbooks and driving partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline in co-sell models. Expertise and acumen in forging initiatives, go-to-market and pipeline development plans with business partners. Experience in selling in an overlay role in conjunction with field sales teams Familiarity with the SAP ecosystem (S/4HANA migrations, RISE with SAP, SAP BTP) and partner-led services delivery frameworks. Past relationships with top national and regional VARs Demonstrated success in exceeding revenue targets with partners Exceptional communication skills (both verbal and written). Able to position technical solutions as business value to 'owners' of Security Services offering portfolio in partner organizations. Experience with Solution Selling/Consultative Selling methodologies. Delivery of comprehensive business plans with a multi-year outlook. Strong analytical competencies and ability to communicate and present at an executive level. Self-disciplined team player that can work in a fast-paced dynamic start-up environment remotely. B.S. or equivalent experience. Masters or MBA a plus. Location: Remote in Germany. title: Member of Technical Staff - Safety
description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why this role FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards. As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world. What you'll work on Develop mid- and post-training safety methods for FLUX models, such as safety SFT, preference optimization and RL with safety rewards, and concept erasure. Build safety data filtering that runs at pretraining scale: classifiers and pipelines that screen billions of images, video clips and captions, with measured Pareto frontiers and precision/recall trade-offs. Make safety hold up for open-weight releases, including robustness to adversarial prompts and to downstream fine-tuning. Extend safety to the text side of the stack: prompts, captions and the text encoders that condition our models. Design evaluations and red-teaming that measure harmful generations alongside image quality and prompt following, so safety gains don't come at the cost of performance. Work directly with pretraining and post-training teams so your methods land in the release model, and publish where it makes sense. What we're looking for Hands-on research experience in visual safety: safety of text-to-image, text-to-video or vision-language models, such as harm classifiers, safe generation methods or safety benchmarks. Proven experience in at least one of: Large-scale safety data filtering: building and running classifiers or filtering pipelines over hundreds of millions of samples or more. Safety mid- or post-training: safety SFT, DPO or RL with safety objectives, or unlearning applied to large generative models. Deep familiarity with concept erasure methods (e.g. ESD, UCE, adversarial unlearning) and their failure modes, such as concept recovery and collateral damage to unrelated concepts. Track record of shipping: top-venue publications (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV) paired with production impact, or unambiguous production wins at a frontier lab. Experience with distributed training at multi-node scale. Strong PyTorch fluency; you write research code that others can build on. You work fluently with coding agents to move faster, and have the depth to verify their output and own the result. Experience running multi-agent workflows: you know which tasks to hand off and which to keep yourself, and you use the speed-up to raise the quality bar, not lower it. We'd be especially excited if you: Know how to keep safety intact after release, when others fine-tune open weights. Have tackled safety for video generation, where harm can emerge across frames rather than in any single frame. Bring experience with audio safety, especially for jointly generated audio and video, where each modality can amplify harm in the other. Have unlearned concepts from text encoders or built safety-tuned encoders (e.g. Safe-CLIP-style approaches). Have worked on text safety: LLM safety tuning, prompt and jailbreak defenses, or text safety classifiers, ideally across languages. Have applied latent-space safety methods, such as activation steering or safe guidance. Have built VLM-based safety judges or guard models for filtering or evaluation. How we work together We're a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You'll join us in Freiburg at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week). We'll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we've structured things to make it accessible to all. We'll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process. Everything we do is grounded in four values: Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful. Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task. Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect. Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos. We are seeking a talented Thermo-Mechanical Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines, with a focus on the main thrust chamber assembly. Key Responsibilities Support structural and thermal analysis of combustion device hardware including injector heads, faceplates, combustion chambers, manifolds, and structural interfaces. Perform finite element analysis (FEA) and establish practical design suggestions and establish design recommendations, and margin assessments for hardware development. Develop and apply analytical and reduced-order models to estimate heat transfer, structural loads, and thermal boundary conditions to inform design trades and hardware maturation. Support hardware development and maturation, including design iteration, development planning, test definition, and post-test assessment of structural and thermal performance. Drive life assessment activities, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, margin tracking, and damage accumulation for reusable hardware. Own structural reliability and lifecycle assessments of combustion hardware, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, and thermo-mechanical failure risk evaluation. Collaborate with combustion and fluid engineers to translate predicted heat flux distributions, pressure fields, and flow characteristics into structural and thermal design requirements Define structural and thermal instrumentation strategies for development testing and participate post-test data reduction, model validation, and correlation activities. Contribute to material selection and design trades considering temperature capability, strength, fatigue resistance, oxidation compatibility, and cryogenic behavior. Prepare technical documentation and contribute to design, and test reviews with clear technical justification and risk assessment. What we would love to see from you Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience (academic, internship, or professional) in structural or thermal analysis of high-performance mechanical systems. Strong fundamentals in solid mechanics, heat transfer, and pressure-loaded structures. Experience with FEA tools such as ANSYS, NASTRAN, Abaqus, or equivalent. Ability to interpret complex thermal and pressure boundary conditions and apply them appropriately in structural models. Understanding of fatigue, temperature-dependent material behavior, and nonlinear structural response. Exposure to high-temperature or cryogenic systems is advantageous. Familiarity with CAD (NX ideally) tools and ability to work directly with geometry. Experience with Python or similar scripting tools for analysis automation or data processing is beneficial. Skills and Behaviours Methodical and structured approach to problem solving. Strong attention to detail and analytical rigor. Clear written and verbal communication of technical rationale. Ability to iterate analyses as design and test data evolve. Interest in propulsion systems and combustion device development. title: Interim Senior Community Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues. What you’ll be doing You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline. The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues. You’ll be: Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline. Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch. Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers. Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand. Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social. Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them. Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off. Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts. Dann suchen wir genau Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als: Ingenieur:in Qualitätssicherung Wohnungsneubau (w/m/d) im Großraum Hamburg | Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 32 Stunden pro Woche Als Mitarbeiter:in in der Qualitätssicherung im Bauwesen betreust Du eigenverantwortlich Bauprojekte unserer Auftraggeber im Bereich Hochbau. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Neubau und Sanierung von Wohnraum. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit den Projektleiter:innen der Bauherren zusammen und stehst ihnen beratend zur Seite. Die Stelle ist in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 32 Stunden pro Woche zu besetzen. Die sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH ist seit über 25 Jahren erfolgreich am Markt tätig und verfügt über ein erfahrenes Team von 25 Mitarbeitenden. In dieser Zeit hat das Unternehmen bereits über 2.500 Projekte erfolgreich begleitet. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Tätigkeit als Sicherheits- und Gesundheitsschutzkoordinator auf Baustellen. Deine Aufgaben: Qualitätssicherung auf der Baustelle Bauvorhaben im Bereich Qualitätssicherung betreust Du eigenverantwortlich und sorgst für die Einhaltung der vereinbarten Qualitätsstandards. Hochbauprojekte mit Schwerpunkt auf Neubau und Sanierung von Wohnraum begleitest Du während der relevanten Bauphasen. Regelmäßige Baustellenbegehungen führst Du eigenständig durch und überprüfst die Qualität der ausgeführten Arbeiten. Deine Begehungen und Prüfergebnisse dokumentierst Du strukturiert und nachvollziehbar. Prüfung & Beratung Relevante Projektunterlagen wie Leistungsverzeichnisse prüfst Du sorgfältig im Hinblick auf die Qualitätssicherung. Weitere qualitätsrelevante Unterlagen sichtest und bewertest Du im Rahmen Deiner Projektbetreuung. Die Projektleiter:innen der Bauherren berätst Du fachlich zu Fragen der Qualitätssicherung und möglichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen. Projektspezifische Prüfergebnisse besprichst Du mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen und unterstützt bei der Abstimmung weiterer Schritte. Kunden- & Projektmanagement Mit den Projektleiter:innen der Bauherren stimmst Du Dich regelmäßig ab und sorgst für eine transparente Kommunikation. Die Zusammenarbeit mit den beteiligten Planer:innen koordinierst Du und stellst einen reibungslosen Informationsaustausch sicher. Mit ausführenden Unternehmen und weiteren Projektbeteiligten arbeitest Du eng zusammen und klärst offene Fragen zur Qualitätssicherung. Deine Projekte organisierst und steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich und behältst dabei Termine, Anforderungen und Qualitätsziele im Blick. Deine Startvoraussetzungen: Das bringst Du mit: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich beziehungsweise eine Qualifikation als öffentlich bestellte:r und vereidigte:r oder zertifizierte:r Bausachverständige:r bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage. Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Qualitätssicherung, Bauleitung oder Bauüberwachung im Wohnungsneubau bringst Du mit. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau in Wort und Schrift ermöglichen Dir eine sichere Kommunikation mit allen Projektbeteiligten. Eine eigenverantwortliche und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Kommunikationsstärke, sichere Microsoft-Office-Kenntnisse sowie die Bereitschaft zu regionalen Außendiensteinsätzen runden Dein Profil ab. Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein: Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Hochbauprojekten wäre von Vorteil. Kenntnisse im Neubau und in der Sanierung von Wohnraum sind wünschenswert. Praktische Erfahrung in der Prüfung von Leistungsverzeichnissen und weiteren Projektunterlagen wäre ein Plus. Erfahrung in der Beratung von Bauherren und der Abstimmung mit unterschiedlichen Projektbeteiligten würde Dir den Einstieg erleichtern. Unsere Benefits: Attraktive Vergütung & Urlaub: Je nach Erfahrung liegt das Bruttojahresgehalt zwischen 65.000 und 75.000 Euro. Dich erwarten außerdem 30 Tage Jahresurlaub. Flexibles & familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld: Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, keine Schichtarbeit sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten. Mobilität & Zusatzleistungen: Fahrtkostenerstattung, Poolfahrzeug, JobRad und Deutschlandticket. Ein Dienstwagen ist bei Vollzeit möglich, auch zur privaten Nutzung; in diesem Fall reduziert sich das Jahresgehalt um etwa 10.000 Euro. Zusätzlich bieten wir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Onboarding & moderne Ausstattung: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding begleitet Deinen Einstieg. Für Deine tägliche Arbeit erhältst Du ein Arbeits-Smartphone und einen Arbeitslaptop. Teamkultur & Weiterentwicklung: Dich erwartet ein kollegiales Team mit flachen Hierarchien sowie regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Außerdem bieten wir Dir eine zukunftssichere Beschäftigung in einem regional verwurzelten Dienstleistungsunternehmen. Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Kurzes Telefonat mit dem Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe. Interview mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen der sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH. Hospitation/persönliches Kennenlernen mit dem Team aus dem Fachbereich der sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH. Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung! Du erreichst das Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe unter Werde Teil unserer spannenden Reise bei der sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH - Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Die sigeko-Ingenieure GmbH ist Teil der Arsipa Gruppe, einer schnell wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-and-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel ist es, eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt zu werden – unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. title: Business Development & Growth Intern
description: Über Valova Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser , die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient. Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern. Deine Rolle Du berichtest direkt an unseren Strategy & Business Development Lead. In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du aktiv mit, wie Valova den Klinikmarkt erschließt und nachhaltig wächst. Du identifizierst und qualifizierst relevante Kliniken, entwickelst gezielte Ansätze für unseren Outreach, eröffnest erste Gespräche und bringst potenzielle Kunden in unsere Demotermine. Gleichzeitig arbeitest Du eng mit dem Team an strategischen Initiativen im kommerziellen Bereich. Das reicht von der Weiterentwicklung unserer Go-to-Market-Strategie über neue Vertriebskanäle und Partnerschaften bis hin zur Optimierung unserer Sales-Prozesse. Darüber hinaus baust Du unsere operative Infrastruktur mit auf. Deine Aufgaben Neue Kliniken und Marktpotenziale erschließen: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Kliniken, von privaten Klinikgruppen über kommunale und ländliche Häuser bis hin zu Unikliniken. Du recherchierst die relevanten Entscheider:innen in Geschäftsführung, Finanzen, Medizincontrolling und Kodierung und qualifizierst neue Marktpotenziale. Gezielte Kundenansprache entwickeln: Du konzipierst und steuerst Outreach-Kampagnen über Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail. Du entwickelst zielgruppenspezifische Ansprachekonzepte und eröffnest erste Gespräche mit potenziellen Kunden. Unsere kommerzielle Strategie weiterentwickeln: Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Go-to-Market-Strategie und analysierst Markt- und Wettbewerbspotenziale. Außerdem arbeitest Du an strategischen Initiativen rund um neue Vertriebskanäle, Partnerschaften und kommerzielle Wachstumsfelder. Skalierbare Sales-Strukturen aufbauen: Du entwickelst unser CRM, unsere Outreach-Sequenzen und unsere Sales-Playbooks weiter und etablierst aussagekräftige Dashboards. Mit KI neue Möglichkeiten schaffen: Du identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale und setzt KI-gestützte Workflows für Recherche, Datenanreicherung und Outreach um. Vertriebsprozesse aktiv mitgestalten: Du entwickelst SOPs und interne Prozesse weiter. Was Du mitbringst Studium: Du studierst oder hast Dein Studium abgeschlossen, zum Beispiel in BWL, VWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Medizin oder einem vergleichbaren Fach. Erste Erfahrung: Du hast bereits erste relevante Berufserfahrung in Vertrieb, Business Development oder Strategieberatung gesammelt. Offen und kommunikativ: Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und hast keine Scheu vor Telefonaten. Auch nach einem „Nein“ bleibst Du motiviert und freundlich. Strukturiert und sicher im Umgang mit Zahlen: Du arbeitest gerne mit Daten und bist fit in Excel. Erste Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Pipedrive, ist ein Plus. Interesse an KI: Du nutzt gerne KI-Tools und hast Lust, neue Möglichkeiten auszuprobieren und Prozesse zu automatisieren. Sprachen: Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und fließend Englisch. Arbeitsort: München. Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Was wir Dir bieten Verantwortung von Anfang an: Du übernimmst eigene Aufgaben und Projekte und bringst Deine Ideen ein. Du siehst direkt, welchen Beitrag Deine Arbeit zum Wachstum von Valova leistet. Schnell lernen und viel bewegen: Du bekommst früh Verantwortung und arbeitest an unterschiedlichen Themen. So sammelst Du praktische Erfahrung in einem stark wachsenden Health-Tech-Start-up. Einblick in Strategie und Vertrieb: Du arbeitest nicht nur im Tagesgeschäft. Du gestaltest auch strategische Themen mit, etwa unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie, neue Partnerschaften und den Ausbau unserer Vertriebsstrukturen. Ein Team mitten in der Stadt: Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort im WeWork am Odeonsplatz in München und im WeWork in Berlin-Mitte. Dich erwarten moderne Büros mit Kaffee, Meetingräumen und Phone Booths sowie zahlreiche Lunch-Spots direkt um die Ecke. title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Discovery
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <div class="container"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ccb59069932b9a6f" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color stronger tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains <strong>Readable</strong>, <strong>Discoverable</strong>, and <strong>Callable</strong> for autonomous AI agents.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP and MCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences.</p> <p>We are a cross functional group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as a technical anchor and become a subject matter expert on our Agentic Discovery team. In this role, you will define the architecture, core protocols, and multi-team standards powering the next generation of agent-web interactions.</p> <p>As a senior technical leader, you will shape product roadmaps, mentor engineers across Cloudflare, and write technical specifications that drive execution across multiple teams. You will drive engineering excellence across edge infrastructure, data pipelines, protocol layers, and developer tooling, ensuring systems are resilient and complexity is reduced for your peers.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Architect and ship high-throughput, resilient production services </strong>that make web properties Readable (structured content transformation), Discoverable (indexing and AEO), and Callable (WebMCP, tool-calling APIs, Generative UI) for autonomous agents.</li> <li><strong>Define emerging agent protocols and integrations</strong> (MCP, MCP Apps, UCP, MPP, WebMCP). Author architectural specifications and technical designs that guide engineering work both within and outside the ETI team.</li> <li><strong>Partner directly with Product Management, customers and stakeholders</strong> to translate customer needs into technical requirements, clarify KPIs, and shape engineering roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Drive improvements in system health and observability. </strong>Lead complex incident responses, conduct post-incident retrospectives, and rearchitect systems to eliminate failure modes and minimize customer-escalation issues.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the engineering process across Cloudflare</strong> through code reviews, technical mentorship, architectural governance, and candidate evaluation for engineering hiring.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing scalable system architecture and setting performance metrics in a distributed environment.</li> <li>Experience writing technical specifications and leading cross-functional technical initiatives to completion.</li> <li>Deep understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, caching, web security, and performance bottlenecks spanning multi-service architectures.</li> <li>Hands-on experience and deep conceptual understanding of AI agents, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or agent harnesses.</li> <li>Ability to partner with product managers and customers to navigate ambiguous problem spaces and iteratively deliver large-scale architecture.</li> <li>Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers, contributing to hiring, and driving improvements to engineering processes and incident response workflows.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Fluency in async Rust or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Cloudflare Workers) at scale.</li> <li>Active contributions to or leadership in open-source agent frameworks, protocols (e.g., MCP), web standards bodies, browser engines, or network proxies.</li> <li>Track record of resolving complex, multi-team production incidents and driving post-mortem recommendations to completion.</li> <li>Background in search engines, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), web crawling at scale, or RAG platform engineering.</li> <li>Expertise in cryptographic protocols (public-key encryption, digital signatures) or privacy-preserving web architectures.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p><strong>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="1">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €91,000.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Incident Response Engineer, SIRT
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Team Mission</strong></p> <p>The Security Incident Response Team’s mission is to systematically respond to security threats safeguarding Cloudflare. We operate 24/7 across the globe to respond to security incidents, continuously improve our response capabilities, lead digital investigations and enhance our overall security posture. Our “Cloudflare on Cloudflare”, data and automation first philosophy makes us a cohesive team with high impact. </p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>This intermediate Security Engineer role on the Security Response Team (SIRT) focuses on leading security incidents and engineering scalable response capabilities across enterprise security,vulnerability response, insider threat and privacy incidents. Incident command is a core responsibility, requiring coordination of technical investigations, containment, remediation, and stakeholder communications. This role collaborates with IT, Engineering, Product, Product Security, Detection Engineering, Privacy, and Legal teams, leveraging programming, security telemetry, and AI-powered tools to improve response effectiveness. It requires clear communication of technical findings and business impact, alongside participation in a shared on-call rotation with rotating weekend and holiday shifts.<br><br><strong>This role requires full time work over the Weekends. Candidates should be comfortable working with a Tuesday - Saturday or Sunday - Thursday 5-day working week schedule and on call rotations.</strong></p> <p><strong>Responsibilities </strong></p> <p><strong>Security Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee security event triage, validation, and response workflows, ensuring timely investigation of high-priority alerts and security anomalies.</li> <li>Collaborate with detection engineers and threat intelligence teams to refine investigative signals and improve security visibility.</li> <li>Maintain incident management processes, ensuring incidents are properly categorized, documented, and escalated as needed.</li> <li>Perform continuous operational improvements, such as tuning detection rules, optimizing log ingestion, and enhancing alert enrichment pipelines.</li> <li>Conduct security gap analysis, identifying weaknesses in monitoring coverage and recommending solutions to enhance detection and response capabilities.</li> <li>Work closely with engineering and infrastructure teams to improve log collection, normalization, and visibility across diverse environments.</li> <li>Ensure adherence to incident response playbooks, compliance standards, and security best practices (e.g., CISA, GDPR, NIST, ISO 27001).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Incident Investigation & Threat Hunting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead forensic investigations into intrusions, insider threats, APTs, and account compromises.</li> <li>Perform log analysis, correlation, and anomaly detection across endpoint, network, and cloud telemetry.</li> <li>Use Python, SQL, and data engineering techniques to extract insights from large-scale logs, identifying attacker TTPs and movement across environments.</li> <li>Investigate real-time security incidents, working closely with detection teams to validate alerts and escalate threats.</li> <li>Conduct post-incident analysis to determine root causes, document findings, and recommend mitigation strategies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Monitoring & Continuous Threat Analysis</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee security monitoring operations, ensuring alert triage, enrichment, and validation align with investigative workflows.</li> <li>Optimize SIEM queries, log ingestion pipelines, and case management systems to improve threat visibility.</li> <li>Develop playbooks and workflows to streamline investigations and reduce manual effort in repetitive tasks.</li> <li>Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for effective response to security alerts and ongoing monitoring.</li> <li>Collaborate with the Detection Engineering team to refine detection rules and investigative signals based on real-world attack patterns.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Engineering & Automation for Investigations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engineer automated solutions to enhance investigation efficiency, such as log parsing scripts, data enrichment tools, and case correlation frameworks.</li> <li>Build log analysis pipelines for efficient parsing, enrichment, and correlation of multi-source security data.</li> <li>Develop custom detection logic for brute-force attempts, lateral movement, and anomaly-based intrusion detection.</li> <li>Automate threat intelligence enrichment, real-time event processing, and security data visualization.</li> <li>Engineer scalable solutions for PCAP analysis, network flow monitoring, and cloud security event detection.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Forensic Analysis & Threat Intelligence Correlation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform disk, memory, and network forensics to uncover hidden indicators of compromise (IOCs) and attacker behaviors.</li> <li>Correlate multi-source logs (firewall, EDR, web, authentication logs, cloud telemetry) to reconstruct attack chains and identify attacker footholds.</li> <li>Analyze network traffic to detect exfiltration attempts, lateral movement, and suspicious patterns.</li> <li>Use threat intelligence tooling (opencti) to enrich investigations and automate IOC processing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Must-Have Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in incident response, security operations, and forensic analysis</li> <li>Proven ability to lead crisis situations, make data-driven security decisions, and drive technical and operational improvements.</li> <li>Strong expertise in incident management, root cause analysis, and forensic investigation methodologies.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with SIEM (SQL, ELK, etc), SOAR, and EDR  for real-time security monitoring and response.</li> <li>Experience managing large-scale security incidents, ensuring effective escalation, resolution, and business alignment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of threat intelligence, attacker tactics (MITRE ATT&CK), and real-world attack chains.</li> <li>Familiarity with SOAR platforms and security case management automation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Certifications: GCFA, GNFA, GREM, GCIH, or equivalent forensic/security certifications.</li> <li>Experience in Red Teaming, Threat Intelligence, or Malware Analysis.</li> <li>Understanding of cloud-native security monitoring (AWS, GCP, Azure).</li> </ul> <p><br><strong><em>Due to this position having access to controlled technology and systems, US export title: Senior Software Engineer, Customs
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Customs Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.</p> <p>That’s where we come in. The <strong>Customs Technology team</strong> at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.</p> <h2>The opportunity: </h2> <p>Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.</p> <p>Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.</p> <p><strong>Things we ❤️</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way</li> <li>Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows</li> <li>Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform</li> <li>Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.</li> <li>Work on systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities and the process of moving cargo in and out of countries.</li> <li>Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.</li> <li>Geek out about shipping, customs regulations and logistics. (We do this often.)</li> <li>Figure out the most efficient way for our customers and partners to participate in the process of moving freight across borders.</li> <li>Design and build deep, complex integrations with government agencies and partners.</li> <li>Automate archaic customs filing processes and save the operations team thousands of phone calls per week.</li> <li>Deliver supply chain insights to logistics teams via a world-class analytics experience.</li> <li>Create beautiful and efficient domain models for the incredibly complex world of freight forwarding.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You should have:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>≥ 5 years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.</li> <li>The ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business partners, product managers, designers and engineers alike.</li> <li>A bias for action. When you see a problem, you solve it.</li> <li>A desire to develop your tooling repertoire. We are tech-agnostic regarding candidate background, but our platform is built with Ruby.</li> <li>Non-optional: an aptitude for learning quickly.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How we work:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>We come to the office at two to three times a week to hang out, have lunch, white board, and collaborate</li> <li>We have the latest and greatest hardware and software for you to work with</li> <li>We’re agile, but not married to a single doctrine like scrum. The teams decide how they work best.</li> <li>Stack: we’re coming from a React/Flow + Ruby on Rails monolith, and moving to React/Typescript, Kotlin Microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love GraphQL, GRPC, Postgres, Kafka and Snowflake</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's in it for you?</strong></p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment </li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis </li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam</li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. </li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme</li> <li>Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members</li> <li>Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-onsite</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <h4>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants</h4> <p>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at <a href="http://www.flexport.com/privacy" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.flexport.com/privacy&source=gmail&ust=1613840050053000&usg=AFQjCNHD63svlkD-hWHlGuGOM_bSYVrnpw">www.flexport.com/privacy</a> for additional information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Licensing Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.</p> <p>At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.</p></div><p>As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Licensing Manager – UEFA will play a critical role in strategically growing and leading the UEFA Masterlicense business unit.</p> <p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>The Senior Licensing Manager – UEFA serves as the senior lead for the UEFA Masterlicense business, owning client and licensee relationships while ensuring operational and financial objectives are met with precision and efficiency. This role partners closely with senior leadership to develop and execute strategic licensing plans that maximize revenue, position client brands appropriately, and identify new business opportunities across the European licensing landscape. The Director, Licensing – UEFA delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT</strong></p> <p><strong>Team & Leadership Impact</strong> (Build Championship Teams)</p> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Communicate division strategy clearly across licensing, legal, finance, and operations teams to ensure cohesive execution against the UEFA Masterlicense program's goals and objectives.</li> <li>Partner with senior leadership to report key business results to corporate officers and align divisional priorities with enterprise-wide strategic initiatives.</li> <li>Coordinate with Finance on royalty reporting and royalty accounting, and with Legal on contract drafting and negotiation, ensuring seamless cross-functional delivery.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>People Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and direct the UEFA licensing business unit, setting performance goals for direct reports and providing ongoing evaluation against the group's objectives.</li> <li>Develop team members through clear expectations, coaching, and alignment to BOLD leadership principles to build a high-performing licensing organization.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Fan & Customer Impact</strong> (Obsessed with Fans)</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain meaningful, trust-based relationships with UEFA and all licensing clients, key stakeholders, business partners, and strategic alliances to advance each client's licensing program.</li> <li>Maintain an in-depth working knowledge of all Fanatics Licensing Management (FLM) clients to proactively anticipate needs and deliver consistently high levels of service.</li> <li>Oversee day-to-day management of client licensing programs — including contract negotiation and royalty reporting — ensuring clients receive accurate, timely, and strategic partnership support.</li> <li>Represent FLM at industry licensing trade shows and participate in business sessions with leading licensees to strengthen relationships and elevate the Fanatics brand in the European market.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Innovation & Problem Solving</strong> (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)</p> <ul> <li>Assist in identifying new business opportunities that align with high-quality business strategies and support both short-term and long-term objectives of the UEFA licensing program.</li> <li>Work with the senior leadership team to develop and implement innovative strategic licensing plans that position client brands competitively and maximize licensing revenue.</li> <li>Continuously evaluate operational and logistics processes within the licensing business unit, identifying improvements that drive greater efficiency and effectiveness.</li> <li>Stay connected to industry trends and competitive dynamics in the European sports licensing landscape, bringing forward-thinking perspectives to client and business strategy.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ownership & Execution</strong> (Determined & Relentless Mindset)</p> <ul> <li>Own the day-to-day management of the P&L for the UEFA licensing business unit, ensuring the division achieves its strategic and financial objectives.</li> <li>Oversee the development of annual reports for clients, delivering accurate and insightful performance summaries that inform future licensing strategy.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Manage competing priorities and complex stakeholder relationships simultaneously, operating with exceptional attention to detail and a self-starter mindset in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Take full accountability for divisional results, driving a culture of relentless execution and continuous improvement across all licensing operations.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY</strong></p> <p>We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:</p> <ul> <li>Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes</li> <li>Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance</li> <li>Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working</li> <li>Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in the licensing industry, with demonstrated expertise in managing licensing programs, client relationships, and contractual obligations.</li> <li>5+ years of experience in customer and client relations, with a proven ability to build and sustain strategic partnerships at a senior level.</li> <li>3+ years of management experience, including directing teams and evaluating performance against defined business objectives.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage a business unit P&L and deliver against financial and strategic targets.</li> <li>Experience in contract negotiation and working cross-functionally with Legal and Finance teams on licensing agreements and royalty processes.</li> <li>Motivated self-starter with the ability to excel at multi-tasking in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment, with exceptional attention to detail.</li> <li>Proficient in Microsoft Office; strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present key results to senior and corporate leadership.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Education:</strong></p> <p>Bachelor's degree required.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>WORK LOCATION</strong></p> <p>On-site: Your work location will be onsite in Paris or Manchester.</p> <p>At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset—We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined & Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.</em><br><br><strong><em>ABOUT US</em></strong></p> <p><em>Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. title: Senior Compliance Manager & Information Security Officer (ISO) (f/m/d)
description: Become a Part of Accurids Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! At Accurids, we build the data backbone behind life-science innovation. As we grow with our pharma customers, we are creating a dedicated role for compliance. You will own our compliance programme, act as our Information Security Officer and become the central contact for security, privacy and contract obligations. title: Technischer Projektleiter Robotik & Physical AI (m/w/d)
description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft von Physical AI und Robotik! Mit unserem Future Robotics Exploration Hub in Stuttgart bauen wir aktuell einen hersteller- und technologieunabhängiger Innovations- und Testraum für mobile und humanoide Robotik, Physical AI und industrielle Automatisierung der Zukunft auf. Unternehmen erproben im Hub Robotikplattformen, KI-Modelle, neuartige Sensorik und Greiftechnik anhand realer industrieller Anwendungsfälle. Ziel ist es, die flexible Fabrik von morgen zu gestalten. Der Hub verbindet Datenerfassung mittels Motion Capture, Physical-AI-Training und Multi-Robot-Benchmarking. Im Mittelpunkt stehen industrielle Use Cases unter industrienahen Bedingungen, darunter Materialtransport, das Be- und Entladen von Maschinen sowie die Automatisierung von Montageschritten. Wir sind das INC Innovation Center , ein internationales Team, das produzierende Unternehmen dabei unterstützt neue Technologien zu erschließen und innovative Ideen in die Praxis umzusetzen. Für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Hubs suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, selbst anzupacken, technische Lösungen zu entwickeln und die Zukunft der Robotik aktiv mitzugestalten. Ihre Mission Sie bauen die technische Infrastruktur des Hubs auf und machen sie für unsere Anwendungs- und Technologiepartner sowie unser Entwicklungsteam nutzbar. Dabei verantworten Sie das Zusammenspiel von Robotik-Hardware und -Software, Sensorik, Greiftechnik, Datenpipelines und Automatisierungstechnik als integriertes Gesamtsystem. Gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam in Aachen und Stuttgart leiten Sie die technische Umsetzung industrieller Use Cases. Ihre Verantwortung reicht von der Anforderungsaufnahme über Architektur und Integration bis zur Inbetriebnahme, zum Benchmarking und zur Validierung. Ein zentraler Fokus liegt auf Physical AI: Sie evaluieren und vergleichen aktuelle Foundation Models und Physical-AI-Modelle in verschiedenen Use-Case-Szenarien. Sie bereiten Modelle für konkrete industrielle Use Cases vor, passen sie durch anwendungsspezifisches Training/Fine-Tuning an und validieren ihre Leistungsfähigkeit in realen Robotik-Umgebungen. Ihre Aufgaben Aufbau, Integration und Betrieb der technischen Infrastruktur für Datenerfassung, Modelltraining, Simulation und die Umsetzung realer Use Cases mit Robotik- und Physical-AI-Systemen. Dazu gehören unter anderem Sensorik, Greiftechnik, Motion-Capture-Equipment, Edge-Devices sowie Cloud- und Datenplattformen. Gemeinsame Ausgestaltung industrieller Use Cases mit Industriepartnern zur Erprobung mobiler und humanoider Roboter. Evaluation, Vergleich, Integration und Anpassung von Physical-AI-Modellen und Foundation Models für unterschiedliche Robotik-Hardwaresysteme. Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien, Benchmarks, Pilotprojekten und Validierungen unter industrienahen Bedingungen. Aufbau von Trainingsworkflows für das Erlernen von Bewegungsabläufen durch verschiedene humanoide Robotiksysteme. Die Workflows umfassen reale Datenerfassung/Data-Capturing-Pipelines (z.B. mittels Teleoperationssystemen), Simulation, Datenaugmentation, Modelltraining sowie die Übertragung auf physische Robotik-Hardware. Technische Leitung und Durchführung von Industrieprojekten im Hub gemeinsam mit dem technischen Team in Stuttgart und Aachen. Planung und Steuerung sprintorientierter Arbeitspakete entlang der gesamten Software- und Hardware-Toolchain. Koordination interner Teams, externer Technologiepartner und industrieller Kunden. Entwicklung der technischen Roadmap sowie Identifikation neuer Technologien, Partner und Anwendungsfelder. Beratung von Industriepartnern sowie industriellen Kunden bei der technischen Vorbereitung, Umsetzung und Bewertung ihrer Robotik- und Physical-AI-Use-Cases. Ihr Profil Abgeschlossenes Diplom- oder Masterstudium in Robotik, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Maschinenbau, Automatisierungstechnik, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich. Promotion ist wünschenswert, jedoch keine Voraussetzung. Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Robotikumfeld; idealerweise bringen Sie mehr als fünf Jahre Erfahrung mit. Besonders relevant sind Bezüge zu Robotik-Hardware, Robotik-Software, Automatisierung, Physical AI, Robot Learning, Sensorik, Simulation oder industriellen Anwendungsfällen. Erfahrung in der technischen Projektleitung komplexer Projekte mit internen und externen Partnern. Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Integration und im Betrieb von Robotik-Infrastruktur oder Automatisierungssystemen. Dazu gehören Kenntnisse über Robotik-Hardware verschiedener Hersteller, Sensorik, Greiftechnik und Edge-Devices sowie über die Integration robotischer Gesamtsysteme. Grundlegende Erfahrung mit ROS 2, Python und Linux sowie mit Simulationstools wie NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab oder MuJoCo beziehungsweise vergleichbaren Technologien. Wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen mit Physical AI und Foundation Models, insbesondere VLA-Modellen, sowie mit robotischen Lernverfahren wie Imitation Learning und Reinforcement Learning. Erfahrung im Fine-Tuning von KI-Modellen und im Aufbau von Data-Capturing-Pipelines ist ebenfalls von Vorteil. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise Hohes Eigenengagement, unternehmerisches Denken und die Energie, neue Themen proaktiv voranzutreiben. Freude an einem dynamischen, sich schnell entwickelnden Umfeld und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Fähigkeit, sich eigenständig in neue Technologien und Fachgebiete einzuarbeiten. Offenheit für kontinuierliches Lernen, Experimentieren und Weiterentwicklung im Bereich Physical AI, Robot Learning und autonomer Robotik. Sie möchten Gestaltungsspielraum nutzen, mit dem Hub wachsen und seine Zukunft aktiv mitprägen. Dabei sind Sie Teil eines Teams mit großem Entwicklungspotenzial. Was wir bieten Die Möglichkeit, einen hersteller- und technologieunabhängigen Physical-AI-Hub in Stuttgart von Beginn an aktiv mitzugestalten. Zugang zu mobiler und humanoider Robotik, Sensorik, Greiftechnik, Simulations- und KI-Infrastruktur. Ein internationales Netzwerk aus Industrieunternehmen, Technologiepartnern, Startups und Forschungseinrichtungen. Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung des Hubs: Sie prägen die technische Roadmap, das Team und die Partnerschaften mit. Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet. Wir streben jedoch eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit an, sodass eine anschließende Entfristung ausdrücklich möglich ist. Sie möchten den Future Robotics Exploration Hub aktiv mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihren Lebenslauf und ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
