title: Engineering Manager
description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers. We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them. Our Tech Stack At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development. Your role In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture. Delivery : Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. Direction : Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose. Talent : Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent. Culture : Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture. Craft : Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends. AI-first engineering : Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes. Your profile 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures. Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams. Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design. Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work. Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit. What's in it for you Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum! Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days). Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year! 1,000 EUR personal development budget. Complete coverage for commuting. Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup. Gym membership discount with Wellhub. Dutch/English classes budget. Variable pension scheme. Diverse international community (46+ nationalities). Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday. title: Lead Systems Engineer (Orbital Launch)
description: Lead Systems Engineer We are looking for a Lead Systems Engineer to act as the Systems Technical Authority for our orbital rocket programme. You will lead the vehicle-level systems effort, maintaining a coherent technical view of the complete vehicle and leading the definition, management, and resolution of system interfaces. Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Act as the Systems Technical Authority for the orbital rocket programme, providing vehicle-level systems leadership and maintaining technical coherence across the complete vehicle. Lead the definition, ownership, and resolution of system interfaces across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other technical departments. Identify and manage interdependencies, assumptions, constraints, and cross-subsystem impacts as the vehicle design develops. Use MBSE models and related system artefacts to maintain a connected view of vehicle architecture, requirements, and interfaces. Lead cross-disciplinary systems discussions and reviews, bringing forward system-level trade-offs, resolving technical conflicts, and ensuring decisions are clearly recorded. Coordinate technical departments around vehicle-level priorities and help keep subsystem work aligned with the needs of the overall programme. Track system-level issues and interface actions through to resolution, helping establish the conditions for successful vehicle integration and launch. What we’re looking for Strong understanding of model-based systems engineering and its application to complex, multidisciplinary engineering programmes. Strong understanding of rocketry and how vehicle subsystems interact across the complete system. Experience leading systems engineering work, system interfaces, or cross-disciplinary technical efforts on complex engineering projects. A proven track record of successfully completing engineering projects. The ability to maintain a vehicle-level perspective while engaging with technical teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and other disciplines. Confidence facilitating technical decisions, managing competing subsystem needs, and driving interface issues toward resolution. Benefits and important information: We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent. Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success. Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas. Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday Free access to shared company housing Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week. We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger. Please submit applications in English Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Financial Crime Compliance, Senior Analyst
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Please only apply using an English CV. We're hiring for a passionate FinCrime problem solver to join the Financial Crime Compliance team in Paris and help protect the future of real-time payments. As a Senior Analyst, you will use your expertise in AML and complex onboarding to solve complex challenges in one of the world’s fastest-growing fintech environments. The Financial Crime Compliance team is the engine ensuring we grow safely. Key Responsibilities Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Lead deep-dive investigations into high-risk corporate entities and complex ownership structures (UBOs). SARs/STRs Management: Identify suspicious patterns and draft high-quality Suspicious Activity Reports (Déclarations de Soupçon) for submission to TRACFIN. title: Engineering Intern
description: About Atira Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP. We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us! Why engineers are the foundation of everything Atira ships As an Engineering Intern at Atira, you will work on frontier AI technology, such as (recursive) agent harnesses, runtimes, evals, inference and self-verification in complex engineering domains. You build the frameworks, primitives and scaffolding that let agents reliably handle complex industrial processes end to end, from the first inbound RFQ to the write-back into ERP. Misreading or wrongly interpreting a spec can cost a manufacturer six figures, so the challenges are real and the margin for error is thin. Where you trained matters less than what you've built and how clearly you can describe what broke. Atira is at a stage where you must own problems end to end, because what you ship today is what our customers use tomorrow. What you will do Work on the agent runtime and harnesses. You improve the core components that let Atira's agents reason in complex engineering environments across the entire sales-engineering lifecycle, orchestrate themselves recursively at scale through dynamic programs, and handle arbitrarily large amounts of data. This includes the runtime/sandboxing, the harness, and the outer orchestration layer that ties it together Build out our AI moat. You are in charge of improving quality & evals, improving the ontology layer that unlocks compounding process knowledge and fusing deterministic guardrails with agentic agency to make our agents actionable at enterprise level complexity Unlock industrial scale. Industrials live in multi-modal, data-heavy environments: 1000-page inbounds, pricing lists, CAD files, ERP tables, legacy applications. You scale the AI systems behind them to millions of concurrent LLM requests in isolated sandboxes, with no silent failures, cost blowouts or latency explosions. Advance our internal tooling. FDEs, platform engineers and the GTM team depend on tooling you build to improve Atira's internal context layer, ambient agents, insight and observability engines Work with FDEs when customer problems hit the platform. When an FDE hits a problem they should be able to pull you in. At a team of 20, the boundary between AI, platform and customer is thin, and you'll cross it regularly What we are looking for Ownership, depth, and the instinct to take problems personally, go deep until you understand the system, and own the outcome including the parts that broke. Your profile Agent fluency sits on top of real engineering fundamentals. Solid skills in Python, TypeScript, or a comparable language. We value someone that can still code without AI. Ideally paired with hands-on experience with agents, evals, harnesses, runtimes, sandboxing and tools You've gone further than most with AI-assisted development. Whether it's Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your own setup, you've invested seriously in building the skills, context, and workflows to get maximum leverage from coding agents. This isn't a nice-to-have. We think engineers who have mastered this are fundamentally more productive, and we hire accordingly You reason clearly about technical tradeoffs. You don’t need to have run systems at scale yet, but you can think through how a design would hold up at thousands of requests per second and explain the pros and cons of different approaches. Every design has tradeoffs: no free lunch You’ve demonstrated ownership and initiative. A side project you took further than anyone asked, a serious open-source contribution, a research project or a startup. We want evidence that you build without being told to and can explain what broke and why You have a strong technical foundation. Enrolled or recently graduated in Computer Science, Information Systems, AI, or a related technical field from a strong technical university (cracked dropouts can qualify too though) Full working proficiency in English. German is not required You're ready for a real internship, not a side gig. You can commit to at least three months full-time, on-site in Munich What you'll get Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and architecture as well as work closely with customers Strong peers and mentorship: work with and learn from engineers who have shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale, with the opportunity for mentorship along the way Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide Competitive salary and additional benefits Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity What success looks like at the end of the internship You've shipped meaningful improvements to the agent runtime, our AI pipelines and related systems that are running in production across multiple customer deployments You own one well-defined piece of our AI stack end to end (an eval suite, an internal tool, part of the context layer or the SDK), and the team trusts your judgment on how it should evolve When something breaks in the part you own, you can trace it end to end, from agent behaviour back to the agent infrastructure layer, and fix it You’ve made an improvement to our internal AI tooling that the team now uses day to day The design decisions in your piece have held up under real load, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made and what you’d do differently If these metrics are met, we'd take you full-time without thinking twice Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Program Manager
description: About us INCO is a leading social enterprise on a mission to shape a more inclusive and sustainable economy that creates opportunities for all. We have teams and programs in over 50 countries. Our work spans five complementary activities: INCO Academy: skilling programs for people facing barriers to employment, leading to careers in fast-growing industries such as technology, sustainability and healthcare (400,000+ job seekers trained to date). INCO Kids: education and awareness programs giving school-age learners future-proof knowledge in technology, sustainability, citizenship and more (350,000+ learners supported to date). INCO Entrepreneurs: incubation and acceleration for underrepresented founders and social entrepreneurs (2,000+ businesses supported every year). INCO Ventures: impact investing and funding for social and environmental impact startups (€500M+ assets under management). INCO Spaces: co-working and co-living spaces for social and environmental innovators (Paris, Berlin, Warsaw and more). About the program: AI and the Future of Work is a new three-year research and policy-engagement program (2026–2029), funded through a research grant partnership and led end to end by INCO. It tracks AI's real-world impact on jobs, tasks and productivity across all 27 EU member states, and gives policymakers the evidence, trend baselines and scenario-planning tools to capture AI's productivity upside while managing the workforce transition. About the role: We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to run the AI and the Future of Work program day to day and make sure it delivers on time, on budget and to the grant's commitments. You will closely lead and collaborate with a Research Lead and a Policy Lead. You will turn a three-year grant into a working operation: a deliverables calendar across 27 countries, a consortium of up to 15 partners, a publication schedule and a reporting cycle the funder can trust. You need to be comfortable working alongside researchers and policy specialists, and fluent in the rhythm of grant-funded research programs. Responsibilities: Lead program delivery end to end Planning and implementation Build and own the three-year implementation plan: workstreams, milestones, dependencies and the deliverables calendar agreed with the funder. Run the program's operating rhythm: weekly core-team check-ins, monthly consortium updates and quarterly steering reviews. Coordinate the publication pipeline with the Research and Policy Leads: quarterly data refreshes, five semi-annual reports, policy briefs, the annual flagship and the 2029 EU27 report. Keep thorough program documentation: plans, decision logs, risk register and handover notes. Set up quality-assurance steps for outputs (review cycles, sign-off, editorial and brand checks) together with the Communications team. Run the semi-annual tracking cycle and the reporting calendar for the five P0 markets and five sub-regional clusters, so national and EU27 outputs land together. Monitoring and evaluation Define and track program KPIs and grant deliverables; spot slippage early and agree corrective action with the leads. Collect and compile performance data across workstreams and partners, and report it to your manager and the funder in a structured, actionable way. Coordinate the program's evaluation framework so the team can show what the evidence changed in policy and practice. Budget and resources Own the program budget and cost sheet, including consortium partner budgets and the research consolidation budget held by the Research Lead. Manage timelines and scope so the program delivers within the grant's budget and rules; prepare budget forecasts and reallocation requests. Ensure grant compliance: eligible costs, audit trail, data protection (GDPR) and the funder's reporting requirements, working with Finance and Legal. Manage the consortium and partners Run the operational side of partner onboarding with the Research Lead: due diligence, contracts, scopes of work, payment schedules and data-sharing agreements. Track the delivery of 8 to 15 national partners against their contracts, and manage underperformance or replacement when needed. Organise consortium working groups, review cycles and annual convenings, and keep communication flowing across countries and time zones. Run the secretariat for the sub-recipient advisory committee (INCO staff, funder representatives and independent experts): schedule meetings, prepare selection materials, record recommendations and keep the process transparent, with final selection resting with INCO. Manage subrecipient compliance: flow-down of grant terms, financial and narrative reporting from partners, and checks before each payment. Manage the funder and stakeholders Act as the primary operational liaison with the grant funder, keeping expectations aligned and surfacing risks early. Prepare and present progress, financial and impact reports to the funder and other key stakeholders. Work with the Head of Partnerships on funder conversations, renewals and any extension of the partnership. Support the Policy Lead and with the logistics of policymaker convenings, events and launches. Coordinate, with the Policy Lead, the expanded public-engagement activity in Poland and the CEE region, and the logistics of rapid, fact-based responses when AI labour market stories break. Coordinate the team Set clear responsibilities, timelines and objectives across the core team, and track progress against them. Act as the connecting point between the Research Lead, the Policy Lead, data engineers and INCO's support teams (Communications, Finance, Legal, HR). Identify staffing needs as the program grows (for example research assistants, data roles or a program officer), write job descriptions, interview and onboard new team members, and manage any program staff assigned to you. Support growth Work with leadership to standardise how INCO runs grant-funded research programs, so lessons from this one carry over. Identify follow-on funding and adjacent opportunities, for example linking findings to INCO Academy skilling programs. Build relationships across the European research and policy ecosystem. Essential At least five years managing complex, multi-partner programs, ideally grant-funded research, policy or public-interest programs in Europe. Proven track record managing funders or institutional partners, including donor reporting, budgets and grant compliance. Experience coordinating consortia or networks of external partners, including contracts, scopes of work and partner payments. At least four years leading teams and working cross-functionally, including with senior experts you do not line manage. Strong budget and financial management skills, with ownership of program cost sheets and forecasts. High digital collaboration literacy (Slack, Monday.com, Notion, G-Suite or similar) and comfort running remote work across many countries. Professional English, written and spoken. Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with excellent communication, versatility and integrity. Desirable Experience with EU-funded or foundation-funded research programs (for example Horizon Europe, Erasmus+ or major philanthropic grants). Familiarity with research operations: publication cycles, data protection (GDPR), research ethics and data-sharing agreements. Interest in AI, the labour market, skills or the future of work; familiarity with EU institutions such as Cedefop, Eurostat, Eurofound or the JRC. A second EU language, especially German, French, Spanish, Italian or Polish. A recognised project management certification (for example PMP or PRINCE2). Experience managing sub-grants or sub-recipients, including selection processes and flow-down compliance. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Working Student - Procurement
description: 📍 Location: Amsterdam ⏱ Weekly Hours: Between 16 -30 hours per week 📅 Start Date & Duration: Available immediately (6-month minimum commitment) Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution! Since 2012, Fastned has been building and operating a rapidly growing network of iconic fast-charging stations powered entirely by solar and wind energy — now spanning over 400 stations across nine countries in Europe. Our goal is 1,000 stations in prime locations. About the role We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Working Student with a strong passion for data, analytics and procurement . In this role, you will play a key part and help build the foundations of Procurement at Fastned. In this role, you will be part of the Procurement Team, reporting to the Head of Procurement and collaborating closely with the Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams spanning Construction, Operations, Technology & Engineering, and IT. Procurement at Fastned is designed to support the business, not constrain it. The Procurement function does not make unilateral decisions about supplier or product selection. Instead, it brings structure, market insight, commercial expertise and oversight. You will help put this approach into practice. What you’ll be doing Dive into our supplier and purchasing data to uncover spending patterns, spot smart consolidation opportunities, and identify potential savings. Research market developments, map out supplier landscapes, and benchmark pricing and services across Fastned’s key procurement categories. Help set the team up for success in commercial negotiations by preparing clear supplier profiles, spend insights, and negotiation briefs. Keep track of how our suppliers are performing across cost, quality, delivery, and ESG—helping prepare supplier reviews and following up on agreed next steps. Help build and maintain practical procurement templates, guidelines, and sourcing documentation that make buying at Fastned smooth and transparent. Support our Procurement Champions across different teams by sharing handy tools, templates, and everyday guidance. Coordinate meetings and workshops with internal teams and suppliers, making sure decisions and follow-up actions are clearly captured. Who we are looking for You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme (ideally in Business, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field) with a genuine interest in procurement, supplier management, or commercial negotiations. You enjoy diving into data, spreadsheets, and complex information to turn them into clear, actionable insights. You’re confident with Excel and PowerPoint, and experience with data visualisation or procurement tools is a great plus. You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and work well independently, while handling sensitive commercial and financial information with discretion. You communicate clearly and enjoy partnering with stakeholders across different teams and backgrounds. Fluency in English is essential, and any additional European language is a bonus. You’re excited about Fastned’s mission and eager to play an active part in accelerating the energy transition. What you’ll learn In this role, you will gain practical experience in: Procurement category management and strategic sourcing Supplier and contract management Spend analysis, RFP and tender processes Commercial negotiations Procurement governance and stakeholder management Building a new Procurement function in a fast-growing international company What you get out of it Beyond a meaningful working student role at a company actively accelerating Europe's energy transition, here's what we offer: Flexibility that fits your schedule . We'll coordinate your working hours around your studies, no forced trade-offs between work and university. Daily lunches, snacks and drinks at our Amsterdam office . Break a sweat and improve your well-being with our Urban Sports Club Subscription and additional weekly fitness classes (kickboxing & bootcamp) led by professional trainers. Mental Wellbeing with nilo health : Access to a confidential mental health platform offering 1-on-1 coaching with psychologists, group sessions, and a variety of digital self-care tools. Real responsibility from day one . At Fastned, we don't believe in busywork. We want you to think like a founder! Your input matters, and you'll be expected to take ownership. Your analyses will influence where Fastned builds next. An hourly salary of €16,25 gross (+ holiday pay) . Apply today! We would love to hear from you! Send us your CV along with a short motivation explaining why you're excited about joining our mission. Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. title: (Senior) Business & Financial Analyst (all genders)
description: Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. title: IT Systems Automation Engineer (f/m/x)
description: bonial helps you save time, money and paper! We are a digital advertising partner for offline businesses - we support retailers in their marketing activities and help them find a new audience. Would you like to join and be a part of digitalisation of retail? bonial is part of Axel Springer SE and is disrupting the retail landscape as the leading "Drive to Store" partner in Germany and France. Through our platforms " kaufDA " and " MeinProspekt " in Germany, and “ Bonial ” in France, we connect millions of users with their favorite shops and brands—driving real impact every single day. We are in the midst of an exciting growth phase, scaling fast and transforming the way people discover retail. At bonial, we thrive in a high-performance, fast-paced environment fueled by motivated, results-driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference. If you’re looking to be part of a dynamic team that’s shaping the future of retail, we’d love to meet you. bonial welcomes both full- and part-timers! About The Role IT Operations keeps the company's core productivity, identity, and device ecosystem running smoothly and securely. As IT Systems Automation Engineer, you will own the design, implementation, and maintenance of automation across our corporate IT platforms (including M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Microsoft Intune, Atlassian & Slack). You'll reduce manual work for the team, improve consistency and security across the employee lifecycle. You’ll help build the scripts, integrations, and workflows that let a 6-person team support the whole organization efficiently. This is a hands-on engineering role within IT Operations, not a helpdesk position - you'll spend most of your time building and improving systems rather than handling day-to-day tickets. What You’ll Do Automate the employee lifecycle: Design and maintain automated workflows for onboarding, offboarding, and role changes across M365, Google Workspace, JAMF, Intune, and Slack (provisioning/deprovisioning accounts, licenses, group memberships, and device enrollment) Device management: Build and maintain JAMF (macOS/iOS) and Intune (Windows/mobile) configuration profiles, compliance policies, and automated patch/update workflows. Identity & access automation: Automate group and license assignment, conditional access rules, and access reviews across M365 and Google Workspace, working closely with the security team where relevant. Collaboration tooling: Manage and automate Slack workspace administration - channel provisioning, app/integration approvals, user lifecycle, and usage policies. Scripting & integration: Write and maintain scripts (PowerShell, Google Apps Script, or similar) and use APIs to connect systems that don't natively integrate. Documentation & runbooks: Document automation logic, workflows, and recovery procedures so the rest of the team can support and extend what you build. Monitoring & reliability: Set up monitoring/alerting for automated workflows so failures (e.g., a broken onboarding script) are caught and resolved quickly. Continuous improvement: Identify manual, repetitive IT Operations tasks and propose/build automation to eliminate them. Vendor & tooling evaluation: Assess new automation tools or platform features (e.g., new Intune or JAMF capabilities) and recommend adoption where it adds value. title: Werkstudent:in - Growth/ Marketing (m/w/d)
description: Du möchtest nicht nur Content produzieren, sondern mitgestalten, wie ein Unternehmen seine Geschichte erzählt und wächst? Bei nu estate verbindest du kreative Ideen, gutes Design und digitales Marketing. Du machst Themen rund um Immobilien, Technologie und KI verständlich und hilfst uns dabei, die richtigen Menschen zu erreichen. Über nu estate Wir wollen ein KI-natives Betriebssystem für die Immobilienverwaltung aufbauen. Dabei denken wir Technologie und die operative Bewirtschaftung von Immobilien zusammen: Was brauchen Eigentümer, Mieter und Dienstleister tatsächlich – und wie lassen sich ihre Anliegen einfacher, transparenter und zuverlässiger bearbeiten? Unser Ziel geht über weniger Verwaltungsaufwand hinaus. Eine belastbare Datenbasis soll langfristig auch helfen, Immobilien besser zu bewirtschaften und fundierte Entscheidungen über ihre Weiterentwicklung zu treffen. Dafür verbinden wir Immobilienpraxis mit Produktentwicklung, Datenanalyse und KI. Deine Rolle Als Werkstudent unterstützt du uns dabei, die Marke nu estate sichtbar und unsere Ideen greifbar zu machen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Content, Gestaltung und Kommunikation. Du recherchierst Themen, entwickelst Formate und bereitest Inhalte für die Menschen auf, die sich für Immobilienbewirtschaftung und ihre Zukunft interessieren. Daneben unterstützt du ausgewählte Growth-Projekte, etwa Materialien für Partner, kleinere Kampagnen oder Veranstaltungen. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team zusammen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und probierst aus, welche Inhalte und Formate tatsächlich funktionieren. Dabei geht es nicht darum, jeden Kanal gleichzeitig zu bespielen, sondern die richtigen Themen für die passenden Zielgruppen zu finden. Das sind deine Aufgaben Themen entdecken und Geschichten erzählen: Du recherchierst zu Immobilien, Technologie und KI und übersetzt komplexe Sachverhalte in verständliche, relevante Inhalte für unsere Zielgruppen. Content gestalten: Du schreibst und bearbeitest Texte, erstellst Grafiken und Präsentationen und unterstützt bei Bedarf bei kurzen Videos – von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Beitrag. Kanäle und Formate betreuen: Du pflegst einen Redaktionsplan, bereitest Beiträge für ausgewählte Kanäle wie LinkedIn oder die Website vor und begleitest ihre Veröffentlichung in Abstimmung mit dem Team. Die Marke mitgestalten: Du arbeitest mit bestehenden Designvorgaben und Vorlagen und sorgst dafür, dass Inhalte und Marketingmaterialien visuell und sprachlich zusammenpassen. Erfahrung mit Gestaltungs- oder Videotools wie Canva, Figma oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen. Growth-Projekte unterstützen: Du recherchierst Zielgruppen und potenzielle Partner und hilfst bei der Vorbereitung von Präsentationen, Kampagnen oder Veranstaltungen. Aus Ergebnissen lernen: Du hältst einfache Kennzahlen und Rückmeldungen fest und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen, wie sich Inhalte und Formate verbessern lassen. KI bewusst nutzen: Du setzt digitale und KI-gestützte Werkzeuge für Recherche, Ideen und Produktion ein und prüfst Fakten, Qualität und Nutzungsrechte, bevor Inhalte veröffentlicht werden. Das bringst du mit Du bist eingeschrieben; beispielsweise in Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, Design, Wirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du hast Freude daran, verständlich zu schreiben und Inhalte visuell ansprechend zu gestalten. Erste Beispiele können aus dem Studium, einem Nebenjob oder eigenen Projekten stammen. Du hast ein Gespür dafür, was eine Zielgruppe interessiert, und möchtest herausfinden, wie man komplexe Themen einfach erklärt. Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig: Du bringst Ideen ein, hältst Absprachen ein und achtest auch bei Details auf Qualität. Du nutzt digitale und KI-gestützte Werkzeuge oder hast Lust, dich schnell einzuarbeiten. Ergebnisse prüfst du kritisch, statt sie ungeprüft zu übernehmen. Du bist neugierig auf Immobilien und Technologie und arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein. Vorkenntnisse in der Immobilienwirtschaft sind kein Muss. Du gehst offen mit Feedback um und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen auszuprobieren und weiterzuentwickeln. Zusätzliche Pluspunkte: Erste Erfahrung mit Canva, Figma oder ähnlichen Design- und Videotools, Social Media, Website-Pflege, Newslettern oder der Auswertung von Marketingkennzahlen. Du musst nicht alle Werkzeuge bereits beherrschen, wichtiger sind Kreativität, Lernbereitschaft und ein sorgfältiger Umgang mit deiner Arbeit. Was die Arbeit bei uns ausmacht Konkreter Nutzen: Deine Inhalte helfen dabei, unsere Arbeit und ihren Nutzen für Eigentümer und Partner verständlich zu machen. Verantwortung mit Rückhalt: Du übernimmst überschaubare Aufgaben und Formate und stimmst Ziele, Inhalte und offene Fragen mit dem Team ab. Gestaltungsspielraum und Lernkurve: Du kannst Ideen einbringen, neue Formate ausprobieren und Einblicke in Marketing, Immobilien und Technologie gewinnen. Tempo mit Qualitätsanspruch: Wir wollen Ergebnisse früh testen und daraus lernen. Sorgfalt, verlässliche Aussagen und ein konsistenter Auftritt gehören dazu. Offenheit und Verbindlichkeit: Wir kommunizieren klar, geben ehrliches Feedback und arbeiten respektvoll und auf Augenhöhe zusammen. Interesse? Wir freuen uns auf eine kurze Vorstellung, deinen Lebenslauf und – falls vorhanden – ein oder zwei Arbeitsproben, etwa einen Text, eine Grafik oder ein Content-Projekt. Besonders spannend: Was war deine Idee, für wen war sie gedacht und was war dein eigener Beitrag? Vergütung Für diese Werkstudententätigkeit gilt ein Stundenlohn von EUR 15–20 pro Stunde. title: Growth Manager (m/w/d)
description: Rund 74 % aller CO₂-Emissionen in Deutschland entstehen im Zusammenhang mit der Energieproduktion, das sind über 543 Millionen Tonnen pro Jahr. Um die europäischen Klimaziele zu erreichen, müssen wir dieses Problem dringend und entschlossen angehen, und genau hier setzen wir bei Sunpeak Capital an. Wir machen den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien investierbar und verwandeln Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur in renditestarke Investments. Unser Ansatz verbindet Klimaschutz mit finanzieller Intelligenz: ein echtes Win-Win für Umwelt und Investoren. Mit unserer Kombination aus spezialisierten Beratungsprozessen, innovativen Investmentstrukturen und einem breiten Netzwerk aus Projektentwicklern ermöglichen wir privaten und unternehmerischen Investoren, den Energiewandel aktiv mitzugestalten, profitabel und nachhaltig. Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage dazu bei, dass Kapitalströme dorthin fließen, wo sie größten Klimanutzen und echte Rendite erzeugen. Aufgaben Deine Rolle Du übernimmst unser Marketing von den Gründern und baust es weiter aus. Einiges läuft bereits, vieles existiert noch nicht. Dein Job ist es, daraus eine Growth-Maschine zu machen: Du verantwortest Lead-Volumen, Lead-Qualität und Akquisitionskosten, testest den Funnel konsequent durch und entscheidest, welche Kanäle wie viel Budget bekommen. Wir suchen keine Person, die Briefings abarbeitet und auch keinen reinen Creative, sondern jemanden mit Performance-Mindset, der Kanäle versteht, Tests selbst aufsetzt und das Thema Growth bei Sunpeak Capital zu 100 % eigenverantwortlich ownt. Growth-Strategie und Budget: Du entwickelst mit den Gründern den Marketing-Plan, definierst Zielgruppen, Kanäle, Budgets und KPIs und steuerst Soll gegen Ist. Performance-Marketing: Unsere bezahlten Kampagnen liegen komplett bei dir. Du skalierst, was funktioniert, testest laufend neue Kampagnen und Zielgruppen und optimierst auf Lead-Qualität, nicht nur auf Volumen. Neue Kanäle testest du an, wenn die Zahlen es hergeben. Funnel und Conversion: Du baust und testest Landingpages und Funnels, optimierst Qualifizierung, Formulare und On-Page Conversion und sorgst dafür, dass Anzeige, Botschaft und Landingpage zusammenpassen. SEO und Content: Du steuerst Agentur, Freelancer und Gastautoren, planst Themen und Ratgeberartikel und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Inhalte technisch und inhaltlich sauber ranken. Longform-Content denkst du von Anfang an so, dass daraus Shorts, Reels und Ads entstehen. Creatives: Du konzipierst Ads, Hooks und Skripte und drehst einfache Formate mit unseren Gründern. Schnitt und Postproduktion laufen AI-gestützt oder über Freelancer. Du musst kein Videoprofi sein, aber ein gutes Auge für das haben, was in Ads performt. Newsletter und Lead Nurturing: Unser E-Mail-Marketing läuft bereits. Du entwickelst Segmentierung, Automationen und Inhalte entlang der gesamten Investor Journey weiter, inklusive Reaktivierung bestehender Leads. Daten und Tracking: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CRM (HubSpot) und unserem Marketing-Dashboard, hältst das Tracking sauber und machst sichtbar, welche Maßnahmen tatsächlich Investoren bringen. Brand: Du ziehst unsere Brand konsequent durch alle Touchpoints, von Ads über Social Media bis zu Investorenmaterialien. AI-First: Du arbeitest AI-first, bei Creatives, Schnitt, Artikeln, Reporting und Automatisierung. Was manuell nicht sein muss, wird es bei dir auch nicht. Das Budget für die passenden Tools stellen wir, welche das sind, entscheidest du. Perspektive: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und bist von Tag eins für die Zahlen verantwortlich. Mit wachsendem Erfolg steuerst du dein eigenes Team an Freelancern, Agenturen und Werkstudenten. Qualifikation Du hast 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance- oder Growth-Marketing in einem Startup oder Scale-up und einen Proven Track Record: Kampagnen, Kanäle oder Funnels, die du messbar aufgebaut oder skaliert hast Du bist hands-on in Paid Social und Paid Search und hast Erfahrung mit Landingpage- und Funnel-Testing. SEO und E-Mail-Marketing kennst du gut genug, um Agenturen und Freelancer zu steuern Du denkst in Funnel-Kennzahlen: CPL, CTR, Conversion Rate und Lead-Qualität sind für dich Werkzeuge, keine Buzzwords. Du setzt Tests sauber auf, wertest sie aus und ziehst Konsequenzen Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Hooks, Creatives und Storytelling und weißt, was auf Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn und Instagram funktioniert. Eigene Erfahrung mit Kamera und Schnitt ist ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung Du arbeitest dich sehr schnell tief in erneuerbare Energien, Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und die steuerliche Logik unserer Investments ein. Nur wer das Produkt versteht, kann dafür Marketing machen, das Investoren überzeugt Du arbeitest AI-first: AI-Tools sind für dich in Content-Produktion, Auswertung und Automatisierung fester Teil des Workflows Du arbeitest mit hoher Autonomie, triffst Entscheidungen selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, auch wenn es unbequem wird Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ein sicheres Gespür für Sprache und Tonalität Du bist verfügbar für eine Vollzeitstelle und bereit, an 5 Tagen pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro zu arbeiten Bonus: Erfahrung im Marketing für Finanz- oder Investmentprodukte oder in erneuerbaren Energien, oder du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera Benefits Ownership und Impact: Du baust das Marketing von Sunpeak Capital von Anfang an mit auf, arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und hast prägenden Einfluss darauf, wie wir am Markt wahrgenommen werden Kompetitive Vergütung: Top Leistung wird bei uns auch adäquat bezahlt! Kostenfreie Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft: Power dich nach der Arbeit aus beim Sport. Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte: Kaffee in Barista-Qualität, Designer-Möbel und technisches Top-Setup (Apple Hardware + XXL Screens). Regelmäßige Team-Events: Gemeinsame Team Abende und unser jährliches Offsite stärken das Miteinander und machen die Zeit bei uns noch besser. Workation: Anfang 2027 reisen wir gemeinsam für 2 Wochen nach Kapstadt. Über uns Sunpeak Capital entstand aus der gemeinsamen Vision von Konstantin und Jan. Vor der Gründung waren sie die ersten beiden Mitarbeiter des Fintech-Scale-ups Cloover, welches PV-Anlagen finanziert. Für dieses bauten sie den deutschen Markt auf und skalierten und das Partnernetzwerk auf über 200 Installationsbetriebe. In dieser Zeit erkannten sie, welches Potenzial entsteht, wenn man Kapital gezielt in nachhaltige Energieprojekte lenkt. Anfang 2025 gründeten sie dann Sunpeak Capital - vollständig gebootstrapped und bereits nach zwei Monaten profitabel. Ihr Antrieb: die Mechanismen des Kapitalmarkts nutzen, um den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien zu beschleunigen und Investoren echte Rendite mit echtem Impact zu ermöglichen. title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London. This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less. You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role, you will: Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners. Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com) Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles Excellent communication skills, verbal and written Curious and able to ask insightful questions A champion of a Growth Mindset Highly proficient in English and fluent in French An ideal candidate also has: Experience in closing-sales roles Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …) Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space ADR pathways Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program. ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them. The next level in the program is ADR II , where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program. The highest level within our organization is ADR III . These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. title: Head of Content Marketing (m/w/d) – B2B Personal Branding
description: Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen? Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt. Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer. Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon. Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt. Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst. Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch. Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich. Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Deine Mission Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast. Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen. Du baust den Weg von Reichweite zu Umsatz: Post → Kommentar oder DM → Termin → Auftrag für unser Sales-Team. Du machst die Brands gleichzeitig zum Recruiting-Magneten für die besten Leute. Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern: Content-Tage, Interviews, Skripte. Dein Ziel ist, dass wir so wenig Zeit wie möglich brauchen. Daneben schärfst du den Marketing-Auftritt der Firma mit: Website, Ads, Bewerber-Kommunikation. Das ist der kleinere Teil. Was du mitbringen musst Du hast nachweislich eine B2B-Founder-Brand aufgebaut oder mit aufgebaut – deine eigene oder als Ghostwriter, Stratege oder Head of Content. Über diese Brand ist nachweislich Umsatz entstanden: mindestens 100.000 € im Monat, idealerweise 200.000 bis 300.000 €. Idealerweise kommst du aus dem B2B-Dienstleister- oder Agentur-Umfeld oder hast selbst eine Agentur über Personal Branding skaliert. Bonus: E-Commerce, Marketing oder SaaS. Du denkst in Zahlen, nicht in Likes: Impressions → Leads → Termine → Aufträge. Du bist stark in Strategie und dir trotzdem nicht zu schade, selbst Hooks zu schreiben, Posts zu veröffentlichen und DMs aufzusetzen. Du arbeitest vor Ort in Düsseldorf. Was wir bieten 7.000 bis 10.000 € Fixgehalt im Monat. Mit variabler Vergütung sind 25.000 € und mehr im Monat möglich. Deine Ergebnisse bestimmen dein Gehalt. Mentoring von den Besten auf dem internationalen Markt: Für Masterminds, Mentorings und Beratung geben wir jedes Jahr über 300.000 € aus, unter anderem für die höchste Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Du bekommst Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und kommst als Teilnehmer mit auf die Events. Direkter Draht zu beiden Gründern, keine Politik, keine Konzernstrukturen. Ein hochmotiviertes Team, in 5,5 Jahren von 2 auf 35 Leute gewachsen. Apple-Ausstattung, Urban Sports, Benefit-Card, Parkplatz, Team-Events. So bewirbst du dich Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und beantworte drei kurze Fragen: Links zu 1–3 Founder-Brands, für die du verantwortlich warst, welcher Umsatz darüber entstanden ist (3–5 Zeilen mit Zahlen) und dein LinkedIn-Profil. title: Spezialist Werkstofftechnik & Prozessentwicklung (m/w/d)
description: Über Remloy Seltene Erden sind unverzichtbar für zahlreiche Zukunftstechnologien – von Elektromobilität und Windkraft bis hin zu Robotik und industriellen Anwendungen. Mit innovativen Recyclingtechnologien tragen wir dazu bei, wertvolle Rohstoffe zurückzugewinnen, natürliche Ressourcen zu schonen und unabhängige, nachhaltige Lieferketten aufzubauen. Die Remloy GmbH ist Teil der internationalen Mkango-Gruppe und spezialisiert auf das Recycling von Seltene-Erden-Permanentmagneten sowie die Herstellung hochwertiger Neodym-Eisen-Bor-Legierungspulver (NdFeB). An unserem Standort in Bitterfeld-Wolfen betreiben wir eine moderne Produktionsanlage und arbeiten daran, unsere Technologien und Produktionskapazitäten weiter auszubauen. Für den weiteren Aufbau unseres Unternehmens suchen wir einen engagierten Spezialisten Werkstofftechnik & Prozessentwicklung (m/w/d), der unsere metallurgischen Produktionsprozesse und Anlagen aktiv weiterentwickelt und als technische rechte Hand eng mit dem Produktionsleiter und dem Produktionsteam zusammenarbeitet. Im Mittelpunkt steht das Zusammenspiel von Werkstoffeigenschaften, Prozessparametern und Anlagentechnik – mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und direktem Bezug zur industriellen Praxis. Das können Sie bewegen: Werkstoff- & Prozessentwicklung: Analyse und Optimierung metallurgischer Produktions- und Schmelzprozesse sowie Weiterentwicklung der Verarbeitung von NdFeB-Legierungen. Untersuchung, wie Prozessbedingungen das Verhalten und die Eigenschaften metallischer Werkstoffe beeinflussen. Materialqualität & Produktionsoptimierung: Analyse der Einflussgrößen auf Materialeigenschaften, Produktqualität und Materialausbeute sowie Ermittlung der Ursachen von Qualitätsabweichungen und Prozessabweichungen. Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen für höhere Reproduzierbarkeit, Effizienz und Prozesssicherheit. Technische Anlagenoptimierung: Analyse des Zusammenspiels von Material, Prozess und Produktionsanlage, Identifikation technischer Schwachstellen und Entwicklung geeigneter Anlagenmodifikationen. Praktische Umsetzung und Bewertung gemeinsam mit dem Produktionsteam zur Verbesserung von Anlagenleistung, Verfügbarkeit, Ergonomie und technischer Zuverlässigkeit. Versuchsplanung & Datenanalyse: Eigenständige Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung systematischer Produktionsversuche. Analyse von Prozessparametern, Materialeigenschaften und Qualitätsdaten, Umsetzung datenbasierter Verbesserungen sowie Weiterentwicklung von Prozessüberwachung und Datenerfassung. Technische Weiterentwicklung: Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Vakuumtechnik, Schmelzanlagen, Sensorik und Steuerungssystemen. Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produktionsverfahren und Anlagenkomponenten sowie Bewertung und praktische Erprobung neuer technischer Ansätze. Anlagenbetreuung & Produktionsunterstützung: Unterstützung bei technischen Fehleranalysen, Wartungsplanung und Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktionsleiter und dem Produktionsteam. Das bringen Sie mit: Grundlegende Anforderungen: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Materialwissenschaften, Werkstofftechnik, Metallurgie oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Fachrichtung. Fundiertes Verständnis metallischer Werkstoffe, ihrer Eigenschaften und ihres Verhaltens unter unterschiedlichen thermischen und verfahrenstechnischen Bedingungen sowie Kenntnisse ihrer Verarbeitung, insbesondere thermischer und metallurgischer Verfahren. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, um Zusammenhänge zwischen Materialeigenschaften, Prozessparametern und Produktqualität zu untersuchen und wissenschaftlich-technische Erkenntnisse in konkrete industrielle Verbesserungsmaßnahmen zu übertragen. Interesse an industriellen Produktionsanlagen, Bereitschaft zur aktiven Mitarbeit im Produktionsumfeld und Fähigkeit zur Einarbeitung in komplexe Prozesse. title: Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>About the department</p><p>Cloudflare's Engineering team builds and runs the software that handles a large share of the Internet's requests. We also build the internal tools and platforms that software depends on. Teams own large areas with real impact and work autonomously within them, whether their customers are external or other Cloudflare engineers.</p><p>About the team</p><p>Developer Productivity builds the internal tools and platforms Cloudflare engineers use to take code from commit to production. We own developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), developer insights and ADLC metrics, AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.</p><p>We're responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering, and adoption has grown 4 to 6 times over in the last year. We also own the tooling behind Cloudflare's Engineering Codex, the standards every engineering team is expected to meet.</p><p>About the role</p><p>This is a front-line engineering manager role leading a team of 6+ engineers in Bengaluru. The team's initial focus will be on two areas:</p><ul><li><p><strong>AI tools for engineers.</strong> Agents, agentic systems, MCP servers, evals, and context engineering that change how Cloudflare engineers write, review, and ship code.</p></li><li><p><strong>Engineering standards and the tooling that enforces them.</strong> Continuing to transform our Engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and feedback engineers can act on, instead of checklists and manual review.</p></li></ul><p>You'll own the product direction for both areas. There are no dedicated product managers on the team. Our users are Cloudflare engineers, and our engineers work as product engineers who talk to users, watch how tools get used, and help decide what to build next. You'll lead that work, deciding what to build and why, and making sure it gets adopted and solves real problems.</p><p>You don't need to write code every day, but you should be able to review a design, debug a broken pipeline, or prototype an agent when the team needs it.</p><p>We move fast. AI tooling changes month to month, so a six-month plan is stale in six weeks. We ship small, put it in front of engineers early, and change course based on what we hear. We'd rather ship a rough version this week and improve it next week than spend a month polishing a design doc. We add process only when it solves a real problem.</p><p>You'll partner closely with engineering managers and principal engineers in the US, UK, and Europe, and work with teams across Cloudflare's global organization. The team starts in Bengaluru. As it grows, it may include engineers in other regions.</p><p>What you'll do</p><ul><li><p>Hire, onboard, and grow your team. Coach engineers to think like product engineers, run career conversations, give direct feedback, and handle performance.</p></li><li><p>Own the product roadmap. Spend time with the engineers who use your tools, decide which problems matter most, and say no to the rest.</p></li><li><p>Keep the team shipping. Release in small increments, get feedback from users quickly, and cut process that slows the team down without adding value.</p></li><li><p>Deliver in both focus areas: agents, MCP servers, and evals the rest of engineering relies on, and Codex standards turned into CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code, with remediation and exception workflows to match.</p></li><li><p>Measure whether the work is landing: tool adoption, Codex compliance, and what engineers actually think of the experience.</p></li><li><p>Own operations for the platforms your team runs, including on-call and incident response.</p></li></ul><p>What we're looking for</p><ul><li><p>3+ years managing software engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and developing people.</p></li><li><p>8+ years of total software engineering experience, with enough recent hands-on work to hold your own in code and design reviews.</p></li><li><p>Hands-on experience with AI in engineering organizations, such as building agents, running agentic systems in production, or governing how a company uses AI. This is not a model-training or ML research role.</p></li><li><p>Experience building or running developer tools, internal platforms, or CI/CD systems.</p></li><li><p>Product and user thinking. You've owned a roadmap, with or without a PM, and you can point to decisions you made because of what users told you or how they actually used what you built.</p></li><li><p>A bias to action. You've led teams that shipped often and changed direction when the evidence called for it, while still delivering on commitments.</p></li><li><p>Clear judgment and clear writing. You make sound trade-offs and explain the "why" as well as the "how". Much of your work with partners will happen asynchronously across time zones.</p></li></ul><p>Bonus points</p><ul><li><p>You've built MCP servers or LLM evals, or worked on context engineering for agents.</p></li><li><p>Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p></li><li><p>Experience measuring developer productivity, using frameworks such as DORA or SPACE, or developer surveys.</p></li><li><p>You've built a team from scratch or started an engineering presence in a new location.</p></li><li><p>Familiarity with TypeScript, Go, or Kubernetes-based systems.</p></li></ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Marseille
description: Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun. Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine. Notre ancrage dans la région marseillaise est déjà un succès incontestable . Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et agrandissons notre équipe à Marseille. L'opportunité Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor. Tes missions Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats. Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients. Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance. Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables. Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation. Ton profil Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.
