title: People Partner, Germany
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our People Operations Team Help shape how we support and grow our teams in Germany. As our People Partner, Germany, you’ll combine deep local expertise with the opportunity to build and improve the People foundations of a fast-changing business. Reporting to Josh Gladwin, you’ll strategically partner with Fleet Operations Germany and be a visible, trusted point of contact for employees and managers across the country. You’ll work closely with our global People Partner team and local leaders to turn compliance requirements into practical processes while building a strong employee experience. 🧠 Your day-to-day Audit and strengthen German People policies, processes and regulatory compliance, owning improvements through implementation. Manage employee relations cases end to end, including probations, grievances and exits. Partner with Fleet Operations leaders and provide responsive local guidance to employees and managers across Germany. Collaborate with departmental People Partners to deliver consistent global practices that meet local requirements. Build trusted relationships with local leadership, communicate clearly and contribute to a visible, people-oriented culture. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Auditing German People processes, identifying compliance gaps and project-managing improvements from recommendation through rollout, including policies, regulatory reporting, health checks and exit processes. Owning employee relations cases end to end, including probations, probation exits, grievances and other exits, working with works councils. Acting as the visible first point of contact for employees and managers across Germany, including local benefits, time off and day-to-day guidance. Strategically partnering with Fleet Operations Germany and operational stakeholders. Working with departmental People Partners on employee relations and process rollouts, and influencing leaders through clear individual and group communications. 🙌 You should apply if Deep practical expertise in Germany’s employment, regulatory and People compliance landscape. End-to-end employee relations experience, including exits, probations and grievances, plus experience working with a works council. A track record of independently building or improving People processes in a fast-paced, changing organisation. Experience partnering with operational stakeholders and influencing leaders. Fluent written and spoken German, with English sufficient for effective collaboration with global colleagues. An approachable, visible partnering style and the ability to attend the office 2–3 days per week, ideally 3. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency interview with the hiring manager Deep-dive interviews: an in-person office interview and a presentation / panel Final interview: mission & values alignment We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. title: Field Account Executive - Stuttgart (w,m,d)
description: Über uns & Die Opportunity Bereit für die Freiheit, komplett eigenständig zu arbeiten, aber mit der Power eines globalen Tech-Pioniers im Rücken? Lightspeed ist die führende All-in-One-Plattform für Handel und Gastronomie. Nach dem erfolgreichen Launch in allen deutschen Großstädten ist Stuttgart unser nächster Stopp! Als KI-getriebenes Tech-Unternehmen bieten wir dir eines der besten SaaS-Produkte auf dem Markt. In dieser Rolle bist du nicht einfach nur Angestellter – du bist der "Owner" deines eigenen Gebiets in Stuttgart . Gemeinsam mit einem neuen, dynamischen Team von ca. 3 Personen und einem erfahrenen Manager vor Ort eroberst du den Münchner Gastronomiemarkt. Wir verzichten auf Micromanagement und setzen auf Vertrauen, Freiheit und Ergebnisse. Deine Mission in Stuttgart Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für dein Vertriebsgebiet und gewinnst die Top-Locations der Stadt für Lightspeed. Dein Erfolg basiert auf einem modernen, holistischen Vertriebsansatz: Digitaler Rückenwind: Wir unterstützen dich aktiv durch Performance Marketing & qualifizierte Leads. Strategische Partnerschaften: Du baust dir ein lokales Netzwerk und ein starkes Empfehlungsmanagement (Referrals) auf. Gezielte Kaltakquise & Walk-ins: Du bist täglich im Markt präsent, besuchst Restaurants, Cafés sowie Bars und überzeugst die Inhaber direkt vor Ort. Full-Cycle-Verantwortung: Du steuerst den gesamten Prozess selbstständig – vom ersten Händedruck über die Produkt-Demo bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Beratender Verkauf: Du verkaufst nicht nur Software, sondern hilfst Gastronomen partnerschaftlich dabei, ihr Business erfolgreicher zu machen. Wer du bist (Dein Profil) Ein echter Hunter: Du liebst die Herausforderung der Neukundengewinnung, bist extrem selbstmotiviert und brauchst niemanden, der dir ständig über die Schulter schaut. Kommunikationsstark: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (essenziell für den Vertrauensaufbau mit lokalen Inhabern) und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit. Charismatisch & Resistent: Du besitzt ein sicheres Auftreten, starke Präsentationsfähigkeiten und hast kein Problem damit, in ein volles Restaurant zu gehen und ein Gespräch zu starten. Ehrgeizig: Du willst deinen Erfolg selbst in die Hand nehmen und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung direkt belohnt wird. title: Operations Agent – Call Center & Kundenservice (m/w/d)
description: Wer wir sind Wir sind ein innovatives PropTech-Team aus Bonn und kümmern uns um etwas, das in Deutschland noch erstaunlich analog ist: Wer eine Immobilie kauft, verkauft oder finanziert, braucht Unterlagen von Ämtern, zum Beispiel Grundbuchauszug, Bauakte oder Baulastenauskunft. Die liegen bei vielen hundert Behörden, und jede tickt anders. Manches geht digital, vieles nur per Telefon, Mail, Fax oder Post. DocEstate sorgt dafür, dass die Unterlagen vollständig und pünktlich ankommen. Digital, wo es geht. Mit Menschen, die dranbleiben, wo es nicht geht. Unsere Kunden sind vor allem Investoren, Wohnungsunternehmen, Hausverwaltungen und Kanzleien. Deine Aufgaben Behörden melden sich nicht immer von selbst. Du sorgst dafür, dass die Auskünfte trotzdem ankommen. Du rufst bei Ämtern an, fragst nach dem Stand einer Anfrage und findest heraus, wer wirklich zuständig ist. Du schreibst Nachfragen und Erinnerungen per Mail oder Fax, sachlich und so, dass sie bearbeitet werden. Du klärst Rückfragen und sorgst dafür, dass fehlende Angaben schnell nachgereicht werden. Du hältst jeden Kontakt in unserem System fest und behältst Fristen und offene Vorgänge im Blick. Du merkst, wo es im Ablauf immer wieder hakt, und bringst Ideen ein, wie es besser geht. Darüber hinaus sprichst du situativ auch direkt mit unseren Kunden, wenn es Rückfragen zu ihren Anfragen gibt. So sieht dein Alltag wirklich aus Viel Telefon: Behörden erreichst du am besten vormittags, etwa zwischen 8 und 12 Uhr. Das ist deine Zeit, unser Team mit deinen Skills nach vorne zu bringen. Rund um die Telefonzeit schreibst du Nachfragen, dokumentierst und bereitest die nächsten Anrufe vor, so wie du das für richtig hältst. Behörden sind nicht immer schnell. Manchmal wirst du zum dritten Mal vertröstet. Wer gern Dinge gründlich zu Ende bringt, ist hier richtig. Du bearbeitest viele Vorgänge parallel. Ordnung im Kopf und mit System sind wichtigste Werkzeuge für dich. Das bringst du mit Du hast Bock, anzupacken, und willst Dinge erledigt sehen, nicht nur verwaltet. Du drückst dich klar aus, am Telefon und schriftlich. Deine Mails können ohne aufwendige Nachbearbeitung rausgehen. Sicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1). Du bleibst freundlich, auch beim dritten Anruf zum selben Vorgang. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und behältst bei vielen parallelen Vorgängen den Überblick. Du kannst in den ersten ein bis zwei Monaten jeden Tag bei uns in Bonn sein, denn die Einarbeitung findet vor Ort statt. Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung im Call Center oder Kundenservice, am liebsten Outbound, also aktiv nachfassen statt nur annehmen Erfahrung mit Behörden, Verwaltung, Kanzlei, Notariat oder Immobilienverwaltung Sicherer Umgang mit Ticket- oder CRM-Systemen Was wir dir bieten Unbefristeter Vertrag, Start ab sofort Strukturierte Einarbeitung: ein bis zwei Monate vor allem vor Ort, mit festen Ansprechpartnern Danach hybrid: 2 Tage im Büro, 3 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche Büro im Digital Hub direkt am Bonner Hauptbahnhof, gut mit Bus und Bahn erreichbar Ein Team, das offen sagt, was gut läuft und was nicht, und deine Ideen ernst nimmt So läuft deine Bewerbung Kein Anschreiben nötig. Dein Lebenslauf reicht, gern mit zwei, drei Sätzen dazu, warum die Stelle zu dir passt. Kurzes Telefonat (ca. 15 Minuten) Kennenlernen bei uns in Bonn mit kleinem Dive-In aus dem echten Arbeitsalltag Du hörst innerhalb von 5 Werktagen von uns. Du erkennst dich hier wieder, hast aber nicht jeden Punkt abgehakt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns ist wichtiger, wie du am Telefon und im Schriftverkehr auftrittst, als welche Stationen im Lebenslauf stehen. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You will help us improve how we collect, process, and analyze performance data at scale, spanning from devices collecting real-time to backend services and ML infrastructure. All of which will have a direct impact on customers and their experiences with the product. This role suits a strong generalist who has seen many parts of engineering. You might have worked on any of the following: high-throughput systems, computer vision, robotics, ML infrastructure, or other complex applications. Our ideal candidate brings strong engineering judgment, good technical range, and the ability to learn quickly. You will be hands-on, working in Python and C++ on devices and services in use by our customers every day. WHAT YOU'LL DO Design and implement algorithms for 3D object tracking, segmentation, and motion recognition on embedded hardware. Train and iterate on ML models — from dataset curation through training, evaluation, and deployment to edge devices. Help bring ML, computer vision, or signal-processing systems into production with tight performance constraints Build reliable application features and services that customers use in real environments. Analyze production data to find system limits, product issues, and opportunities for improvement. Collaborate closely with the embedded platform team on model optimization and inference performance, and with the applications team on how tracking data becomes product features. WHAT YOU'LL NEED 4+ years of software engineering experience in production systems. Strong skill in Python and backend engineering. Working knowledge of C++ or a strong reason to be effective in performance-critical code. Experience with data-intensive systems, distributed systems, parallel processing, or efficient data pipelines. Exposure to ML, ML infrastructure, signal processing, real-time systems, computer vision, or related applied technical areas. A track record of shipping reliable software, not only prototypes. Strong debugging skills and the ability to find the root cause of complex system behavior. Clear communication and good judgment when tradeoffs are not simple. Curiosity, adaptability, and the desire to learn new technical areas. Nice to have — and what would make you exceptional: Experience with computer vision, depth cameras, pose estimation, tracking, or 3D data. Experience with ML model deployment, feature pipelines, evaluation systems, or data quality tools. Experience with streaming data, event systems, real-time processing, or low-latency applications. Experience with numerical methods, signal processing, filtering, state estimation, or robotics. WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE In 6 months time, you understand the main systems, ship reliable changes, and help improve a meaningful data or product workflow. You give valuable technical input towards solving problems across backend, data, and perception systems. In 12 months time, you have made a measurable impact on system reliability, product capability, or data quality. title: Projektingenieur Niederspannungsschaltanlagen (m/w/d)
description: Über ScaleZ GmbH Hinter jeder Stelle, die wir ausschreiben, steht ein Betrieb, den wir persönlich kennen. ScaleZ ist ein Headhunting-Unternehmen aus Zürich, spezialisiert auf Architektur, Bau, Gebäudetechnik und Industrie in der Deutschschweiz. Wir arbeiten mit Betrieben zusammen, die Menschen suchen, die bleiben wollen. Bei uns sprichst du von Anfang an mit einem Menschen, der dir ehrlich sagt, was hinter einer Stelle steckt, von den Projekten bis zum Lohn. Und wer einmal mit uns gesprochen hat, hört wieder von uns, auch wenn die Nachricht keine frohe ist. Stellenbeschreibung Projektingenieur:in für Niederspannungsschaltanlagen in Zürich, 60 bis 100 Prozent, mit einem Lohn von CHF 95'000 bis 130'000 pro Jahr und zwei bis drei Tagen Homeoffice pro Woche. title: Analyst (Legacy)
description: About Marble Marble is a climate tech venture studio. We partner with scientists, engineers and operators to create companies solving hard climate problems in the world's largest industries. Our first 15 companies are building transformative products across energy, industry, agriculture, and climate resilience. 100% have been successful in raising follow-on to date. We are looking to partner with exceptional individuals to create our next venture. About The Role We’re hiring a Partners Analyst intern to join the Marble team during a pivotal 6-month window as we raise our second startup studio vintage, launch the next generation of Marble companies, and accelerate growth across the portfolio. This is a high-trust, high-context role, ideal for someone who wants to work side-by-side with Marble Partners and play a meaningful part in how Marble operates, raises capital, and supports Founders. You'll help drive investor outreach, prepare materials, keep internal priorities moving, and step in to support where needed for our world-class climate tech companies. This internship is a great fit for a student with a passion for climate tech and venture, with prior exposure in a fast-paced environment where they had to own work, navigate ambiguity, and help shape key decisions (e.g., startups, scaleups, VC, corporate dev, etc) Location: HQ in Paris, Station F Language: English fluency required. French fluency preferred. Period: 6-month internship starting as soon as possible Responsibilities This internship is built around four key pillars: Fundraising Operations. Support Partners on fundraising for our second startup studio vintage, as well as potential new vehicles. This includes: investor research (e.g., HNWIs, Family Offices, Fund of Funds, other LPs), data room material preparation, CRM updates, meeting scheduling and follow-ups, etc. Separately, you may also support select Marble companies during their own fundraising processes (with a focus on VCs and angels) Project Management. You’ll act as a force multiplier for the Partners, helping them stay on top of key meetings, follow-ups, and fast-moving priorities. You’ll also support internal coordination between Partners, the team, and founders. Founder Support. You’ll take on focused research projects - from helping our Founders in Residence develop their startup idea and mapping potential competitors, to supporting portfolio companies with market research and customer discovery. You’ll also assist with light financial modelling (e.g., cap tables, projections) when needed to help inform internal discussions or founder support. Content & Communications. You’ll support us on internal and external comms, and prepare key deliverables, e.g., investor updates, decks, memos, as well as briefing docs in advance of key external meetings attended by Partners. Requirements This internship is a unique opportunity for an entrepreneurial individual who’s excited to operate in a fast-paced, high-context environment. You are studying for a Master’s degree (must be able to obtain a convention de stage) at a top engineering or business school, with ideally a specialisation in entrepreneurship, venture capital, or climate tech. You already had exposure (e.g., internship, school project, etc) to startups, VC, studios, or similar programmes, or corporate development. Maybe you’ve even built your own thing. You are fluent/native in English, and ideally in French as well. Your ability to learn on the job is more important than ticking every single box. However, we would especially love to hear from you if: You’re passionate about climate tech, startups, venture creation, and capital. You are familiar with the key trends and relevant ecosystems. You’re organised, responsive, and can manage many moving parts without dropping the ball. You’re a strong communicator and take pride in creating clean, structured deliverables. You’ve done basic financial modelling (Excel preferably) and are comfortable working with cap tables and business plans. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks with a "learning by doing" attitude. You excel at using modern software and AI products to increase your work leverage, such as Claude, Gemini, Notion, Slack, Airtable, Google Suite, etc. Familiarity with CRMs and specialist AI tools (e.g. Lemlist, Exa, Clay, etc) is a welcome plus. We encourage women and people of colour to apply. Studies have shown that under-represented candidates are less likely to apply for an opportunity unless they feel they meet every single qualification. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and mission-driven cohort. If you’re excited about the programme but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with what you read on our website, we encourage you to apply anyways! title: Office Manager
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. As our Office Manager in Munich, you'll have an incredible role as a people driven person who's passionate about the day to day operations and administrative needs of the office, to helping curate a best in class workplace environment and assisting on events. You’ve worked at a startup. You’ve been through the speed and the ambiguity, and the “we’re doubling headcount next quarter” moments. You know how to build processes without slowing anyone down. You care how the office feels. You notice the small things: the coffee, the light, how a new joiner’s first morning goes, whether the meeting rooms actually work. You want people to come in because they’d rather be there. You’re an operator at heart. You’ve managed vendors, facilities, supplies, budgets, health and safety, access and maintenance, and you keep it all running smoothly in the background. You can run events. You’ve planned team socials, all-hands, offsites, investor visits and community nights. You can take one from a rough idea to a polished event, often with little notice. You’re very organised and you follow through. You juggle a dozen moving parts, and nothing gets dropped or waits on someone else to chase it. You’re a great communicator. You build good relationships with everyone, from new engineers to the founders, landlords and suppliers. People find you warm, approachable and dependable. You’re happy owning things alone. You don’t need a playbook. You see what’s needed, set a high bar and get it done. Who Will Thrive at microagi Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior PMO Analyst
description: About the Role Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies. Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth. Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Program Planning & Execution Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control. Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs. Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early. Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution. PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use. Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery. Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow. Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity. Risk, Issue & Performance Management Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges. Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time. Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership. Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention. AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking. Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate. Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs. Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making. Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned. Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders. Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration. Requirements What You'll Need Required Qualifications & Experience At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls. Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management. A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace. Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment. Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken. Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations. Eligibility to work in Switzerland. Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations. Strong Plus Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies. Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms. Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes. Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management. Nice to Have Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe. Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations. Who You Are You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results. You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle. You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture. You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans. You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations. You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward. You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation. You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables. You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company. You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues. You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs. What We Offer A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction. The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth. Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs. The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.</p> <p><strong>Reports to:</strong> CTO</p> <p><strong>About the venture: ROB'E</strong></p> <p>ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.</p> <p>Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory.</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes.</li> <li>Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification.</li> <li>Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.</li> <li>Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety architecture.</li> <li>Drive the hardware contribution to risk management (ISO 14971), including design FMEA and risk control measures.</li> <li>Plan and lead hardware verification, pre-compliance and full compliance testing for electrical safety and EMC (IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2) with external test houses.</li> <li>Contribute hardware documentation to the design history file and technical documentation under our ISO 13485 quality system.</li> <li>Build prototypes for verification, usability studies and clinical evaluation, together with suppliers and the development partner.</li> or PhD in mechatronics, mechanical, electrical or systems engineering.</li> <li>At least 8 years of hardware development experience, including at least 3 years as a system architect or lead engineer.</li> <li>Hands-on development of active medical devices through design controls, from concept to verified design.</li> <li>Practical experience with IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2 and ISO 14971, engineering partners or suppliers, including technical reviews and cost control.</li> <li>Fluent in English and comfortable working in a small, fast moving startup team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with medical robotics, catheter or endoscope handling, or image guided intervention systems.</li> <li>Knowledge of cleanable and reprocessable device design and single use interface components.</li> <li>Dutch or German language skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>A key role in a clinically validated medtech venture, with real influence on the product and the company.</li> <li>Close collaboration with interventional cardiologists and direct exposure to the cath lab.</li> <li>Permanent employment with a competitive salary and an employee stock option plan.</li> <li>A lean, senior team with short decision paths.</li> </ul> <h3 data-section-id="1pw1999" data-start="3755" data-end="3777"><strong data-start="3758" title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.</p> <p>We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our <a href="https://techcrunch.com/2022/09/21/ledgy-a-carta-for-european-startups-to-manage-equity-and-cap-tables-raises-22m-from-nea-sequoia-and-more/">$22m Series B</a> round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.</p> <p>We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.</p> <p> </p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.</p> <p>Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.</p> <p><strong>The team you'll join:</strong> Platform - Builds the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably, working with InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Work On</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloud infrastructure.</strong> Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.</li> <li><strong>CI/CD and developer experience.</strong> Speed up feedback loops, reduce flaky builds, and turn recurring support requests into self-service tooling.</li> <li><strong>Observability.</strong> Reduce alert noise, define meaningful SLOs, and make production issues easier to diagnose.</li> <li><strong>Security and automation.</strong> Partner with InfoSec on secure delivery, access controls, and guardrails for AI-assisted workflows.</li> </ul> <p>You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.</p> <p><strong>You'll Thrive in This Role If You</strong></p> <p>Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.</p> <ul> <li>Have strong DevOps / SRE background designing and operating cloud infrastructure and production systems</li> <li>Have worked with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, ideally GCP and Terraform</li> <li>Enjoy building fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines and improving developer experience</li> <li>Can diagnose issues across networking, infrastructure, and application code</li> <li>Write maintainable code and bring a practical approach to observability and security</li> <li>Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost</li> <li>Are curious about supporting AI-assisted development safely - no AI specialism required</li> </ul> <p>Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.</p> <p><strong>Our Tech Stack</strong></p> <p>We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.</p> <p>You don't need to know all of it. We don't expect proficiency in every part of this stack. title: Control & Estimation Intern
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware. Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions. Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment. Candidates Requirements Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus. Technical skills : Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus. Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink. BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces. EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads. Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation. Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary. Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers. Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification) : ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms. Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium). Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug. Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed. Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership. title: Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Project Manager (f/m/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-teams="true">PHENOGY AG is a leading innovator of battery energy storage technologies and solutions for the green electrification of the planet. Our team members work on future-proof and sustainable battery systems that are powerful, safe, and robust – with circularity as a central principle. Our technology partner network spans leading battery research institutes. PHENOGY is an environmentally and socially conscious enterprise. We are committed to fostering prosperity for the people and our planet, ensuring sustainable growth – starting in the area of our greatest expertise and impact: energy storage solutions.</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><strong>We energize the future.</strong></span></p> <div class="content-intro"> <p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">PHENOGY is seeking curious, entrepreneurial-minded energy pioneers to help shape our vision, systems, and growth; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re inspired by our mission, values, and drive to change how we energize the future — we’d love your application.</span></p> </div></div><p>Purpose/Mission - The role owns the infrastructure, network and cybersecurity workstream for</p> <ul> <li>PHENOGY's corporate IT infrastructure (cloud, network, endpoints, identities and access) and its interfaces with the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) product environment. It translates business, product, operational, customer and regulatory requirements into secure, resilient and auditable infrastructure and security controls across the BESS lifecycle.</li> <li>Cybersecurity governance and the Information Security Management System (ISO/IEC 27001)</li> <li>Security architecture of BESS connectivity (EMS, BMS, gateways, IoT, APIs) and secure data exchange with partners such as Heidelberg</li> <li>Backup, business continuity and disaster recovery for critical systems (BESS/EMS, ERP, CRM)</li> <li>Project management of infrastructure and cybersecurity projects</li> </ul> <p>Your Tasks & Responsibilities</p> <ul> <li>Act as internal-facing and technical owner of the IT infrastructure and security landscape: network, firewalling and web filtering, Microsoft 365/Azure tenants, identity and access management, endpoints, backup, and secure remote/supplier access to BESS sites.</li> <li>Maintain the asset and configuration inventory, network and security architecture documentation, risk register, vulnerability backlog, security policies and the infrastructure/security roadmap.</li> <li>Run the risk management and vulnerability management cycle: periodic assessments, prioritisation, patching and remediation tracking across IT systems, applications, APIs and BESS connectivity.</li> <li>Define and operate security monitoring, incident response, escalation paths, maintenance windows and problem management, together with external service providers (MSP/MSSP).</li> <li>Define backup and retention policies (daily, monthly, yearly; 10+ years for critical data), offline/immutable backups, disaster-recovery runbooks and regular restore and DR tests.</li> <li>Define secure segmentation between corporate IT and the OT/BESS environment and secure remote access for O&M and field service, aligned with IEC 62443 concepts.</li> <li>Provide infrastructure, system-integration and cybersecurity support to the After Sales & Service framework once operational responsibility moves to the Service Manager.</li> <li>Support B2B customer and audit requests: security questionnaires, tender requirements and compliance evidence.</li> <li>Hands on when required: configure firewall rules, endpoint and identity policies, backup jobs and cloud security settings.</li> </ul> <p>Key Projects (2027 portfolio)</p> <ul> <li>Risk Management & Vulnerability Assessment (Jan–Feb 2027): assess risks and vulnerabilities across all systems and deliver a prioritised remediation plan.</li> <li>BESS Security Architecture II (Jan–Mar 2027): secure the BESS architecture and data exchange with Heidelberg, building on the current BESS security baseline.</li> <li>Business Continuity & Recovery System (Feb–Apr 2027): offline backup and disaster recovery for critical systems such as BESS/EMS, ERP and CRM.</li> <li>Network Improvements (Feb–Jun 2027): introduce firewalling and web filtering, which are not yet in place.</li> <li>Advanced Threat Protection – ISO 27001 (Mar–May 2027): protect network and application traffic, including APIs and IP-based access.</li> <li>ISO 27001 Enhancements (ongoing): close control gaps, maintain policies and evidence, and prepare for audits.</li> <li>Take over operation of granular backup and advanced endpoint management, and provide security input to the PHENOGY IoT solution POC (BMS/EMS communication and REST APIs).</li> </ul> <p>Core Competencies</p> <ul> <li>Lead assigned infrastructure and cybersecurity projects from initiation through closure, using structured scope, schedule, budget, dependency, risk, issue, decision and change control.</li> <li>Create project charters, work breakdown structures, delivery plans, security requirements, test and DR-test plans, cutover plans, acceptance records and handover packages to operations.</li> <li>Coordinate external suppliers (MSP/MSSP, network and firewall vendors, cloud providers, BESS/EMS partners) to resolve cross-functional blockers and escalate material decisions to the Head of IT and relevant governance bodies.</li> <li>Provide concise status reporting on progress, milestones, risk posture, vulnerabilities, incidents, suppliers and compliance.</li> </ul> <p>Required Qualifications & Experience</p> <ul> <li>Degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, computer science, information security, engineering or a related discipline.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity management, including responsibility for delivering projects, ideally in an international mid-sized company.</li> <li>Practical experience with network security (firewalls, VPN, segmentation, web filtering, IDS/IPS), Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / Intune / Defender, and backup and disaster recovery.</li> <li>Experience running risk assessments, vulnerability management and security incident response.</li> <li>Hands-on experience implementing or maintaining an ISMS according to ISO/IEC 27001.</li> <li>Experience coordinating technical suppliers and multidisciplinary stakeholders across business, IT and engineering.</li> <li>Ability to understand operational technology and industrial-system boundaries without assuming ownership of safety engineering or embedded-control design.</li> <li>Strong documentation, risk management and executive-status reporting skills.</li> <li>Professional English; German or another relevant operating language is an advantage.</li> </ul> <p>Strongly preferred</p> <ul> <li>Experience securing Battery Energy Storage Systems, EMS, BMS, SCADA, PLC, PCS/inverters, industrial gateways, IoT or energy-data platforms.</li> <li>Working knowledge of IEC 62443, NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act in mixed IT/OT environments.</li> <li>Experience with Azure networking and security, Microsoft Sentinel / Defender XDR and enterprise firewall platforms (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point).</li> <li>Familiarity with industrial protocols and secure integration patterns, including Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, API gateways and certificate/PKI management.</li> <li>Experience with backup and DR solutions for cloud and hybrid environments, including immutable and offline backups.</li> <li>Recognized credentials such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, PMP, PRINCE2 or ITIL are advantageous</li> </ul> <p>Decision-making authority: Approves infrastructure and security changes, firewall and access rules and security exceptions within the agreed policy framework and budget; may isolate systems or accounts during a security incident; escalates risk acceptance and major investments to the Head of IT.</p> <p>Reporting Line: Reporting to Head of IT Direct reports: none (functional lead of external infrastructure and security providers)</p> <p>Workload: 100% - Hybrid</p> <p>Travel: approx. 10% – PHENOGY offices, BESS customer sites and partner/supplier sites as required</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><strong>We offer you:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Join a high-caliber environment that enables you to develop your full potential, shape your job, and take ownership.</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Participate in the development of PHENOGY and inspire the world to transition to sustainable energy.</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Become part of our eco-passionate expert team - a first-class team all around. </span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Benefit from flexible work hours as well as remote and on-site working in a modern sustainable office</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Enjoy various events, an amazing coffee machine, and the occasional coffee from our CEO (acting Barista)</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">At PHENOGY, we highly value diversity, equality, and inclusion. It makes our company stronger. <strong>Our philosophy: one mindset, many minds.</strong></span></p> <p> </p> <h6><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">For recruitment and staffing agencies: PHENOGY works exclusively with selected recruitment partners under formal agreements. </span></span><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from agencies and assume no liability for claims made by unauthorized recruiters regarding our recruitment processes.</span></span></h6></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior IT Engineer
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Mission Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount. The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite. Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to 2-3 days a month on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next. Scope ⚙️ Platform & automation Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices 🔑 Identity & access Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem. Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack 🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope 🩺 Health Professionals IT The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process 🌍 Internationalisation Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one Bring acquired entities onto that same platform Milestones First 3 months Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment Join title: Technical Marketing Engineer
description: The role Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories. You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market. Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications. This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams. Your mission Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable. You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it. The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate. What you will do Drive technical co-builds with partners Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept. Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks. Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure. Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories. Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets. Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility. Produce technical marketing content Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives. Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations. Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets. Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember. Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity. Build for the audience Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work. Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype. Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance. Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology. Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication. What we are looking for A strong engineering background The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred. Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems. Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video. A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation. Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value. Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams. The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept. Excellent written and spoken English. This role may suit you if You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing. You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value. You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market. You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems. You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message. This role is probably not for you if Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations. You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it. You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete. You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes. How the role complements Product Marketing Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity. The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content. Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities. Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos. Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance. Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams. title: Venture Development
description: About Tacto Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision. Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto ~110 people on the team in Munich €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others Our mission at Tacto We make industry stronger. Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work. Your role You build the teams that build Tacto, working directly with our CEO and Chief of Staff. Why this role exists We are entering our next growth phase in the AGI age: new markets, new teams and the structures that carry them. Almost all of it runs through people: who we hire, how we set up teams and the culture of ambition we protect. As a Venture Developer, you own several hiring pipelines across functions, from Sales to Tech to Customer Value, and you help make Tacto the place where the best talent in Europe wants to work. Our own AI agents do much of the searching and first outreach, so about half of your week goes to what only people get to do: speaking to talent, judging fit and giving every candidate a great experience. You work directly with André (CEO) and Marla (Chief of Staff). Why your role matters You decide who gets in. You run the first interviews and shape which candidates our hiring managers meet. Every person you move forward can shape a team at Tacto for years. Talent is our biggest lever in building a generational company. You see every part of the company. You interact with Sales, Tech and Customer Value roles and learn fast what great looks like in each. AI does the groundwork, you bring the judgement. Our agents search, score and write to candidates. You decide where they look, check what they find and raise their bar. You grow as fast as you deliver. 70%+ of our leadership team was promoted internally. After your first year, you shape your own path: in Talent, Ops, Tech or in a commercial role. What your week looks like Interviews: about 40% Steering and reviewing sourcing: about 20% Candidate communication and scheduling: about 10% Events, campaigns, merch and employer branding: about 20% Other: about 10% What this role is and isn’t Hands on: The first 9 to 12 months are about execution: many interviews and candidate calls, clean pipelines and events that run smoothly. It's not always glamorous, but some of the highest leverage work at Tacto and that's how we like it. Not a closing role: Offers and final negotiations sit with our Chief of Staff and the hiring managers. Your job is to bring the right people to the final round, with a clear picture of who they are and making sure that everybody is aligned to provide the best possible candidate experience we can. Not a strategy role: Those don’t exist at Tacto. It is also not a short stop: we look for people who want to grow here. Where you want to grow and into which direction you want to take your career is up to you to define. The deal: Prove yourself with real impact, and we back your growth in every way we can. Your tasks Own your pipelines and build the org: You own a few open roles at a time, often in very different teams. You agree with each hiring manager on who we are looking for and keep the pipeline moving until the final interview. Interview and assess: You run first interviews, judge fit against a clear bar and give hiring managers a sharp recommendation. Orchestrate sourcing: Our AI skills search, score and write to candidates. You decide where they look, review what they find and source yourself where it counts. Turn candidates into fans: You make our process fast, personal and honest, from the first message to the final interview. Even the people we say no to should walk away telling their friends to apply. Build a base that scales: You set up job descriptions, interview plans, pipelines and data that let us grow the team without losing speed or quality. What you build today is how Tacto hires tomorrow. Shape how Tacto shows up: You help run our talent events, from hackathons and university partnerships to invite-only dinners and Lunch & Learns, plus campaigns, merch and employer branding. Grow into company building: Once the basics run, you take on additional projects with our Chief of Staff. Your path is yours to define in this role and you will receive all the support needed to make it happen. Your profile Experience and skills Experience: Ideally 1 to 2 years of work experience, but not required High bar: You’ve seen what great looks like, through an internship or role at a top startup, in consulting or in VC AI native: You already use AI in your daily work and want to build with it, not just use it Languages: Fluent German and English Core strengths People intuition: You read people fast, connect easily and build trust Storyteller: You sell a vision and get others excited to join it Hands on: You solve problems yourself instead of only talking about them Hungry and fast: You get energy from moving fast and seeing results Curious about company building: You want to understand how companies grow and can see yourself in Talent or org building long term You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway. Our values No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way. We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from. Merit matters: Results count, not titles. Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard. Real passion: Grit and ownership. Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing. Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously. Caring is key: We help each other grow. What we offer What to expect Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try. Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step. Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events, for example with Andreas Klinger, Judith Dada or at large hackathons. All events: luma.com/tacto Benefits €1,500+ learning budget per year 26 + 4 days of vacation €300 childcare allowance per child EGYM Wellpass JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets Company pension plan and discounts How you apply Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step. Intro Call , 20 min, with the People Team Hiring Manager Interview , 30 min, with Marla (Chief of Staff) Mini Task , 30 min prep + 30 min call, with Marla Onsite Case and Meet the Team , 4-5h prep + 1.5h at our office, with Marla, André, and two people from the team Equal opportunity and data protection Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation. Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material. Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans. Why It Matters Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives. But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech. What We Offer The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day.
