title: HR Operations Specialist, APAC (Full-time)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What You Would Do Here:</strong></p> <p>Our focus is getting the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented People Operations Specialist to join our team and champion this mission within the APJC region. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for our employees, ensuring their journey is smooth and positive. You will be instrumental in creating a seamless experience by resolving inquiries, managing data with precision, and ensuring our People processes are efficient and effective. This is an exciting opportunity to provide exceptional support to our internal teams and contribute to building a world-class employee experience as our organization expands.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Champion key employee lifecycle process:</strong> Take ownership of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes across APJC, including onboarding, internal transfers, organizational changes, and offboarding, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and positive experience for employees throughout the APJC region.</li> <li><strong>Be a subject-matter expert for employee inquiries:</strong> Provide timely, high-quality support to employee inquiries through Zendesk. Act as a trusted liaison between employees and People/Payroll teams, resolving issues efficiently with empathy and accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the employee experience through cross-functional collaboration:</strong> Act as a proactive liaison between employees and specialized teams such as Payroll, Benefits, and Legal to address and resolve complex issues efficiently and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Ensure data integrity and governance: </strong>Maintain and update employee records across People/Payroll systems, performing regular and ad hoc audits to guarantee 100% data accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements.</li> <li><strong>Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence:</strong> Analyze employee feedback and process metrics to identify opportunities for process enhancements. Partner with regional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve the overall People Operations function across APJC.</li> <li><strong>Support strategic HR initiatives and projects:</strong> Contribute to HR system implementations, vendor management, and regional programs such as annual performance and compensation cycles, benefits enrollment, and year-end Payroll preparation, making them easy to understand and navigate for our employees.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills/experience</strong> </p> <ul> <li>5+ years in HR administration and comfortable handling sensitive employee information with discretion.</li> <li>Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills. </li> <li>Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.</li> <li>Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.</li> <li>Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.</li> <li>Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.</li> <li>Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Team Lead (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. You'll use candidate experience data to surface patterns and risks to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement, and partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global process. At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead Candidate Experience Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.</li> <li value="2">Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.</li> <li value="3">Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.</li> <li value="4">Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate interviews, prepare offers and employment contracts, manage background and reference checks, and partner with People Operations on the handoff to onboarding.</li> <li value="6">Build and maintain reporting on candidate satisfaction, specialist response times, scheduling turnaround, and data accuracy to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and risks.</li> <li value="7">Partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.</li> <li value="2">Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.</li> <li value="3">Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.</li> <li value="4">Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.</li> <li value="6">Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.</li> <li value="7">Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including executives, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and time zones.</li> <li value="8">Proficiency with an applicant tracking system or interview tool for scheduling, tracking, and stage management, plus Google Workspace and scheduling tools, and a willingness to learn additional tools. Greenhouse and ModernLoop experience is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our Candidate Experience team supports candidates through interview coordination, offers and contracts, background and reference checks, and the transition to onboarding. As regional leads and specialists, we partner with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations to deliver a consistent global candidate experience. We work across time zones, using transparent documentation in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories to collaborate asynchronously. Our regional leads work together to resolve process differences and bring regional evidence into global improvements.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: CDI - Senior Platform Engineer - Paris

nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.</p> </li> <li> <p>Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Profil description: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Activités et responsabilités</strong></p> <p>Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.</p> <p>Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.</p> </li> <li> <p>Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li> <p>Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.</p> </li> <li> <p>Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</p> </li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.</p> </li> <li> <p>FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une certification cloud.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.</p> <p>Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.</p> <p>Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : serving de modèles, observabilité des agents, sécurité de l’IA, avec l’appui de la communauté Platform Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Platform Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).</p> <p>Une spécialisation en sécurité de l’IA (red teaming, guardrails, conformité à l’AI Act) est possible : elle relève aujourd’hui de l’archétype Platform Engineer. Plus tard, un rôle transverse s’ouvre (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), et les Platform Engineers seniors peuvent rejoindre le chapter AI Architect.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Processus de recrutement</strong></p> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li> <p><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</p> </li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Global Operations Excellence
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><strong>Role overview:</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Director, Global Operations Excellence</strong> will be responsible for leading Operational Excellence, standardisation, transformation, and continuous improvement across the Sony Interactive Entertainment global supply chain.</p> <p>Working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, this senior leader will oversee a team of Lean experts and Operational Excellence business standardisation specialists, ensuring SIE Operations continues to improve service quality, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and deliver consistent, high-performing operational practices across all regions.</p> <p>Reporting into Global Operations, this role will act as a key transformation leader across the Operations division, partnering with Logistics, Warehousing, Planning, Transportation, Finance, Procurement, Commercial, D2C, Customer Service, and regional Operations teams to drive measurable improvements across cost, service, process maturity, and customer experience.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the global Operations Excellence agenda for SIE, defining and executing a transformation roadmap focused on standardisation, Lean capability, service partner development, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Oversee the Operations Lean Kaizen Office, driving Lean transformation activities across operational functions, including Kaizen events, value stream mapping, Gemba practices, waste reduction, cost improvement, and operational performance improvement.</li> <li>Lead the development of global operational standards, ensuring SIE delivers a consistent, high-quality service experience to customers, retailers, commercial partners, and internal stakeholders across all markets.</li> <li>Act as the central point for translating commercial, customer, and business requirements into operational solutions, ensuring requests are clearly assessed, prioritized, and converted into realistic delivery plans.</li> <li>Lead global service partner development, including strategic tender activity, performance improvement, and commercial governance across warehousing 3PLs, control tower 4PLs, transportation partners, and other key Operations service providers.</li> <li>Oversee centralised budgetary analysis across Operations, supporting visibility, control, and governance of OPEX and CAPEX activities across the global supply chain.</li> <li>Generate data-driven insights into operational performance, ways of working, service quality, cost drivers, and customer impact, using these insights to shape strategic and continuous improvement initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key areas of focus:</strong></p> <p>Service Partner Development</p> <ul> <li>Lead global Operations tender activity across key warehousing 3PL, control tower 4PL, transportation, and logistics service partners.</li> <li>Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and regional Operations teams to ensure tender processes are commercially robust and operationally aligned.</li> <li>Support service partner strategy, performance management, governance, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Provide budgetary oversight and centralised analysis of OPEX and CAPEX spend across Operations.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to improve partner performance, cost efficiency, service delivery, and operational scalability.</li> </ul> <p>Lean Transformation: Operations Lean Kaizen Office</p> <ul> <li>Lead the Operations Lean Kaizen Office as the centre of excellence for Lean transformation across SIE Operations.</li> <li>Drive Lean continuous improvement activities across all operational areas.</li> <li>Support weekly and monthly S&OE practices, ensuring continuous improvement is embedded into operational routines and decision-making.</li> <li>Lead and support Kaizen events, value stream mapping, Gemba walks, process diagnostics, and waste reduction initiatives.</li> <li>Deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, service quality, process flow, and operational performance.</li> <li>Build Lean capability across teams through coaching, standards, tools, and practical application.</li> </ul> <p>Distribution Excellence</p> <ul> <li>Oversee global operational standardisation across distribution, warehousing, transportation, and fulfilment practices.</li> <li>Ensure SIE delivers one consistent, high level of operational service excellence to its global customer base.</li> <li>Develop data-driven insights into how operational practices impact customers, commercial outcomes, cost, and service performance.</li> <li>Act as the central funnel point for commercial and customer requests, translating business needs into operational realities.</li> <li>Identify global best practices and scale them across regions, partners, and operational functions.</li> <li>Establish performance metrics, governance forums, and improvement roadmaps to drive accountability and progress.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>15+ years’ experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Operational Excellence, Lean Transformation, or a related global leadership role.</li> <li>Proven experience leading Operational Excellence, Lean, continuous improvement, or business transformation programs.</li> <li>Strong understanding of global supply chain operations, including warehousing, transportation, distribution, 3PL/4PL management, and operational governance.</li> <li>Experience leading or supporting global tenders, service partner development, and supplier performance improvement.</li> <li>Strong financial acumen, with experience overseeing or analyzing OPEX, CAPEX, cost performance, and budgetary controls.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience with Lean tools and methodologies, including Kaizen, value stream mapping, Gemba, standard work, waste reduction, and continuous improvement routines.</li> <li>Strong ability to translate commercial and customer requirements into operational plans and scalable processes.</li> <li>Excellent leadership skills, with experience managing high-performing teams of specialists or transformation experts.</li> <li>Strong analytical capability, with the ability to turn operational data into strategic insight and measurable improvement.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management skills across Operations, Finance, Procurement, Commercial, Customer Service, and regional leadership teams.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.</p> <p protection rights.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p><em>Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.</em></p> <p><em>We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. description: <h2 class="sc-1npqnwg-4 sc-1npqnwg-5 sc-1uwf3m5-0 ghXWGq custom-css-style-job-description">Job description</h2> <p><strong>Team & Reporting Line:</strong> Program Management Team | Reports to Lead Project & Procurement Manager</p> <p class="Paragraph SCXW53634494 BCX8"><span style="color: rgb(61, 116, 204);"><strong>Our Mission</strong> </span></p> <p>At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth – where, when and at scale. You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality, and operations, helping to shape how we build and deliver software in a fast-moving, mission-critical space environment.</p> <p>The PQA team defines and maintains the company’s quality and Product Assurance standards. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring our software meets the highest levels of robustness, compliance, and reliability, supporting mission success in both orbit and ground operations.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who thrives in complex, technical environments, enjoys working across disciplines, and is comfortable balancing structured quality processes with the pace of a rapidly scaling space organisation. You will be trusted to take end-to-end ownership, bring clarity to ambiguity, and help embed strong engineering discipline across the software lifecycle.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(61, 116, 204);"><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></span></p> <ul> <li> <p>Develop, implement, and continuously improve a robust Software Product Assurance (PA) programme, reporting directly to the Product Assurance Manager.</p> </li> <li> <p>Take end-to-end ownership of Software Product Assurance across both flight and ground software for our satellite constellation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ensure rigorous application of software configuration management and release processes, maintaining strong version control, traceability, and engineering discipline.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enforce compliance with safety-critical and mission-critical software standards, with a strong focus on risk reduction and failure prevention.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define and oversee software testing, verification, and validation strategies across all development and delivery phases.</p> </li> <li> <p>Investigate, manage, and resolve software anomalies throughout development, testing, integration, and operational phases.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support Spacecraft Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT) activities, ensuring software readiness and compliance at every stage.</p> </li> <li> <p>Coordinate and lead software deliveries from suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal standards, schedules, and quality expectations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Participate in subcontractor reviews and key technical title: Client Delivery Lead (f/m/d)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Kraken Customer What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 🏠 Where you'll fit in: You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects. The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms...) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client. 🚀 What you'll own: You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners) You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform. Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have. This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role. We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation. You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. title: Platform Engineer
description: Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer . Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform. Jouw rol Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten. Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting. Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties. Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden. Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht. Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform. Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes. Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau . Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code . Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact. Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.500,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om goed uit te rusten en op te laden. Werkplek & Sfeer: Een gezellige werksfeer op ons kantoor in Hilversum met flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor. Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan. Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst. Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen en trainingen om te blijven groeien, plus een jaarlijks Coolblue thuiswerkbudget van € 500,- om je werkplek perfect in te richten. Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen. Denk aan de zorg, educatie, duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud. We bouwen software die logisch voelt. Precies dat maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis. We zoeken de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken elkaar. Benieuwd naar de sfeer bij Dawn Technology? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast . Solliciteren Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 . Have a great day. Dawn Technology. We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen Infrastructure Automation & Architecture) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Responsable d'offres techniques (F/H)
description: Nous recherchons un Responsable d’offres techniques (F/H) en CDI pour venir renforcer nos équipes HEMERIA SERVICES au sein de notre division LAND & SEA sur Villebon-Sur-Yvette. Au cœur de notre développement, vous pilotez la construction de nos offres techniques et commerciales, de l’analyse du besoin client jusqu’à la remise de la proposition. En lien étroit avec le Bureau d’Études, les ingénieurs et les équipes commerciales, vous contribuez aux choix techniques, à la qualité des réponses et au développement de nouvelles offres. Missions : Construire et piloter les offres techniques Analyser les cahiers des charges, les spécifications clients et les dossiers de consultation afin d’identifier les besoins, les exigences, les contraintes et les risques. Rédiger les offres techniques et les mémoires techniques en vous appuyant sur les membres du Bureau d’Études (BE), les ingénieurs spécialistes et les experts métiers. Piloter la définition des solutions techniques proposées et décider des orientations de réponse, en tenant compte de la faisabilité, des performances attendues, des coûts, des délais et des engagements contractuels. Mobiliser les ingénieurs et les contributeurs internes pour challenger les solutions, instruire les points techniques et construire des réponses robustes et différenciantes. Consolider les spécifications techniques, les données d’entrée, les architectures et les nomenclatures complètes (BOM) afin de garantir la cohérence et l’exhaustivité des propositions. Coordonner les contributeurs et sécuriser les jalons Organiser et suivre les revues d’offres ainsi que les différents jalons de préparation et de remise, en étroite collaboration avec le responsable commercial. Assurer la coordination entre les équipes techniques, le BE, les ingénieurs, les experts métiers et les interlocuteurs commerciaux. Anticiper les points de blocage, identifier les risques et suivre les actions nécessaires au respect des échéances. Contribuer à la consolidation des chiffrages et vérifier la cohérence technico-économique des propositions et des engagements pris. Améliorer les méthodes et les outils de chiffrage Proposer et piloter l’amélioration des outils de chiffrage, notamment automatisés, afin d’accélérer le flux de traitement et de remise des offres. Identifier les possibilités d’automatisation, de standardisation et de capitalisation des données techniques et économiques. Fiabiliser les méthodes et les référentiels utilisés pour gagner en rapidité, en qualité et en répétabilité dans la construction des offres. Développer de nouvelles offres produits et services Être force de proposition dans la conception de nouvelles offres de services et de produits, en lien avec les équipes d’ingénierie, les experts et le commerce. Identifier les opportunités de valorisation des savoir-faire de l’entreprise et contribuer à la diversification de ses propositions. Participer à la structuration de solutions techniques et commerciales innovantes, adaptées aux besoins émergents des clients et aux évolutions des marchés. Profil : Formation supérieure technique (école d’ingénieur ou équivalent), ou expérience significative permettant de maîtriser des environnements techniques. Expérience dans la construction, la rédaction et le pilotage d’offres techniques, idéalement dans un environnement industriel, technologique ou de systèmes complexes. Bonne connaissance du secteur de la Défense et aisance dans des environnements à fortes exigences de criticité. Une expérience dans l’aéronautique, le naval, le spatial ou les industries sensibles sera également appréciée. Capacité à comprendre et challenger des solutions techniques, à exploiter des spécifications et à consolider des nomenclatures. Aptitude à mobiliser des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à faire travailler ensemble des interlocuteurs aux expertises variées. Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et capacité à piloter plusieurs offres en parallèle avec des échéances parfois contraintes. Appétence pour l’amélioration des processus, l’automatisation et les outils de chiffrage. Vous êtes curieux(se), dynamique et force de proposition. Vous êtes à l’aise dans les échanges avec les ingénieurs, les experts métiers, les équipes commerciales et les responsables opérationnels. Vous savez prendre du recul, challenger les solutions et arbitrer les orientations de réponse dans votre périmètre. Vous appréciez les environnements collaboratifs dans lesquels l’autonomie, l’initiative et le sens du collectif sont essentiels. Localisation : Possibilité d'occuper le poste depuis Toulouse, avec des déplacements réguliers à prévoir à Villebon-sur-Yvette, à raison de 2 à 3 jours par semaine. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Des projets passionnants et stratégiques : des sujets technologiques variés dans les univers Terre, Mer, Air et Spatial, avec des applications concrètes dans des environnements exigeants. Une équipe jeune et dynamique : une équipe engagée, portée par la collaboration, l’initiative et l’envie de progresser. Un management de proximité : des managers accessibles et impliqués, qui favorisent les échanges directs, l’autonomie et la prise d’initiative. Une entreprise en croissance : une dynamique de développement soutenue depuis cinq ans, offrant la possibilité de contribuer directement à la structuration et à l’évolution de l’entreprise. Un environnement stimulant en région parisienne : un poste au contact direct des équipes d’ingénierie et commerciales, au cœur des projets et des décisions. 🌟 NOS AVANTAGES : 💼 Avantages sociaux : mutuelle gratuite et familiale, tickets restaurant, participation et intéressement. 🕐 Organisation flexible : horaires aménageables pour un meilleur équilibre vie pro / perso. 🚀 Évolution & formation : mobilité interne, parcours personnalisés et accompagnement de carrière. 🌿 Qualité de vie au travail : compte épargne-temps, droit à la déconnexion, etc. 🤝 Prime de cooptation pour valoriser vos recommandations. description: TYTAN Technologies The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems to join our Platform Team. Our interceptors fly autonomous missions from launch to intercept. Before a software change flies in the air, we want to see it fly on the bench: the real mission computer and flight controller, flying a full simulated mission in real time against simulated physics, sensors and targets. We are taking our hardware-in-the-loop testing to full closed-loop missions, and you lead that build. You are a builder, not a test author. You design the rigs, couple the simulation to the hardware, and build the framework so that our autonomy and perception engineers write and run their own HIL scenarios on every change. Your roadmap to make an impact The closed loop: Couple real-time physics, sensor and target simulation to real flight hardware. Inject IMU, GNSS, camera and other sensor data at the interface the hardware expects, close the loop on actuator commands, and keep latency, jitter and time synchronisation within budget, so a flight on the rig behaves like a flight in the air. Fault injection: Sensor failures, GNSS denial and spoofing, link loss, bus errors and power faults, reproducible on demand. System rigs: Rigs for the current and next generation mission computer and for full system configurations with ground station, radio link and interceptors. Provisioned as code, with automated deployment of builds, remote power control, health monitoring and self-recovery. HIL in CI: Merge-gating regression suites, nightly and long-running mission suites, rig scheduling across pipelines, flaky test detection, and structured results traceable to requirements. Test framework: Fixtures for devices, instruments and simulators, so that a domain engineer writes a HIL test as easily as a unit test, and the same scenario runs in SIL and HIL. HIL as a product: Your users are our autonomy, perception and systems engineers. Availability and time to result are your metrics, also in restricted and air-gapped lab networks. 4+ years building HIL or hardware test systems for embedded or autonomous systems, including at least one closed-loop rig you designed and built yourself, not only operated or wrote test cases for Real-time simulation coupled to hardware: plant and sensor models running in real time against real hardware, on commercial HIL platforms or custom Linux-based rigs Expert Python, plus C or C++ for real-time components Strong Linux and CI: self-hosted runners with hardware in the loop, containerised test environments, device management, remote power and console control Debugging across the hardware and software boundary: embedded interfaces such as CAN, UART, SPI and Ethernet, and timing problems you have measured, not guessed Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience Nice to haves Flight or vehicle dynamics models, and PX4 or ArduPilot SITL/HITL HIL platforms such as dSPACE, NI PXI/VeriStand or Speedgoat Sensor stimulation at the hardware interface: IMU, GNSS, camera and video injection Time synchronisation (e.g. PTP), real-time Linux and jitter measurement Test frameworks at scale (pytest or Robot Framework) and instrument control via SCPI or VISA FMI/FMU or Gazebo-based simulation MAVLink and flight controller interfaces GNSS simulators (e.g. Spirent, Safran Skydel) and RF environment simulation Camera and image generation pipelines for perception testing Requirements-based testing in DO-178C or ISO 26262 contexts Rust for performance-critical test components Firmware for test fixtures on microcontrollers End-of-line test stations Why TYTAN? title: Director of Industrialisation
description: Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence. Getting complex hardware through development and into flight is one challenge. Building the industrial capability to deliver it repeatedly, at the required quality and rate, is another. We’re looking for a Director of Industrialisation to lead that work in Germany. You’ll take a greenfield manufacturing site from an empty floor to sustained series production. You’ll shape the facility, decide what we build in-house, bring in the equipment and people, and lead the ramp until the operation can deliver reliably. Your job starts while the product is still taking shape, when the right manufacturing decision can save months of work later. We’re looking for someone who’s done this before and wants to build again. You’ll work directly with the founders and with Engineering, Programmes, Quality, Supply Chain and Operations. You’ll be close enough to the floor to see where the plan is breaking down, and senior enough to make the decisions that fix it. What you’ll do Own the industrialisation plan. Translate programme demand into a plan for capacity, capital investment, people and suppliers. Set milestones from facility readiness through pilot builds and production ramp, and make the trade-offs visible when timelines or assumptions change. Build and commission the operation. Define what the site needs to support, shape the layout and material flow, and lead equipment selection, installation and commissioning. Plan how the operation will expand as demand grows. Bring manufacturing into product decisions early. Work with Engineering to make the hardware practical to build, inspect and test. Bring evidence from the floor into design reviews, and agree how changes will be introduced as the design matures. Decide what to make and what to buy. Work with Supply Chain to establish which capabilities we need to own, where specialist suppliers make sense, and how we qualify and scale those suppliers alongside our own production. Take pilot builds into repeatable production. Use early builds to expose what will limit output. Resolve bottlenecks, improve yield and build consistency, and demonstrate that the operation can sustain its target rate across successive builds. Build the team and the way it works. Hire the people who will establish the operation. Give them clear ownership, develop leaders on the floor, and put in place the training and routines that let the team solve problems as production grows. Own manufacturing readiness. Define the evidence needed before increasing the rate, from process capability and trained operators to supplier readiness, inspection and traceability. Work with Quality and Safety to build those requirements into everyday work. Make the hard calls. Decide where automation earns its place, where a simpler process gets us there sooner, and where to commit capital before all the answers are in. Give leadership a clear view of what’s on track, what’s at risk and what decision is needed. Who you are You’ve personally led a greenfield site or a major production operation built from scratch, through commissioning and into sustained series or volume production. You can tell us what existed on day one, what you owned and what the operation was delivering once it ramped. You’ve industrialised complex hardware while the design was still evolving. You know how to keep engineering and manufacturing moving together when a design change affects tooling, suppliers, inspection or the delivery plan. You’ve made consequential capital, capacity and staffing decisions. You can explain what you committed to early, what you deliberately kept flexible and how those choices played out. You’ve lived through a difficult ramp. You can talk us through a target you missed, how you found the real constraint, what you changed and what happened to output, yield, cost or delivery as a result. You’ve built and led teams across disciplines. You can earn the trust of operators, technicians and engineers, challenge a design decision with evidence, and explain a manufacturing trade-off to the founders in plain language. You know how to build at pace in a demanding hardware environment. You put the controls that matter in place early, and keep decisions close to the people doing the work. You’re motivated by the opportunity to build industrial capability for European defence, and you want to be on site with the team doing it. Where you might have done it You might have launched a new factory in automotive, built a production operation at a hardware startup, or taken an aerospace or advanced manufacturing product from low-rate builds to series production. You could have done it inside a larger company if you had the mandate to build the operation and were personally accountable for the ramp.The common thread is the build itself. We want to hear about the operation you created, how quickly you brought it online, the rate it sustained and the decisions you made when the original plan met reality. What we offer Genuine ownership of the industrialisation of one of Europe’s most ambitious defence engineering programmes, from an empty site to sustained series production. The chance to join early enough that your decisions will shape the factory, the team and how Hypersonica manufactures for years to come. Direct access to the founders and the factory floor, with short decision paths and the authority to act when you see a better way to build. Daily collaboration with exceptional people across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test and Programmes. You’ll have a seat at the table while the product is still taking shape. The freedom to challenge convention and build from first principles, from what we make in-house to where automation earns its place. The resources and ambition to build a production operation at a pace that would be hard to match in a traditional aerospace organisation. The chance to see your decisions through, from the first factory layout on a whiteboard to hardware coming off a line that delivers reliably, shift after shift. At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Network Deployment Engineer - APJC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4><strong>Available Locations: Singapore or Sydney</strong></h4> <h4><strong>About the Team</strong></h4> <p>In this role, you will be focused on the build out and expansion of our global network. This is a highly visible position that requires deep technical understanding of datacenter infrastructure, physical and logical network configuration, system administration, server provisioning and troubleshooting, and basic experience with data analysis and project management.</p> <p>To be successful in this position, you should have excellent technical skills, communication skills, and be able to navigate a range of challenges and constraints (e.g. schedule adherence, time zones, and cultures). facility power (AC/DC), cooling, security/access, rack layout and cable management.</li> <li>Providing technical leadership and guidance to remote contractors and junior team members during deployment activities—walking them through configurations, troubleshooting steps, and quality checks.</li> <li>Creating and maintaining documentation, plans, SOPs, MOPs and runbooks.</li> <li>Collaborating with support of physical network expansion.</li> <li>Assisting with the definition, documentation and implementation of consistent processes and standardization across all regions.</li> <li>Limited travel.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience in Data Center Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Linux Systems Administration, Network Engineering, and/or DevOps experience.</li> <li>Familiarity with day-to-day tasks and projects common in Data Center Operations.</li> <li>Experience with optical transport technologies such as CWDM/DWDM.</li> <li>Configuration management tool experience like Saltstack, Chef, Puppet or Ansible.</li> <li>Knowledge and exposure to Network Protocols, Topologies and Enterprise architecture. </li> <li>Experience writing network configuration and design documentation.</li> <li>Experience with network and server installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.</li> <li>Experience with remote "lights-out" and out-of-band access to data center resources (IPMI/BMC for remote server administration).</li> <li>Experience solving problems through automation, writing Python or Bash scripts for internal tools and workflow improvements.</li> <li>Experience running and improving operational processes in a rapidly changing environment.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. Must be proactive in performing due diligence, e.g. checking for blockers before executing work, spotting patterns in failures or process improvements.</li> <li>Experience building or working with agentic AI tools for workflow automation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, MIS, or a related field is a plus.</li> <li>Direct experience executing on datacenter / infrastructure projects with many moving parts.</li> <li>Experience installing / maintaining datacenter (and other IT) infrastructure and DCIM tools.</li> <li>Experience running and improving operational processes in a rapidly changing environment.</li> <li>Understanding of BGP and anycast routing.</li> <li>Good working knowledge of major networking and optical device OS such as Juniper Junos, Cisco IOS, Cisco NX-OS, Arista EOS, SONiC, Ciena, Nokia (Infinera).</li> <li>Proficient in one or more programming languages and willing to learn new ones when required.</li> <li>Ability to write scripts for internal tools and automation workflows.</li> <li>Ability to learn fast and execute on multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining quality.</li> <li>Ability to manage MS Excel and Google Spreadsheets.</li> <li>Comfortable handling basic program management responsibilities (prioritization, planning, scheduling, status reporting) using tools like JIRA.</li> <li>Experience managing remote contractors</li> <li>Strong team player who collaborates across functions (planning, network engineering, SRE, vendors).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Professional level network certification(s) (JNCIP, CCNP, etc) or higher.</li> <li>Linux certifications.</li> <li>Experience with continuous / rapid deployment.</li> <li>Experience working in a 24/7/365 mission-critical service environment (on-call rotation required)</li> <li>Knowledge of the OSI-model and experience isolating network, hardware and software issues.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. responsable communication de l’événement</p> <h3><strong>À propos d’Adopt AI – Grand Palais</strong></h3> <p>Du <strong>30 novembre et 2 décembre 2027</strong>, Artefact Open Innovation organise la <strong>4ᵉ édition </strong><strong>d’Adopt AI – Grand Palais</strong>, le sommet international de référence dédié à l’intelligence artificielle.</p> <p>Organisé au <strong>Grand Palais à Paris</strong>, l’événement réunira plus de <strong>20 000 participants</strong>, <strong>800 intervenants</strong> et <strong>250 exposants</strong>.<br>Son ambition est triple :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Inspirer</strong>, grâce à des intervenants internationaux de renom partageant leur vision<br><br></li> <li><strong>Montrer concrètement</strong> comment l’IA transforme les industries à travers des retours d’expérience<br><br></li> <li><strong>Mobiliser les écosystèmes</strong> autour de discussions concrètes pour accélérer l’adoption réelle de l’IA</li> </ul> <h3><strong>À propos gagnent en développant de nouvelles formes de collaborations et une compréhension des enjeux liés à l’adoption des nouvelles technologies – notamment DATA et IA.</p> <p>Pour cela, nous partageons et propageons l’esprit entrepreneur avec des modes de collaboration plus agiles à l’échelle :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Des individus</strong>, à travers des programmes de formation et l’accélération de projets d’innovation<br><br></li> <li><strong>Des équipes</strong>, grâce à des expériences d’innovation participative et l’adoption de nouveaux modes de collaboration<br><br></li> <li><strong>Des écosystèmes et des organisations</strong>, en créant et animant de larges communautés ouvertes (open innovation), mobilisées autour d’objectifs communs<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un·e <strong>stagiaire communication avec une appétence pour les stratégies de communication</strong>, afin d’accompagner la chargée de communication au sein du pôle événementiel & communication sur la structuration et le déploiement de la communication d’Adopt AI.</p> <h3><strong>Missions</strong></h3> <p>En soutien direct à la chargée de communication et au sein du pôle événementiel & communication, vous interviendrez sur un large spectre de missions :</p> <h4><strong>Communication et stratégie de marque</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Participation à la réflexion autour de la promotion de l’évènement Adopt AI - Grand Palais</li> <li>Contribution à la cohérence des messages et des prises de parole sur l’ensemble des supports</li> <li>Appui à la structuration de la
