title: Account Executive, Start Ups
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Available Locations</strong></span></h2> <hr> <p>Munich, Berlin or Frankfurt</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h2> <hr> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Startup Account Executive to join our Digital Natives team in Germany and Austria. You'll build your own customer base from the ground up, mostly through your own prospecting or by working closely with your BDR. Your job is to find promising startups across the region, win them early and help them build on Cloudflare as they grow.</p> <p>You'll work with AI startups, developer tool companies and other young tech businesses, often in the first years after their funding. Their teams are small, and founders make most of the decisions. Often an engineer has been using Cloudflare long before anyone talks to sales. You know this world, and you're comfortable talking about technology with a founder or CTO. You don't need to know every spec, but you understand what they're building and what Cloudflare can change for them.</p> <p>The pace is high. You'll spend a good part of your week reaching out to founders and engineers, following up and booking first meetings. You'll also build your network in the startup scene. VC firms, accelerators and founder communities are often the fastest way to the right companies, and you'll become a familiar face there. If you enjoy the hunt and like seeing your own work turn into new customers, you'll like this job. </p> <p>Above all, we are looking for true team players. We win together, not as lone wolves with sharp elbows. You share what works, ask for help when you need it, and celebrate your colleagues' wins as much as your own. You see your BDR, Solutions Engineers and specialists as real partners, not as support functions, and you bring the same care to working with your colleagues as you do to working with your customers. If you believe the best results come from people who make each other better, you'll feel right at home on our team. </p> <p>AI tools are a big part of how we sell. Many of the startups you work with are building AI products themselves, and they notice when you work the same way. We expect you to use AI every way, from researching accounts to preparing for meetings.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li>Building your customer base: Find and win new startup customers across DACH, and build your book of business from the first deal. Hit or beat your quarterly targets for new customers.</li> <li>Pipeline generation: Own your pipeline from the first contact. Most of it will come from your own prospecting, such as cold outreach to founders and CTOs, LinkedIn and startup events. Your BDR supports you, but you set the pace.</li> <li>VC and accelerator relationships: Build relationships with VC firms, accelerators and startup programmes in DACH. Get to know their portfolios, find the companies where Cloudflare fits and get warm introductions to founders.</li> <li>Product-led growth: Find startups whose developers already use Cloudflare's free or self-serve plans, and turn that usage into a commercial relationship as the company grows.</li> <li>Founders and technical buyers: Have credible conversations with founders, CTOs and lead engineers about what they're building. Explain what Cloudflare changes for them, for example lower infrastructure costs or less time spent running infrastructure.</li> <li>AI startups: Position Workers AI, AI Gateway, Vectorize and R2 with startups building AI products. Understand their usual problems, such as inference costs and securing AI APIs.</li> <li>Fast sales cycles: Run short, efficient sales cycles with many deals at the same time. Follow up quickly, spend your time on the startups with the most potential and close with confidence.</li> <li>Long-term thinking: Choose startups that can grow into large customers, and set them up on Cloudflare in a way that lets them scale with us.</li> <li>Teamwork: Work closely with your BDR and Customer Engineers. Plan accounts together, bring them into conversations at the right moment and keep everyone up to date. Work with Sales Ops, Product and Customer Success to keep deals moving and get new customers off to a strong start.</li> <li>Pipeline and forecasting: Keep your pipeline in Salesforce accurate and give your manager forecasts they can rely on.</li> <li>AI in your daily work: Use AI tools every day for account research, personalised outreach, meeting prep and follow-ups. In the interview, we'll ask you how AI helps you get better results.</li> <li>Market insight: Share what you see in the DACH startup scene with the wider team, such as which funding rounds to watch and which technologies startups choose.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></span></h2> <hr> <p>Sales Experience</p> <ul> <li>2+ years in B2B technology sales with a quota, including at least one role you held for two years or more</li> <li>Met or beat your quota in your most recent full year</li> <li>Won new customers mainly through your own prospecting, such as cold email, calls and LinkedIn</li> <li>You enjoy prospecting and are used to a high volume of outreach every week</li> <li>Sold to startups or scale-ups, or worked closely with VC firms or accelerators</li> <li>Run full sales cycles with many deals at the same time</li> <li>Ideally sold to developers or CTOs before</li> <li>Worked with a structured sales method such as MEDDPICC</li> </ul> <p>Startup background</p> <ul> <li>Ideally you've worked at an AI or tech startup yourself</li> <li>You know how startups are funded (seed, Series A, Series B) and what each stage means for their budget and priorities</li> <li>You have a network in the DACH startup scene, or you know how to build one quickly</li> </ul> <p>Technical knowledge</p> <ul> <li>You can explain the basics of how the internet works: DNS, CDN, TLS, HTTP and APIs</li> <li>You know how startups typically build their products, using public cloud, serverless, open-source tools and AI APIs</li> <li>You have solid public cloud know-how. You understand how companies use AWS, GCP, Azure, including Kubernetes and serverless. What drives their cost and where Cloudflare complements or replaces them.</li> <li>You know how modern engineering teams ship software, including CI/CD and developer tooling such as GitHub, GitLab and AI coding tools like Claude Code. </li> <li>Knowing Cloudflare (Workers, R2, AI Gateway, Zero Trust) or a competitor such as AWS, Akamai, Fastly or Vercel is a plus</li> </ul> <p>Tools and ways of working</p> <ul> <li>You use Salesforce or a similar CRM every day and keep your pipeline accurate</li> <li>You already use AI tools in your sales work, for example ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research and writing, or Clay for account research. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the Team and Role</h3> <p>The Developer Productivity team builds internal tools and platforms that improve the velocity and developer experience of Cloudflare's engineering teams. We own developer productivity (code commit to production), developer insights and ADLC metrics, developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.</p> <p>This team is responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering. It's a small team, so you'll have a big surface area and real ownership from day one.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer, you will help build and operate internal platforms that help Cloudflare engineers develop, deploy, and run software safely and efficiently. You’ll work across developer tooling, CI/CD, GitOps, and AI-assisted development, including MCP servers, agents, evals, and context engineering.</p> <p>You’ll also help govern and enforce Cloudflare’s Engineering Codex by turning engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and actionable feedback.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <p><strong>Exp</strong>: 4-12yrs</p> <p>- Build developer productivity tools, MCP servers, and AI agents.</p> <p>- Automate Engineering Codex controls through CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code.</p> <p>- Monitor Codex adoption, improve controls, and support remediation and exception workflows.</p> <p>- Improve GitOps, developer experience, platform security, and reliability.</p> <p>- Partner with product teams on architecture and platform adoption.</p> <p>- Respond to and prevent incidents affecting internal platforms.</p> <h3>What We’re Looking For</h3> <p>- Experience with TypeScript, Go, or Bash.</p> <p>- Strong debugging and source-control skills.</p> <p>- Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, or developer platforms.</p> <p>- Ability to break down complex problems and evaluate trade-offs.</p> <p>- Clear communication and a strong focus on developer experience.</p> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <p>- Experience with AI agents, MCP, evals, or LLM-based tooling.</p> <p>- Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p> <p>- Background in platform engineering or developer productivity.</p> <p>- Experience operating distributed or Kubernetes-based systems.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Senior Mechanical Designer
description: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure? You want to take ownership of designs that move from early prototypes to reliable serial production? Join CDDS to turn ambitious engineering concepts into parts and assemblies that can be manufactured, assembled, and delivered at scale. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your Mission We are looking for an experienced Senior Mechanical Designer with strong expertise in injection molding and a track record of taking products from prototype to serial production. You will work hands-on in CAD, developing and refining parts and assemblies with manufacturing and assembly requirements built into the design from the start. You will collaborate directly with injection molding suppliers, resolve manufacturability issues, and follow your designs through tooling, first samples, and production ramp-up. Working closely with our mechanical, electrical, and production teams, you will help ensure that our designs perform in the field and can be produced and assembled consistently. We are looking for someone who have practical manufacturing knowledge and follows a design through until it works on the assembly line. Core Responsibilities Develop and refine 3D CAD models, assemblies, and production drawings, with a strong focus on injection-molded plastic parts. Take designs from functional prototypes through design release, tooling, initial production runs, and serial production. Apply design for manufacturing and assembly principles to improve part quality, reduce cost, and simplify production. Work directly with injection molding suppliers on feasibility reviews, tooling constraints, design changes, and first-sample evaluation. Design for efficient, repeatable assembly, including accessible fastening, clear part orientation, and mistake-proofing methods such as poka-yoke. Requirements Your Profile You bring practical experience turning designs into manufactured products. You understand how CAD decisions affect tooling, part consistency, assembly effort, and cost. You are comfortable discussing details with suppliers and working alongside the people who assemble your designs. At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical design or product development. Demonstrated experience taking at least one product or significant assembly from prototype through production ramp-up. Proficiency in professional 3D CAD software and the creation of complete manufacturing drawings. Strong understanding of injection molding constraints, including draft angles, wall thickness, ribs, bosses, undercuts, shrinkage, and warpage. Ability to work autonomously and collaborate closely with engineering, suppliers, and production teams. BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field, a Swiss apprenticeship as a Konstrukteur/in EFZ, or an equivalent relevant qualification. Nice-to-Have Proficiency in SolidWorks. Experience with composite materials and their manufacturing and assembly processes. Experience designing assembly fixtures, inspection aids, or production tooling. Familiarity with machining, sheet metal fabrication, and additive manufacturing. Experience with drones, robotics, aerospace, or other products combining mechanical and electronic systems. Benefits Why CDDS Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape. Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership. Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team. Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations. Attractive compensation. Details Location: Zürich Hardbrücke, on-site Start date: ASAP Environment: High-impact deep-tech startup working on real deployments If you are interested in the position, please apply via the application form. repeatable AI workflows for spotting story candidates, preparing interviews, drafting, and cutting one story into versions for each channel.</li> <li><strong>Track results: </strong>Decide how we title: Head of Zero Day Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the role</h3><p>Cloudflare is hiring a Head of Zero Day Engineering to build and lead the team that turns newly discovered vulnerabilities into verified protection—for Cloudflare and its customers.</p><p>High-priority vulnerabilities rarely fit within one team’s boundaries. A fix may require kernel expertise, changes across software dependencies and trust stores, fleet-wide deployment, customer-facing WAF protections, and investigation of prior exploitation. You will bring those efforts together, with clear ownership from initial disclosure through verified remediation.</p><p>This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will recruit the team, establish its operating model, and build the tooling that makes response faster and more reliable. You will combine experienced human judgment with carefully evaluated AI-assisted workflows—not automate away accountability.</p><h3>What you’ll do</h3><p><strong>Build and lead the team</strong></p><p>- Establish Zero Day Engineering’s charter, priorities, operating model, and partnerships across Cloudflare.</p><p>- Recruit, develop, and lead engineers spanning vulnerability response, exposure analysis, mitigation, patching, artifact provenance, release coordination, and automation.</p><p>- Build a sustainable incident-command rotation, clear escalation paths, and effective handoffs across teams and time zones.</p><p>- Create a culture of technical depth, calm execution, blameless learning, and shared accountability.</p><h3>Own vulnerability response end to end</h3><p>- Establish a consistent intake and triage process for public vulnerabilities, private disclosures, and internal findings.</p><p>- Ensure each significant vulnerability has a clear owner, an evidence-based exposure assessment, and a path to verified remediation.</p><p>- Lead decisions about mitigation versus patching, balancing urgency, exploitability, exposure, and production risk.</p><p>- Enable the team to implement fixes directly where practical and coordinate partner-owned changes through verified production deployment.</p><p>- Partner with SIRT on suspected compromise, exploitation analysis, hunting, and eviction verification. Ensure blocking an exploit is not mistaken for removing an existing compromise.</p><h3>Engineer for speed and safety</h3><p>- Drive artifact and dependency provenance so responders can quickly determine what Cloudflare runs and where it is exposed.</p><p>- Build repeatable capabilities for safe exploit validation, mitigation, patch qualification, and fleet-wide remediation.</p><p>- Coordinate managed WAF response with SRA, Managed Rules, Firewall/ERE, and WAF engineering while preserving specialist ownership.</p><p>- Maintain strong review, staged-release, health-monitoring, and rollback practices—including during urgent response.</p><p>- Turn recurring response problems into durable engineering improvements rather than repeated manual coordination.</p><p>### Develop responsible AI-assisted operations</p><p>- Build AI-assisted workflows for triage, research, exposure analysis, drafting, and release tracking.</p><p>- Establish replay evaluations, measurable quality thresholds, access controls, and human approval gates before production use.</p><p>- Keep release authority, disclosure approval, risk acceptance, and other consequential decisions with accountable people.</p><p>- Measure actual operational benefit and failure rates rather than assuming productivity gains.</p><h3>Set direction and communicate clearly</h3><p>- Define and report response metrics, including time to assess exposure, mitigate, patch, and verify remediation.</p><p>- Translate technical uncertainty into clear decisions, priorities, and executive updates.</p><p>- Partner with Product Security, Legal, Communications, and engineering leaders on coordinated disclosure and customer communication.</p><p>- Use workload and outcome data to guide staffing, investment, and capability development.</p><h3>What you’ll bring</h3><p>- Experience building and leading engineering teams responsible for security-critical systems, vulnerability response, production infrastructure, or closely related work.</p><p>- A record of delivering complex technical changes across organizational boundaries, including when priorities compete and authority is distributed.</p><p>- Strong technical judgment across several of the following: Linux and operating systems, vulnerability analysis, software supply chains, application security, distributed systems, fleet management, or production reliability.</p><p>- Experience leading high-pressure technical response with incomplete information, making defensible decisions, and communicating what is known, unknown, and next.</p><p>- A practical understanding of mitigation, patching, exploitation detection, and remediation verification—and the differences between them.</p><p>- Experience establishing safe deployment, validation, and rollback practices at scale.</p><p>- The ability to recruit and develop strong engineers while remaining credible in technical reviews and operational decisions.</p><p>- Clear written communication and the ability to work effectively with engineers, security specialists, executives, and legal partners.</p><p>- A thoughtful approach to AI-assisted engineering, including evaluation, security boundaries, and human accountability.</p><h3>Experience that would be especially useful</h3><p>- Coordinating responses to embargoed vulnerabilities or working with upstream maintainers and security researchers.</p><p>- Kernel patching, backporting, runtime or trust-store remediation, or large-scale dependency updates.</p><p>- WAF rule development or deployment, exploit reproduction, host forensics, or threat hunting.</p><p>- Building artifact inventories, dependency graphs, or software provenance systems.</p><p>- Developing and operating AI-assisted engineering tools with rigorous evaluation and access controls.</p><p>- Building a new team or function while maintaining effective partnerships with existing owners.</p><h3>What success looks like</h3><p>- Vulnerabilities have a clear path from intake to an accountable owner and verified remediation.</p><p>- Exposure questions are answered quickly with evidence rather than repeated manual investigation.</p><p>- Urgent fixes move faster without bypassing production safety or disclosure controls.</p><p>- Cloudflare can distinguish between an exploit being blocked, a vulnerability being patched, and a compromise being removed.</p><p>- AI-assisted workflows deliver demonstrated value within explicit safeguards.</p><p>- The team’s capabilities and staffing evolve based on measured demand and outcomes.</p><p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? description: <p>Joining Capco means becoming part of an innovative and dynamic consultancy firm, committed to fostering an inclusive environment where you are encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. title: Senior Software Engineer - Product Core Team
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About BLP Join BLP and help make the world's business processes autonomous. Our agentic AI platform helps enterprises worldwide remove manual execution from their core business processes, enabling those processes to run autonomously end-to-end, with greater control and productivity gains of 5–10×. Today, more than 550 enterprise customers rely on BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. Across more than 40 countries, our platform automates purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes for organizations ranging from mid-sized companies to Fortune 500 enterprises with complex global operations. Our success is built on deep expertise in business processes and technology, a differentiated product, and strong product-market fit, as reflected in a continually expanding customer base. As one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies, BLP is entering its next phase of growth with the backing of Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a minority growth investor. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we are expanding our presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day. Where you'll work. You join the Product Core Team, about 12 engineers. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns, and with the frontend engineers who build the UIs on top of your APIs. What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it. What you'll do Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds. Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default. Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast. Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including their audit trail. Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and the APIs behind our admin UIs, so customers and project managers can run them on their own. Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling. Own it end-to-end. From design through the Go service to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships. Tech stack: Go, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability. We're excited about you because You have 4+ years of experience as a backend developer , building and operating systems in production. You have 2+ years of professional Go experience , writing services that run in production, not side projects. You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew. You work well across teams. You align with product, frontend, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers. You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it. You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns. You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live. Strong plus Experience with distributed systems , Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure. Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC). Experience running multi-tenant systems. Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills. What you'll get Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them. Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily. Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership. Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation. What You'll Work On Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites. Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather. Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse. Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them. Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors. Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control. Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts. New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design. The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack. Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions. Who We're Looking For We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments. Your Background A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth). Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors. Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior. Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions. Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries. Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests. Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills. Clear communication of navigation and path-planning design choices and their trade-offs. Willingness to visit customer sites regularly. Nice to Have Experience with legged robots or with more than one robot embodiment. Experience with Nav2 or a comparable navigation framework. Motion prediction or planning among people and vehicles, such as trajectory forecasting or socially aware navigation. Terrain mapping and traversability methods: elevation mapping, learned traversability, or semantic segmentation for navigation. Experience with night-time or all-weather sensing, such as thermal cameras or LiDAR in rain and fog. Background in security, defence, or other safety-critical robotics deployments. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
description: About the team Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives. Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment. The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. title: Senior Response Engineer - Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></h2> <h2><strong>About the Department</strong></h2> <p><strong>Cloudforce One</strong> is Cloudflare's threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs). Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.</p> <p>Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><strong>About INTERDICT</strong></h2> <p><strong>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T.</strong> (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD):</strong> Network and application security monitoring for 'Under Attack' mitigation support.</li> <li><strong>PhishGuard:</strong> Managed email threat detection and response service.</li> <li><strong>Detection Engineering:</strong> ML model development and detection optimization.</li> </ul> <p>Together, INTERDICT provides comprehensive <strong>24×7×365 protection</strong> across email, application, and network threat surfaces.</p> <h3><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>As a <strong>Senior Response Engineer</strong> within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center (CMDC), you will serve as a subject-matter expert and technical escalation point for threat mitigation across Cloudflare’s strategic enterprise customer base. In this role, you will lead the response to sophisticated, multi-vector cyberattacks spanning OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7, operating beyond standard playbooks to diagnose anomalies, engineer custom mitigations, and stabilize mission-critical infrastructure under fire.</p> <p>Beyond active incident command, you will act as a force multiplier: architecting customer-specific defense strategies, authoring and refining automated detection logic, mentoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers, and collaborating directly with Cloudflare Product and Engineering teams. We are looking for an experienced, high-ownership technical leader who excels during high-stakes incidents and is passionate about mentoring others while advancing threat mitigation at scale.</p> <p>CMDC operates 24×7×365. <strong>This role participates in a regional shift rotation and on-call escalation rota including periodic weekend and public-holiday coverage as part of a follow-the-sun model across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.</strong></p> <h3><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the technical lead and incident commander during high-impact, multi-vector security events, designing and deploying bespoke mitigation strategies when standard runbooks do not suffice.</li> <li>Perform deep-dive forensic analysis into complex Layer 3/4 and Layer 7 traffic anomalies, identifying zero-day attack patterns, sophisticated bot networks, and novel evasion techniques.</li> <li>Apply advanced mitigation strategies and filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare’s core security suite, including Magic Transit, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Advanced Rate Limiting.</li> <li>Lead technical communications and incident bridge calls with enterprise C-level executives, principal network engineers, and security teams during critical events, clearly articulating root causes, impact assessments, and remediation paths.</li> <li>Monitor and investigate proactive security alerts across internal telemetry systems to rapidly triage incoming events, assess blast radius, and validate threat severity.</li> <li>Adhere to and champion strict customer SLAs for alert response times, event analysis, and clear executive reporting.</li> <li>Mentor and elevate Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers through structured shadowing, technical post-mortems, and internal training.</li> <li>Partner with internal Engineering and Product teams to translate operational attack trends into prioritized platform enhancements, tool feedback, and automated detection logic.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A minimum of 6–8 years of hands-on experience in a high-volume Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Detection and Response (MDR), network engineering, or incident response environment dealing directly with live threat mitigation.</li> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of networking principles and internet infrastructure, including TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, DNS, BGP routing mechanics, and edge network design.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Layer 7 protocols and web architectures (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, TLS handshakes/ciphers, reverse proxy models, and API security).</li> <li>Experience analyzing network traffic data for anomaly detection and designing, tuning, and executing advanced mitigation strategies against L3/L4 and L7 attacks, including bespoke countermeasures when standard playbooks are insufficient.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in packet capture and network traffic analysis using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, or tshark to isolate anomalies and dissect malformed or novel payloads.</li> <li>Practical experience analyzing and mitigating security incidents using AI and machine learning tools, paired with the hands-on capability to build and integrate custom tooling that improves operational workflows, accelerates log telemetry analysis, and defends against AI-driven botnets and adversarial edge attacks.</li> <li>Proficiency in using the command line (Bash shell) alongside general system administration literacy across Linux, Mac, or Windows environments.</li> <li>Proven experience commanding incident bridges, making decisive risk-tradeoff decisions, and maintaining composure while managing enterprise stakeholders during high-pressure crises.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience querying large-scale distributed logging and analytics systems using SQL, GraphQL, ClickHouse, or SIEM platforms (Splunk, Elastic, Sumo Logic).</li> <li>Hands-on experience defending against advanced persistent threats (APTs), credential stuffing, scraping botnets, or application-layer bypass attacks against major CDNs/WAFs.</li> <li>Relevant industry certifications, such as CISSP, CCNP/CCIE, or advanced GIAC credentials (e.g., GCIA, GCIH, GNFA).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage

description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. Let's build together. Your impact This is a high-impact role where you directly protect Mollie's financial stability and reputation. As an Merchant Risk Analyst, you are the first line of defense, proactively monitoring merchant activity to identify and mitigate patterns indicative of fraud or financial crime. This work is critical to safeguarding our platform integrity, ensuring our merchants and customers can trust Mollie as a secure and reliable payments provider. You will be expected to conduct proactive and reactive fraud investigations, moving beyond simple alert validation to interpret complex fraud scenarios and uncover emerging risks. Your analysis and recommendations will directly shape cross-team decision-making across compliance, operations, and fraud strategy, positioning you as a trusted Subject Matter Expert. If you are driven to continuously challenge existing practices, propose improvements to our fraud-prevention frameworks, and want to master the craft of financial crime analysis, you will be key to strengthening our overall risk resilience and staying ahead of evolving threats in the payments landscape. What you'll ship Detect and investigate fraud risks through proactive monitoring, deep data analysis, and event-driven reviews of merchant activity. Mitigate financial losses by validating, escalating, and actioning fraud alerts promptly to protect platform integrity. Deliver clear, actionable recommendations for mitigation strategies based on your interpretation of complex fraud scenarios and typologies. Drive continuous process improvement by proactively proposing enhancements to our fraud-prevention frameworks, tools, and processes. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert , advising internal and external stakeholders on emerging fraud trends, typologies, and compliance standards. What you'll bring Hands-on experience in fraud detection, investigations, or financial crime analysis. Strong data analysis skills and the proven ability to interpret complex transaction patterns and identify anomalies. Knowledge of payment systems , merchant risk, fraud typologies, and relevant regulatory requirements. Proficiency with fraud monitoring tools , case management systems, or relevant dashboards. Clear and effective communication skills to articulate complex scenarios and mitigation strategies to cross-functional and external teams. A proactive, detail-oriented approach that thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment. Base location for this role can be either Amsterdam or Maastricht. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter. Bij Lefebvre Sdu bouwen we al 200 jaar aan die kennis. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ontwikkelen we bovendien ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. title: Cloud Architect
description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this." You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute. If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market. Key Responsibilities: Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages. Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces What You’ll Bring: Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for A track record of finishing what others started: turning a partial or unstable implementation into something genuinely reliable in production Strong Infrastructure as Code practice (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) as the authoritative source of environment configuration Comfortable operating in a regulated, security-conscious environment where architecture decisions have compliance implications Familiarity with AWS cost structure, along with the ability to factor in cost-related considerations when designing infrastructure Professional English; title: IT Operations Specialist I
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>London, UK</p> <p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>As an IT Operations Specialist I, you will provide essential onsite IT support and help maintain daily workplace technology at our corporate office. Working in a heavy macOS and Google Workspace environment with additional support for Windows and Linux endpoints, you will deliver hands-on technical assistance, maintain office AV systems, and manage end-to-end hire-to-retire lifecycle processes. In this role, you will also leverage our internal AI technology tools to optimize support workflows and documentation. You will collaborate closely with broader IT teams, the IT Service Desk, HR, Places & Office, and Security teams to ensure a seamless technical experience for all employees.</p> <p><strong>Role responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary onsite technical support resource, managing employee walk-ups, support tickets, and hardware troubleshooting across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints.</li> <li>Work closely with broader IT engineering and operations teams to execute infrastructure updates, enforce system policies, and resolve escalated technical issues.</li> <li>Manage complete hire-to-retire IT operations, including hardware provisioning, account setup, leading IT orientation for new hires, offboarding asset recovery, and access revoking.</li> <li>Administer day-to-day user accounts, permissions, and group access within Google Workspace and connected corporate SaaS tools.</li> <li>Manage physical IT asset lifecycle operations, including inventory tracking, hardware check-in/check-out, stock audits, and secure device disposal.</li> <li>Utilize internal AI technology tools to summarize support incidents, speed up ticket resolution, and draft self-service Knowledge Base (KB) documentation for end users.</li> <li>Support office conference room technology (Google Meet Hardware and Zoom Rooms) and provide live technical setup for corporate town halls and department events.</li> <li>Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation (evenings and weekends) to address critical after-hours P1/P2 incidents, system outages, and urgent executive support needs.</li> </ul> <p>This is an in-office/onsite position. This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>1–2 years of hands-on IT support or help-desk experience in a corporate environment.</li> <li>Strong expertise troubleshooting macOS hardware, software, and enterprise OS configurations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Windows OS and basic Linux desktop administration or CLI troubleshooting.</li> <li>Practical administrative experience with Google Workspace (User management, Shared Drives, Groups, Admin Console).</li> <li>Availability to work fully onsite 5 days a week and participate in a scheduled on-call rotation for after-hours support.</li> <li>Readiness to utilize internal AI tools and assistants to streamline ticketing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first approach to technical support and leading new-hire orientations.</li> <li>Application requires a current resume/CV detailing relevant IT workplace support experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with macOS endpoint management using Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms like Jamf Pro or Kandji.</li> <li>Experience using corporate ticketing platforms such as Jira Service Management or Zendesk.</li> <li>Relevant technical certifications such as Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP), Google Workspace Administrator, CompTIA A+, or ITIL 4 Foundation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job.
