title: Embedded & Firmware QA Engineer
description: 🌊 Who are we? We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging. Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive. As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in. Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we're proud of. We're committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow. The Role You'll own the quality of the firmware and embedded systems across our physical product portfolio. That means making sure every firmware release is tested, reliable, and ready for the field, and that defects are caught before they reach a client. This is a senior, hands-on role. You understand electronics and embedded systems well enough to reproduce and diagnose issues yourself, read a schematic, and build your own test kits and jigs. You don't wait for an engineer to set things up for you. You run your area independently. Over the past year, we've built a validation framework that changed how we release firmware. We now ship on evidence instead of gut feel: structured test cycles across our product generations, tracked defects across release candidates, formal release reviews, and controlled rollouts to the fleet. Your first job is to own that framework and keep it strong. Your bigger job is to take it further. Today, testing mostly happens once a release is nearly done. We want to catch risk earlier, inside the firmware stage-gate process, through integration testing, corner cases, and tests at the edges of the operating envelope. You'll move firmware QA from reacting to preventing. What You'll Do Embedded & Firmware Testing Own test strategy and execution for firmware and embedded systems across our physical products. Reproduce field and development issues independently, using your electrical and embedded understanding. Develop diagnostic and validation methods for firmware features, aligned with our stage-gate process. Define and run regression testing ahead of every firmware release. Test at the system-integration and interface level, including the edges of the operating envelope where real risk sits. Reliability & Field Quality Support containment and root-cause analysis for firmware and embedded field issues. Feed field learnings back into the test suite. Every field issue is a missing test. Contribute embedded input to DFMEA and PFMEA and to our stage-gate quality gates. What You Bring Experience building embedded test capability from an early stage, a background that bridges electronics and firmware, or exposure to a stage-gate release process for embedded products sets you apart. 6+ years in embedded or Firmware QA A strong electrical and embedded background: you read schematics, understand PCB and hardware behavior, and reproduce embedded issues on your own. Firmware testing experience across diagnostics, validation, and regression. A hands-on, self-sufficient approach: you build your own test kits, jigs, and test environments. Experience with system-level integration testing for a hardware and firmware product. A pragmatic, risk-weighted mindset: you test in proportion to the risk, not for coverage's sake. Comfort in a lean, fast-moving team where you own your area, and the habit of using AI tools every day. Why Aquablu? You'll build the foundation that lets quality scale at Aquablu, with real ownership from day one and a direct line to our firmware and digital engineering teams. 💰 A yearly base salary between €70k and €98k (incl. 8% holiday allowance) 🌴 26 paid holiday days 📈 Equity through our Aquablu for All plan: everyone shares in what we're building 🌱 Healthy (heavily discounted) lunches 💪 Urban Sports Club membership 🚀 Access to the Corporate Benefits platform for endless savings 🚆 Travel compensation >10km 👴 A pension plan by Zwitserleven 💧 Endless amounts of our very own flavored water 💙 Check out our YouTube to get a feeling for the culture at Aquablu Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Solutions Consultant (New York, NY)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 8–15+ years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. NICE TO HAVES - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York, NY, the estimated range for total on-target earnings (including base salary and on-target incentive pay) for this role is $360,000 - $400,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence tools.</li> <li>Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical frameworks.</li> <li>Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Plan and prioritize work independently in a remote, cross-functional environment across time zones.</li> <li>You may also bring experience with large language </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>Our Support Engineering organization uses data to understand performance, improve customer outcomes, and improve operational practices. title: Training Operations Specialist - EMEA
description: The Learning Team at ClickHouse is growing fast as more users discover the power of ClickHouse and seek to understand how to use it effectively. As a Training Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for coordinating, managing, and supporting the logistics and administration of global training programs, with a focus on public and private instructor-led training events. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless event execution and a consistent, high-quality learner experience. What you will be doing: Here is a list of the typical tasks you would be performing as a Training Operations Specialist: Schedule and organize virtual and in-person training events, including registration page setup, Zoom configuration, and email communications. Coordinate training event logistics, including sourcing and booking venues, managing event requirements, coordinating instructor availability, and communicating with instructors and attendees. Manage event registration, monitor enrollment, send reminders, follow-up emails, and track attendance to ensure smooth event execution. Track and report training metrics, registration trends, attendance, and program outcomes to key stakeholders. Partner with Field Marketing teams to coordinate public training events, including event scheduling, registration monitoring, and promotional support. Collaborate with Sales teams to coordinate private training requests, manage scheduling and logistics, and support customer training needs. Work closely with the broader Training team to coordinate resources, streamline processes, and ensure consistent execution across training programs. Requirements: 2+ years of experience in training coordination, operations, event management, or a related role. Proficiency with marketing automation platforms, particularly Marketo, including registration management and email communications. Proficiency with online communication and collaboration tools, including Zoom, Google Workspace, and Notion. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities across various time zones simultaneously. Detail-oriented, with excellent organizational, time management, communication, and process management skills. Ability to learn new technologies and systems quickly and effectively. A self-motivated attitude with the desire and determination to complete tasks in a fast-paced startup environment. Bonus points: Experience working with Learning Management Systems (LMS). Experience with Salesforce, particularly reporting, dashboards, and tracking training-related data. Background in project management, curriculum design, or learning and development. Experience coordinating instructor-led training programs across multiple regions or global audiences. Perks Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here . Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse. Equal Opportunity & Privacy ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. title: Jr Account Executive
description: About Us Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the Role We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market. In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more. What You’ll Do Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate: Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about Create engaging ways to show our product Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path What You’ll Need You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry: Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech A minimum of 1 year of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality You are comfortable working in both English and Dutch If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers . Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Flexible time off Team events What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Lead UX Designer
description: About Act There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. About the Role Create beautiful, fast, and intuitive interfaces for A1. You'll focus on the visual design of our products, ensuring every screen is clear, polished, and easy to use. Working alongside Product Designers and engineers, you'll bring the user experience to life through exceptional interface design. What You Will Be Doing Design high-quality user interfaces Build and maintain UI components and design systems. Refine layouts, typography, spacing, and visual consistency. Work closely with product and engineering to deliver pixel-perfect experiences. Continuously improve the quality of the product interface. What You Will Need Strong portfolio demonstrating UI design work. Excellent visual design, typography, and layout skills. Experience building and maintaining design systems. Proficiency with Figma. Strong attention to detail and craftsmanship. How We Work The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution. This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Our goal is to build products that are genuinely useful to billions of people globally. Interview process For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process. If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design challenge. Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Business Development Lead - Hivemind - Netherlands
description: Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and Job Description: Shield AI is seeking a high-performing Business Development / Account Executive to drive growth for Hivemind Autonomy across the Netherlands, with a primary focus on defense and government customers. This role is responsible for identifying, shaping, and closing complex opportunities while building enduring customer relationships and executing disciplined capture strategies. You will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Product, Engineering, and Strategic Engagement teams to align customer needs with Hivemind’s autonomy capabilities and deliver mission-critical outcomes. The ideal candidate is a customer-first, technically credible seller with strong capture instincts, experience navigating defence acquisition processes, and a proven track record of winning and expanding strategic accounts. What you'll do: Own and drive the full sales lifecycle for Hivemind opportunities across assigned accounts/territories (pipeline generation through close) Develop and execute territory and capture strategies for priority pursuits, aligning with Shield AI’s long-term strategic plan Identify, qualify, and shape new business opportunities through deep understanding of customer missions, budgets, and acquisition pathways Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, program offices, and influencers across defense and government customers Lead proposal development in Then you will get it to first customers and see it through to general availability.</p> <p>Your mission in this role is to lead the project of building a database designed for agent-driven development workflows, getting both the core tradeoffs and the fine-grained details right.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Run customer discovery to find and sharpen the problem the product should solve.</li> <li>Define the product, its target users, and its positioning against established databases.</li> <li>Work with engineering on core design tradeoffs across consistency, latency, scale, durability, and cost to serve.</li> <li>Recruit design partners and run a private beta that produces honest, usable feedback.</li> <li>Set success metrics and use them to decide what to build, change, or cut.</li> <li>Own pricing and packaging, grounded in customer value and unit economics.</li> <li>Drive the product from first prototype through beta, launch, and GA.</li> <li>Make sure it fits naturally with Workers, Wrangler, and Cloudflare's existing data products.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Sales, and Customer Support teams.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare externally at conferences, community events, customer meetings, and developer-focused initiatives.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience as an EM, PM or founder. You raise the bar for sweating the details.</li> <li>External presentation skills. title: Senior Backend Engineer, Development Health
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior Backend Engineer on Development Health, you'll help make the systems that engineering teams rely on more reliable, maintainable, and easier to extend. You'll build and improve the automation, tooling, and data that help teams spot problems early and ship with less friction.</p> <p>As customer zero for GitLab, we support engineering workflows on GitLab's own product at scale. You'll use the product in demanding, real-world ways, surface the friction and gaps you find, and contribute to improvements that get built into the product for GitLab's customers.</p> <p>You'll support work such as:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Health alerting and remediation routing for GitLab's core continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines</li> <li value="2">Flaky and slow test detection systems</li> <li value="3">Engineering analytics and reporting that engineering teams use to make decisions</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own and evolve core Development Health systems, from design through production.</li> <li value="2">Improve the reliability, maintainability, and test coverage of long-lived automation, and reduce reliance on undocumented knowledge by documenting and simplifying legacy systems.</li> <li value="3">Partner with engineering managers and product teams to identify workflow pain points and turn them into well-scoped, measurable improvements.</li> <li value="4">Work with data to show whether changes improve engineering health, and use it to prioritize.</li> <li value="5">Mentor intermediate engineers through code review, design feedback, and pairing.</li> <li value="6">Communicate clearly in writing and asynchronously, including status, tradeoffs, and proposals for stakeholders across Engineering.</li> <li value="7">Monitor the health of production systems, troubleshoot incidents, and contribute to root cause analysis.</li> <li value="8">Use artificial intelligence (AI) agents and assistants to analyze issues and problem areas to help shape the team's product roadmap.</li> <li value="8"><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience as a backend or tooling engineer, with a track record of owning production systems end to end.</li> <li value="2">Strong proficiency in Ruby, or the ability to become productive quickly.</li> <li value="3">Experience maintaining or modernizing legacy codebases safely.</li> <li value="4">Comfort with CI/CD systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), and automation at scale.</li> <li value="5">Independent problem-solving and clear, concise written communication: you spot problems early, raise risks proactively, and drive work to completion without close direction.</li> <li value="6">Experience writing automated unit and integration tests and taking part in collaborative code review.</li> <li value="7">Experience using AI coding assistants to speed up development while critically reviewing their output.</li> <li value="8">Optional experience: Rails; developer productivity, engineering analytics, or internal tooling; GitLab's product and open source contribution workflow; data pipelines or metrics reporting; or agent-based workflows that run in production.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Development Health is part of Developer Experience. Our work is mostly internal, and our customers are GitLab team members across an engineering organization of hundreds of engineers.</p> <p>We're all-remote, asynchronous by default, and documentation-driven, in line with GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p style="margin: 0in; font-family: Arial; font-size: 11.0pt;">Estimated Annual Salary: $214,000 -$336,000 OTE </p> <p style="margin: 0in; font-family: Arial; font-size: 11.0pt;">This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plan. title: System Engineer - Network Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Cloudflare's Network Engineering Team builds and runs the infrastructure that runs our software. The Engineering Team is split into two groups: one handles product development and the other handles operations. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base. The operations team handles one of the world's largest networks with data centers in 190 cities worldwide and a couple of large specialized data centers for internal needs.</p> <p>About the role</p> <p>Cloudflare operates a large global network spanning hundreds of cities (data centers). You will join a team of talented network automation engineers who are building software solutions to improve network resilience and reduce engineering operational toil.</p> <p>You will work on a range of tools, infrastructure and services - new and existing - with an aim to elegantly and efficiently solve problems and deliver practical, maintainable and scalable solutions. Leverage AI tools and automated assistants to streamline daily workflows.</p> <p>Examples Of Desirable Skills, Knowledge And Experience</p> <ul> <li> <p>BA/BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience</p> </li> <li> <p>3+ years of proven experience in developing software components for network automation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and various programming languages (like python and golang)</p> </li> <li> <p>Proficient with modern Unix/Linux operating systems/distributions</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience in MySQL, Postgres, Clickhouse  (or equivalent SQL language)</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with CI/CD, containers and/or virtualization</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Observability systems like prometheus, grafana (or equivalents)</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated experience working alongside AI assistants or automated tools to augment task execution and project delivery</p> </li> </ul> <p>Bonus Points:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Knowledge of Networking engineering, with competencies in Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols and vendor equipment: Cisco, Juniper, etc.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building and maintaining large distributed systems</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing internal and/or external customer requirements and expectations</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €45,000-62,000. </span></li> </ul> <div class="cell word-wrap"> </div> <p> </p> <p> </p> <div class="cell word-wrap"> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. We build and maintain managed rules that help protect millions of Internet properties from known vulnerabilities, emerging exploits, and new attack techniques.</p> <p>We work at the intersection of vulnerability research, large-scale traffic analysis, and detection engineering. Using threat intelligence and telemetry from Cloudflare’s global network, we identify exploitation patterns, develop mitigations, and measure how well they work against real traffic. We partner with Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams to improve coverage while minimizing false positives and disruption to legitimate applications.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have hands-on experience in web application security, vulnerability research, or detection engineering, including writing and improving WAF rules, exploit signatures, or comparable detection logic.</li> <li>You understand HTTP/HTTPS, how web applications and proxies process requests, and common vulnerability classes such as SQL injection, cross-site scripting, remote code execution, SSRF, and insecure deserialization.</li> <li>You can analyze a vulnerability advisory or proof of concept, reproduce the exploit in a controlled environment, and identify the request characteristics that distinguish exploitation from legitimate traffic.</li> <li>You use SQL to investigate large datasets and a language such as Python, Go, or Rust to build research tools, automate analysis, and validate detections.</li> <li>You make evidence-based tradeoffs between detection coverage, false positives, and performance. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.</li> </ul> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>We are looking for a Security Research Analyst to research web application threats and develop the managed rules that protect Cloudflare customers. You will turn public CVEs, threat intelligence, customer reports, and internal telemetry into tested, effective mitigations.</p> <p>Your work will span the detection lifecycle: understanding an exploit, designing a rule, validating it against malicious and legitimate requests, and measuring its behavior in production. You will collaborate with engineering and research partners to close coverage gaps and continuously improve the quality of our WAF protections.</p> <h3>Key responsibilities:</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Research vulnerabilities and exploitation.</strong> Analyze public CVEs, proof-of-concept exploits, and observed attacks to understand root causes, exploit chains, and opportunities for WAF mitigation.</li> <li><strong>Develop and maintain managed rules.</strong> Design, test, and deploy WAF managed rules and exploit signatures, keeping protections effective as applications, exploits, and attacker techniques evolve.</li> <li><strong>Investigate false positives and missed attacks.</strong> Analyze customer reports and request telemetry, reproduce issues, and refine detections to improve protection without unnecessarily blocking legitimate traffic.</li> <li><strong>Validate coverage and resistance to bypasses.</strong> Use targeted penetration testing, exploit variants, and adversarial testing to identify detection gaps and evaluate proposed mitigations.</li> <li><strong>Automate research and validation.</strong> Build tools and reproducible test cases that accelerate exploit analysis, rule validation, regression testing, and traffic analysis.</li> <li><strong>Measure detection quality.</strong> Use SQL, dashboards, and production data to assess rule efficacy, track attack trends, and guide improvements to coverage, false-positive rates, and performance.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across teams.</strong> Partner with Engineering, Product, and other detection teams to deliver reliable protections and resolve recurring customer problems at their roots.</li> <li><strong>Share actionable research.</strong> Document findings, explain mitigation decisions, and contribute to internal research reports and public-facing blogs on vulnerabilities and Internet-wide attack trends.</li> </ul> <h3>Additional Experience We Value</h3> <ul> <li>Experience developing WAF rules or contributing to open-source WAF projects, such as ModSecurity or the OWASP Core Rule Set.</li> <li>Experience finding WAF bypasses, analyzing request parsing and encoding differences, or researching novel exploitation techniques.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale security analytics, advanced SQL, columnar databases such as ClickHouse, and visualization tools such as Grafana.</li> <li>Experience building automated exploit-reproduction environments, detection test suites, or CI pipelines for security rules.</li> <li>Familiarity with Linux/UNIX systems, TCP/IP networking, reverse proxies, and the performance constraints of inspecting production traffic.</li> <li>Published security research, conference presentations, open-source security tools, or demonstrated work through bug bounty programs or CTFs.</li> <li>Experience partnering with data science or machine learning teams to combine rule-based detections with other security signals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $216,000</li> <li>For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. clients in the Greater China region, which form a significant part of your portfolio.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Collaboration:</strong> A track record of guiding complex technical strategies involving developers, infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> Deep working knowledge of distributed application architecture (compute, storage, networking, security, reliability, and observability).</li> <li><strong>Hands-On Capability:</strong> Software-development experience, including the ability to build or review production-quality applications and proofs of concept (preferably in JavaScript or TypeScript).</li> <li><strong>Ecosystem Knowledge:</strong> A strong understanding of modern web technologies, without direct authority, thoughtfully mentor colleagues, and turn individual solutions into shared organizational capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Excellent written, communities in Greater China.</li> <li>A background in public speaking, technical writing, open-source contribution, or community leadership.</li> <li>Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.</li> <li>A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, OR equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Important Note: </strong><em>At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. title: Principal, Developer Platform Positioning
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. As part of our explosive growth, we are looking for a Principal, Platform Storytelling to shape how developers, technical leaders, and the broader AI ecosystem understand our platform, and why they should build on it.</p> <p>This is a high-impact, foundational individual contributor role within Developer GTM. You will connect individual products and technical breakthroughs into a compelling platform story, develop differentiated positioning, and bring that story to market through launches, executive voices, and content developers actually read. You will help articulate not just what we have shipped, but our point of view on where software development and AI infrastructure are going.</p> <p>The right person has the product depth of a technical PMM, the writing instincts of an exceptional editor, and an intuition for how developer products earn attention and trust. You can move from a conversation with an engineer to a positioning brief to a keynote opening, and make each one better because you understand the others. As an early member of this team, you will have the autonomy to experiment, learn what resonates, and establish repeatable ways to turn our product momentum into market momentum.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Platform Positioning & Narrative:</strong> Develop the overarching positioning for Cloudflare’s Developer Platform. Shape positioning, launch narratives, and audience-specific content that connect technical capabilities to real developer needs. Build momentum beyond announcement day, helping developers move from interest to trying, adopting, and expanding their use of the platform.</li> <li><strong>Executive Storytelling:</strong> Be a strategic writing and narrative partner to Developer Platform leadership. Develop keynotes, presentations, essays, and other executive communications that express a distinctive, technically grounded point of view. Help leaders explain where the market is going, what we believe, and how our products themselves deliver on those beliefs.</li> <li><strong>Writing & Editorial Direction:</strong> Write and edit platform narratives, long form content, web copy, and other external content. Establish a consistent voice without making everything sound the same. Know when a story needs a technical explanation, a sharp argument, a compelling demo, or fewer words. Build credibility through substance.<br><strong>Sales & Partner Enablement:</strong> Translate platform positioning into compelling pitch narratives and competitive differentiation for field and partner teams. Partner with Customer Strategy & Storytelling to ground our claims in customer proof, and with enablement teams to make the strongest narratives repeatable.</li> <li><strong>Market & Developer Insights:</strong> Stay close to developers, customers, the field, and the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem. Understand what people are building, where they get stuck, and how they evaluate alternatives. Turn those insights into messaging and recommendations that inform product and GTM strategy.</li> <li><strong>Impact & Measurement:</strong> Establish success measures to evaluate whether our work improves message comprehension, earns relevant developer engagement, supports cross-product activation and usage, and helps the field win.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <p><strong>First 30 days:</strong><strong><br></strong>Establish key relationships, use the products, consume an inordinate amount of content about our platform and the market, and listen to developers and field teams. You can explain where our story is compelling and where it breaks down. You’ve shipped your first meaningful piece of writing.</p> <p><strong>First 6 months:</strong><strong><br></strong>Establish a clear platform narrative and put it to work across priority launches, executive communications, and developer-facing channels. Product and GTM teams are using your positioning because it makes their work sharper. We are hitting a new level of clarity for the platform story that makes each product’s story stronger.</p> <p><strong>First year:</strong><strong><br></strong>Cloudflare’s Developer Platform has a more recognizable point of view and a clearer place in the developer and AI ecosystem. Our launches build on one another rather than telling disconnected product stories. Executive voices reinforce the same strategy without sounding scripted. Your work is measurably helping developers understand, choose, and build on the platform, and helping our field teams turn that interest into commercial impact.</p> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Product Marketing Experience:</strong> 8–10 years of experience in product marketing, technical marketing, or a related role, including meaningful ownership of positioning and adoption for developer-first products. You have an instinct for which value propositions we should lead with, for which audiences, and why. You have a demonstrated ability to turn a complex portfolio into a clear, differentiated platform story.</li> <li><strong>Technical Fluency:</strong> 5+ years working with developer tools, APIs, cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML products. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable trying products, reading technical documentation, understanding architectural tradeoffs, and asking questions that earn engineers’ trust.</li> <li><strong>Writing & Editorial Excellence:</strong> Exceptional writing, editing, and presentation skills, with work that demonstrates range across technical, commercial, and executive audiences. Strong judgment about what to say and what to leave out.</li> <li><strong>Developer & AI Instincts:</strong> Curiosity about how software is being built and how AI is changing it. You naturally follow products, competitors, and developer conversations. An instinct for what will “hit” on Hacker News and X.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Builder:</strong> Proven ability to work cross-functionally without direct authority and to navigate ambiguity. A love of chaos and comfort doing unscalable things.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $164,000 - $200,000</li> <li>For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $190,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Sales Strategy and Operations Manager, EMEA
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: In this position, you'll play a crucial role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and driving data-informed decision-making within the EMEA region. This position sits at the intersection of sales, strategy, and operations, offering the opportunity to significantly impact Notion's growth trajectory. You'll work closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimize processes, deliver actionable insights, and support key strategic initiatives. You will report directly to the Head of Field Strategy & Operations. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Partner with EMEA leadership team to define and drive strategy (e.g. territory mapping, long-term account planning, geographic expansion) and results for the region by conducting insightful analysis on local EMEA markets and customers - Support the regional rhythm of the business, including business reviews, forecasting, and pipeline management cadences. Ensure that our global operating priorities are executed thoughtfully locally balancing regional nuance with - Support regional sales leaders and sales teams in achieving their goals by providing actionable insights and visibility to sales performance metrics - Build reporting and presentations for EMEA sales leadership to update on the state of the business, both up and across the organization - Act as a partner to the EMEA sales team, providing hands-on operational support to drive deals forward and advising with decision-making - Enable smooth, efficient deal execution by supporting day-to-day deal operations, including opportunity hygiene, quote preparation, and coordination of approvals and internal handoffs, helping sellers navigate processes and remove friction throughout the deal lifecycle - Partner with the GTM Systems team to continuously enhance our sales technology stack to provide both a best-in-class experience for our sellers and a robust sales data environment - Work with cross-functional teams including Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, etc. as the primary operational counterpart on behalf of the EMEA sales org - Maintain and embed global sales policies, processes, and procedures, driving discipline with regards to strategy execution - Support global planning process locally, including target setting, capacity modeling, territory carving, etc. - Surface on-the-ground observations and insights to global sales and RevOps leadership SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 5+ years of strategy, operations, and analytics experience with a track record of driving growth - working in sales operations, preferably in a high-growth SaaS environment - Expertise to quickly drill down into the business funnel for outbound and inbound sales motions, and how that connects to revenue - Excellent analytical and quantitative modeling skills; ability to analyze and interpret data, provide actionable insights, and deliver measurable results - Expert proficiency with core sales tools (e.g. Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, etc.) and best practices for sales data management - Ability to apply AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, uncover trends, and translate complex sales data into actionable business insights. Comfortable framing analytical questions, iterating on prompts, and validating AI-generated outputs with sound business judgment and rigorous data checks, while handling sensitive information responsibly - Strong collaborator, works well with stakeholders, gains trust, enjoys working with people - Demonstrates a senior presence and can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely; can resolve tradeoffs. Effective communicator across levels and audiences - Hands on and proactive, with a builders mentality. - Maintaining high ownership mentality, demonstrated by developing projects of >6-12 months length - Notion power user or desire to learn -- prior Notion experience is not required, but you have the ability and desire to become a pro Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits.
