title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Platform: Authentication
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll be the technical lead for how every user, application, token, and automated agent proves who it is on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.</p> <p>We're an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for millions of users. We also accept identity from enterprise identity providers through Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). Behind that sit more than ten token types and several session methods that grew inside the Ruby on Rails monolith. You'll help us move this work onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. GATE exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens at the edge through a Secure Token Service written in Go.You'll set our technical direction, lead the hardest protocol and migration work yourself, and help senior engineers own the rest.</p> <p>Our projects include:</p> <ul> <li value="1"><strong><strong class="textBold">OAuth across Cells:</strong></strong> Making OAuth clients, grants, and tokens work when users and organizations live in different cells</li> <li value="2"><strong><strong class="textBold">Global identities:</strong></strong> One user identity that works across organizations and cells</li> <li value="3"><strong><strong class="textBold">Token consolidation:</strong></strong> Reducing the number of token types and moving token issuance and validation out of the monolith</li> <li value="4"><strong><strong class="textBold">Identity for artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads:</strong></strong> OAuth for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, workload identity federation, and service identities with narrow scopes</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own the technical direction for authentication protocols at GitLab, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and token exchange, across the Rails monolith and GATE services.</li> <li value="2">Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags.</li> <li value="3">Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.</li> <li value="4">Be hands-on in the most complex parts of the code, in Ruby on Rails and Go, and review the designs and merge requests of other engineers.</li> <li value="5">Agree interface contracts with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams, and keep them current as the architecture changes.</li> <li value="6">Treat authentication as a security and availability boundary: threat-model new flows, add rate limits and abuse controls, and lead the technical response to authentication incidents.</li> <li value="7">Mentor senior and intermediate engineers on the team and raise the protocol and security knowledge of the whole group.</li> <li value="8">Work asynchronously with engineers in India, Europe, and the Americas, with most decisions made in writing.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Significant experience building and running production authentication or identity systems at scale, with technical leadership across teams that moves unclear problems to written decisions and shipped code.</li> <li value="2">Deep, hands-on knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC: authorization code with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE), refresh token rotation, token exchange, client registration, scopes, and JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with signing keys and key rotation.</li> <li value="3">Working knowledge of SAML 2.0 single sign-on and enterprise identity integration (LDAP, System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or similar).</li> <li value="4">Strong production experience in Ruby on Rails or Go, willingness to work in both, and experience with careful refactors, feature-flagged rollouts, and backward-compatible migrations in large, long-lived codebases.</li> <li value="5">A security mindset. You think about token theft, replay, revocation, and blast radius before you think about elegance.</li> <li value="6">Experience with multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS) systems, including data isolation and performance under high request volume.</li> <li value="7">Clear, concise written English and comfort working in an all-remote, asynchronous company.</li> <li value="8">Optional experience: authentication libraries (Doorkeeper, Devise, or OmniAuth), passkeys or multi-factor authentication, workload identity, gateways or policy engines, AI agent authentication, or multi-region architectures. Contributions to identity standards or open source identity projects are also welcome.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Authentication group is part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. We own sign-in, single sign-on, OAuth, and personal and service tokens. Our work touches every GitLab customer, and much of it is on the critical path for Cells and for GitLab's AI agent platform.</p> <p> </p> <h2> </h2><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

You'll manage these multi-quarter programs with fixed deadlines and many dependent teams.</p> <p> </p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Hire, onboard, and grow a team of senior and intermediate engineers in Bangalore, working with talent acquisition during a high-volume hiring period.</li> <li value="2">Own delivery for your team's part of the authentication roadmap: plan in milestones, track risks early, and communicate clearly when a date is at risk and what would change it.</li> <li value="3">Work with your Staff Engineer and Product Manager to turn architecture decisions into shippable, feature-flagged increments.</li> <li value="4">Protect your team's focus. Manage requests from other teams through one intake path, and make trade-offs visible to leadership.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams across India, Europe, and the Americas.</li> <li value="6">Make sure the team runs what it builds, including on-call coverage, incident response for authentication issues, rate limits, and production readiness for new services.</li> <li value="7">Build a team culture where security comes first, decisions are written down, and code review is thorough and kind.</li> <li value="8">Give clear, regular feedback, run career conversations, and handle performance issues early.</li> <li value="8"><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Significant experience as an engineering manager of backend or platform teams, including hiring and growing senior engineers.</li> <li value="2">A background as an engineer in identity, authentication, or security systems, with enough depth in OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and JSON Web Tokens to review designs and ask probing questions.</li> <li value="3">Experience delivering complex, multi-team programs against fixed dates, including migrations that must not disrupt existing customers.</li> <li value="4">Experience running production services, including on-call coverage, incident response, and reliability work.</li> <li value="5">Working knowledge of Ruby on Rails or Go.</li> <li value="6">Experience building a new team or growing one quickly while keeping the hiring bar high.</li> <li value="7">Clear, concise written English and comfort leading a team in an all-remote, asynchronous company across time zones.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We're part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. You'll partner closely with our existing Authentication engineers in Europe and the Americas.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. title: Manager, People Operations (APJC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Available Locations: <span class="il">Singapore</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What You Would Do Here:</strong></span></p> <p>At Cloudflare, our mission is to empower our people to do their best work. We're looking for a motivated and detail-oriented <strong>People Operations Manager </strong>to join our growing team. In this manager role, you'll play a crucial part in supporting our rapidly expanding organization by ensuring the seamless and efficient experience for our employees, from inquiry resolution to accurate data management, and auditing of critical People and Payroll processes within the APJC region.</p> <p>You'll be instrumental in <strong>guiding and developing a team</strong> focused on delivering world-class employee inquiry support. This includes acting as an <strong>escalation point for more complex matters</strong> involving People and Payroll questions, and ensuring that all transactions meet minimum standards, keeping our people systems auditable, clean, and up-to-date. A key focus will be on <strong>providing high-quality customer support to our internal clients and stakeholders</strong>, ensuring their needs are met with efficiency and accuracy. As we scale, you'll also have exciting opportunities to <strong>contribute to the design and improvement of our existing processes</strong>, aligning our operations across multiple regions.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead HR Service Delivery: Guide and develop a team focused on providing world-class employee inquiry support, serving as an escalation point for complex People and Payroll matters.</li> <li>Ensure Data Integrity & Compliance: Oversee HR transactions to ensure they meet minimum standards, maintaining auditable, clean, and up-to-date people systems.</li> <li>Drive Operational Excellence: Partner with regional senior management and stakeholders to address their specific HR operational needs with high responsiveness and accuracy.</li> <li>Manage Payroll Operations: Oversee monthly payroll inputs, ensuring accuracy and timely submission.</li> <li>Uphold Compliance Standards: Manage adherence to SOX Control & Compliance, ensuring all Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) requirements are meticulously followed and documented.</li> <li>Optimize HR Processes: Contribute to the design, tracking, and implementation of improvements for HR business processes, translating operational needs into technical requirements.</li> <li>Facilitate Regional Approvals: Manage the regional offer approval process, ensuring strict compliance with internal guidelines.</li> <li>Support System Enhancements: Contribute to the implementation of improvement projects defined by the People Services group, collaborating with Centers of Excellence (COEs) and other internal teams to test new functionality and troubleshoot technical issues within HR systems.</li> <li>Analyze & Report: Analyze support tickets and HR business processes to provide regional status insights and identify opportunities for continuous process enhancements.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You'll Bring:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience: 3+ years of leadership experience in People Operations, HR Service Delivery, or Payroll.</li> <li>HR Systems & AI Tools Expertise: Familiarity with HR systems such as Workday and Zendesk, as well as experience leveraging AI-driven HR tools and automated ticket/inquiry triage solutions. Experience with Core HR, Talent, and Compensation modules is a plus.</li> <li>Process Improvement & Automation Mindset: Proven ability to support and contribute to projects aimed at enhancing operational efficiency, including leveraging AI-assisted workflows to optimize service delivery.</li> <li>Attention to Detail & Accuracy: Highly detailed and process-oriented with a strong commitment to accuracy in all HR transactions and data management.</li> <li>Compliance Knowledge: Foundational knowledge of APJC countries' employment law and a clear understanding of operating within these regulatory environments.</li> <li>Customer Focus: A strong customer service orientation and a dedication to delivering a positive internal client and employee experience.</li> <li>Communication Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly present information and respond to cross-regional and cross-functional inquiries.</li> <li>Prioritization & Execution: Adept at prioritizing tasks, executing effectively, and providing clear status reports as needed.</li> <li>Organizational & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time management abilities.</li> <li>Adaptability & Technical Aptitude: Highly adaptable in a global, fast-paced environment with a willingness to adopt AI-assisted data analysis and reporting tools to streamline APJC operations.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Data Center Operations Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Boston, MA | Dallas, TX | Salt Lake City, UT  (This role requires you to be onsite 5 days a week in one of our locations)</strong></p> <h1>About the Department</h1> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h1>About the Role</h1> <p>We're looking for Data Center Engineers to be the hands, eyes and judgment on the ground at our new sites. You'll work on-site every day at your home data center, helping bring it online and keeping its hardware healthy once it's in production.</p> <p>You'll rack, cable and replace equipment, troubleshoot servers and network gear well past a simple parts swap, and keep every asset accurately documented from the moment it arrives. You'll work alongside colocation staff, integrators and partner teams, and support other sites remotely when the team needs you. Experienced engineers will have room to act as the technical lead for their site, mentor others, and help set the standards the team uses everywhere.</p> <p>We're building these sites to run with less manual effort than traditional data centers. When something breaks, we expect you to fix it for good, not just for today, and to use AI and automation to make the fix stick, whether that means a better runbook, a script, or a change to how the team works.</p> <p>This role is hands-on at the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. You'll use the command line to troubleshoot servers and Layer 2 network issues, but network configuration and server provisioning are owned by partner engineering teams.</p> <h1>What You'll Do</h1> <h2>Site Builds</h2> <ul> <li>Support integrated site builds: receive and inspect hardware, rack and stack equipment, and run and dress structured cabling to standard.</li> <li>Verify integrator and contractor work against build specifications, drive defects to resolution, and make sure sites are production-ready before handoff.</li> </ul> <h2>Break/Fix and Troubleshooting</h2> <ul> <li>Triage and troubleshoot server hardware using BMC/IPMI, hardware logs, diagnostics and firmware tools. Find the root cause instead of swapping parts until something works.</li> <li>Replace components and whole systems, including servers, switches and optics, safely and with minimal disruption.</li> <li>Troubleshoot Layer 1 and Layer 2 issues: console into network devices, read interface and link state from the command line, inspect and clean optics, check light levels, and test fiber with a light meter or OTDR.</li> </ul> <h2>On-Call and Incidents</h2> <ul> <li>Take part in an on-call rotation and respond on site to incidents affecting hardware at your data center.</li> <li>Document what happened and what you did, and contribute to root-cause analysis and follow-up actions.</li> </ul> <h2>AI, Automation and Continuous Improvement</h2> <ul> <li>Solve problems for good. When an issue repeats, find the underlying cause and change the process, runbook or tooling so it doesn't come back.</li> <li>Use AI tools as part of your daily work: to speed up troubleshooting, interpret hardware and network logs, draft and improve documentation and runbooks, and summarize incidents.</li> <li>Find repetitive manual work and remove it with scripting, automation or AI-assisted workflows, or turn it into clear requirements for tooling teams.</li> <li>Share what works so the rest of the team can adopt it across every site.</li> </ul> <h2>Documentation and DCIM</h2> <ul> <li>Keep DCIM records accurate in real time, including rack elevations, cabling, power and asset location, from receipt through decommissioning.</li> <li>Follow and improve runbooks and build standards so work is repeatable across sites.</li> </ul> <h2>Logistics and Hardware Lifecycle</h2> <ul> <li>Own receiving, shipping and spares inventory at your site, and process RMAs end to end.</li> <li>Perform on-site decommissioning: unracking, serial number verification and chain of custody through handoff for secure destruction.</li> </ul> <h2>Vendors, Partners and Compliance</h2> <ul> <li>Escort and supervise colocation remote-hands staff, contractors and integrators working at your site, and hold them to our quality and safety standards.</li> <li>Work directly with partner teams to coordinate access, maintenance and escalations for your site.</li> <li>Follow physical security, access control and compliance procedures without exception, and help produce accurate evidence for audits.</li> </ul> <h2>Supporting Other Sites</h2> <ul> <li>Support other sites remotely, for example by guiding remote hands or reviewing documentation, and travel occasionally to help with builds or surges.</li> </ul> <h1>Who You Are</h1> <p><strong>Careful and precise.</strong> Clean cabling, correct labels and accurate records matter to you. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p> <p><strong>Dependable on your own.</strong> You're often the only Cloudflare person on site. You work independently, communicate clearly with a remote team, and know when to escalate.</p> <p><strong>Security-minded.</strong> You understand that access rules and chain of custody exist for a reason, and you follow them every time.</p> <p><strong>A troubleshooter, not a parts swapper.</strong> You want to know why something failed, and you use logs, diagnostics and the command line to find out.</p> <p><strong>Someone who makes the team better.</strong> You share what you learn, help newer teammates get up to speed, and take ownership of your site's outcomes.</p> <p><strong>AI-fluent and automation-first.</strong> Your first instinct is to solve a problem for good, not work around it again. You reach for AI tools and automation to troubleshoot faster, document better and improve how the team works, and you check the output before you trust it.</p> <h1>Required Experience</h1> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience in data center, network or server hardware operations, including working independently on site.</li> <li>Experience racking, stacking and cabling servers and network equipment, and replacing whole systems and components.</li> <li>Solid working knowledge of structured cabling standards, fiber and copper, and optics.</li> <li>Hardware troubleshooting beyond parts swaps, including BMC/IPMI, hardware logs, diagnostics and firmware.</li> <li>Comfort with the Linux command line and with network device CLIs to troubleshoot Layer 1 and Layer 2 issues.</li> <li>Experience with fiber inspection, cleaning and testing, including light meters or OTDR.</li> <li>Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your technical work, such as troubleshooting, log analysis or documentation, and examples of improving a process instead of repeating a workaround.</li> <li>Experience with asset tracking, DCIM or inventory systems, and with receiving, shipping and RMA processes.</li> <li>Experience working in colocation facilities and with third-party vendors or contractors.</li> <li>Willingness to take part in an on-call rotation and respond on site.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting work and updating tickets.</li> <li>A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and proximity to your assigned data center.</li> <li>Ability to travel occasionally to other sites.</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred Qualifications</h1> <ul> <li>Experience as a technical lead or primary on-site contact for a data center, including leading on-site incident response.</li> <li>Experience mentoring or training other technicians or engineers.</li> <li>Experience writing runbooks, build standards or checklists used across multiple sites.</li> <li>Experience supporting or leading new data center builds or integrated rack deployments.</li> <li>Scripting experience (for example Bash or Python), or experience building automation or AI-assisted workflows that reduced manual work.</li> <li>Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+ or Linux+, CCNA, BICSI, or data center certifications (for example CDCP or CDCTP).</li> <li>Experience with DCIM and source-of-truth tooling such as NetBox or Nlyte, and Jira-based workflows.</li> <li>Experience at a hyperscaler, cloud provider, major CDN or similarly large infrastructure operator.</li> <li>Experience with ITAD and secure destruction processes.</li> </ul> <p>We also consider candidates earlier in their careers who bring strong fundamentals and a drive to learn.</p> <h1>Physical Requirements</h1> <ul> <li>Lift and move equipment up to 50 lbs, and handle heavier equipment with a team or lift assist.</li> <li>Stand, walk, bend, kneel and work in tight or elevated spaces for extended periods.</li> <li>Work in loud, cold, and tightly controlled data center environments.</li> <li>Use ladders, lifts and carts safely.</li> </ul> <p><em>These are essential functions of the role. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.</em></p

We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. The ideal candidate possesses unparalleled strategic influence, a profound understanding of localized public sector enterprise architecture, and the ability to proactively shape how Cloudflare advances modern, resilient cloud operating models for critical regional infrastructure and higher education.</p> <p>As a Client Executive, you will consistently demonstrate the highest level of sales mastery, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. This role demands the ability to influence and engage at the highest executive levels—including <strong>County/City CIOs and CISOs, Agency Directors, University Vice Chancellors, and Chief Financial Officers</strong>—while leading highly specialized cross-functional teams to secure enterprise-wide adoptions and forge transformative digital innovation partnerships.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Strategic Regional Revenue & Contract Leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Architect and execute strategies to consistently exceed ambitious multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas across the territory.</li> <li>Pioneer contract strategies utilizing localized and education-specific purchasing vehicles (e.g., <strong>DIR, OMNIA Partners, NASPO ValuePoint</strong>, and county-specific master service agreements) to streamline procurement and maximize Cloudflare's regional footprint.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Local Government & Institutional Architecture Alignment</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Apply mastery in understanding and influencing Enterprise Architecture across all four pillars (mission/business, data, applications, technology) within highly complex, decentralized public environments.</li> <li>Map Cloudflare’s capabilities directly to localized public sector challenges—ensuring robust protection for citizen and student PII, compliance with <strong>CJIS, FERPA, and FEDRamp</strong>, and seamless defense against ransomware or DDoS disruptions targeting critical regional infrastructure and public utilities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>TOLA Executive & Civic Stakeholder Engagement</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead and orchestrate multiple, simultaneous, highly complex engagements across the State’s premier public landscape, including major local governments (e.g., <strong>Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas and Louisiana Agencies, The largest Counties and Cities</strong>) and higher education ecosystems (e.g., <strong>UT, Texas A&M, U of Houston, Texas State, U of N. sectors.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Digital Transformation & Critical Infrastructure Protection</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exhibit mastery in understanding the intricate nuances of digital transformation in <li>Identify regional market shifts, regulatory compliance mandates, and public sector-specific needs to construct pioneering digital innovation partnerships between Cloudflare and TOLA’s leading institutions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>12+ years of unparalleled experience</strong> selling complex, leadership, major municipal agencies, administrators, and prominent universities across the TOLA region.</li> <li><strong>Strong familiarity with public procurement protocols</strong>, including In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p> <p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p> <p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p> <h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. Both modes are equally core.</p> <p><strong>Rapid response.</strong> When a customer issue surfaces that is high-severity, cross-layer and complex, you are the engineer who answers. You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation.</p> <p><strong>Proactive engineering.</strong> When no fire is burning, you work with Product Engineering and our platform teams to build the capabilities that make the next fire cheaper or unnecessary: telemetry pipelines that correlate signals across the customer base, detectors that fire before a human notices, diagnostic tooling that scales across hundreds of customers, automation that reduces toil for Customer Support. Every incident you carry generates engineering output that reduces the cost of recurrence. The work compounds.</p> <p>Cloudflare is building CRE as an AI-native function. You will work with and help build agents and tooling that pre-diagnose incidents, surface relevant logs and configuration, and propose fixes with cited evidence. Engineers who ship AI-assisted diagnostics are the ones defining this discipline.</p> <h3><strong>What You Might Work On</strong></h3> <p><strong>Rapid response:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own a Sev-1 incident where a large financial services customer sees asymmetric latency from a single POP. Trace it through BGP routing and origin configuration. Produce the fix upstream.</li> <li>Diagnose a recurring WebSocket disconnect that a media customer has been fighting for weeks. Isolate it to a specific interaction between WAF and their origin load balancer. Drive the fix with Product Engineering.</li> <li>Partner with a government customer's SRE team during an active DDoS event. Help them shape their Magic Transit and WAF configuration in real time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Proactive engineering:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, with Product Engineering, a distributed tracing capability that correlates Cloudflare edge signals with customer origin metrics so a single query tells the story of a failing request end-to-end.</li> <li>Ship a detector for a class of WAF false positives silently degrading several customers. Get it into production before the next renewal cycle.</li> <li>Prototype an AI agent that takes a new customer case, pulls relevant logs and config, and proposes a root cause with linked evidence. Deploy it internally. Measure whether it makes engineers faster. Iterate.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><strong>Rapid incident response and root cause analysis.</strong> Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. Lead deep-dive debugging across the full stack: edge, network, DNS, transport, APIs, application, customer-side configuration. Reproduce defects, validate fixes with Engineering, and confirm customer-side resolution. Produce postmortems other engineers rely on. Hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global rotation that includes weekends.</p> <p><strong>Proactive reliability engineering.</strong> Analyze support and telemetry signals across the customer base to find systemic risks before they become incidents. Contribute monitoring, detection, and diagnostic capability to the core product and the engineering systems that give Customer Support early visibility into customer-affecting issues. Define customer-facing reliability metrics (error rates, resolution times, repeat-contact rates) and drive measurable improvement. Write automation that reduces mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve.</p> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership.</strong> Manage the technical escalation lifecycle with clear ownership and timely communication. Partner with Product Engineering to drive fixes, workarounds, and configuration changes that address underlying gaps. Represent the customer reliability perspective in engineering syncs, incident reviews, and post-mortem processes.</p> <p><strong>Technical leadership and enablement.</strong> Raise the technical floor of Customer Support through pair-debugging, structured knowledge transfer, and shared tooling. Document diagnostic procedures and resolution patterns in runbooks, internal knowledge bases, and AI skills. Share insights from customer-facing incidents to improve product documentation and operational readiness.</p> <p><strong>Product and platform depth.</strong> Maintain deep, current expertise across Cloudflare's product portfolio: edge networking, DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, Zero Trust, Workers, and our developer platform. Anticipate customer impact from new releases and architecture changes. Serve as a go-to subject-matter expert in one or more domains.</p> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in site reliability engineering, escalation engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable deeply technical support / operations role, with at least 2 years in customer-facing environments.</li> <li>Strong foundation in networking and security:</li> <ul> <li>TCP/IP fundamentals: OSI model, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing, switching.</li> <li>Core protocols: DNS, HTTP/S, TLS/SSL, SMTP, SNMP, NTP.</li> <li>Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, including path selection and route propagation.</li> <li>Firewall concepts: stateful/stateless inspection, rule sets, NAT, ACLs.</li> <li>VPN and encryption: IPSec, SSL/TLS tunnels, GRE.</li> <li>Zero Trust architecture, network segmentation, modern security models.</li> </ul> <li>Proficiency with observability and diagnostic tooling: packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump), log aggregation (Kibana, Elasticsearch), metrics dashboards (Grafana), distributed tracing.</li> <li>Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python) with a track record of shipping tooling that improves reliability and reduces toil.</li> <li>Experience with incident management, postmortem culture, and SLO/SLI-based reliability practices.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication. Composure under pressure during high-severity incidents.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desired Skills & Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering experience with direct customer-facing accountability.</li> <li>Deep expertise at both L3/L4 (network infrastructure) and L7 (application protocols, DNS, HTTP, WebSocket).</li> <li>Expert-level proficiency with Linux command-line tools: curl, dig, git, traceroute, mtr, strace, ss.</li> <li>Data-at-scale analysis using SQL, PromQL, or equivalent.</li> <li>Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).</li> <li>Track record of building internal tooling or diagnostic utilities that measurably improved team efficiency.</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving cross-team initiatives, influencing outcomes without direct authority.</li> <li>Experience applying AI/ML to production engineering or operational workflows.</li> <li>Comfort engaging directly with enterprise customer engineering teams, including on calls during incidents.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Active Cloudflare user who understands the platform as a practitioner.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Workers, Page

This critical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running Cloudflare's data center and network infrastructure across 700+ sites worldwide.</p> <p>The DCSC team manages physical access control and compliance auditing across one of the most complex and distributed infrastructure footprints in the industry, spanning more than 105 vendor portals, hundreds of non-portal carrier-neutral and edge partner sites, and multiple regulatory frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. You will interview the team to understand each workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation targets, and ship tooling that demonstrably reduces the time it takes to close a QAR cycle, produce an audit evidence package, or manage a batch of access provisioning requests. You will work in close partnership with the DCSC coordinators, and existing automation developers, and will own the DCSC operational tooling roadmap.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Portal Automation & User List Extraction</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Browser Automation: Design and maintain automated scripts (Playwright, Puppeteer, or equivalent) that log into vendor data center portals, extract user access lists, and feed structured output into the DCSC Portal and comparison pipelines replacing manual portal-by-portal data collection across 105+ portals covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> ACL Reconciliation & Diff Engine</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Automated Comparison: Build tooling that ingests portal-extracted user lists and compares them against the master Access Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> <li>Exception-Only Output: Route confirmed discrepancies directly to pre-populated Jira tickets for human review and action, eliminating the need for coordinators to perform full manual review of every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Attestation & Evidence Automation</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Attestation Module: Own and extend the attestation workflow within the DCSC Portal, including automated cycle triggering, manager notification, time-stamped confirmation capture, and exception escalation, replacing manual screenshot-based evidence gathering.</li> <li>Evidence Package Builder: Build automated pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and correspondence into structured packages keyed to specific control IDs.</li> <li>GRC Alignment: Work directly with GRC counterparts to validate that automated evidence formats meet auditor and regulatory requirements before deployment.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection & Triage</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Pattern Analysis: Implement LLM-based review passes over QAR cycle output to surface patterns warranting human escalation: former employees retaining access, access creep over time, dormant accounts, and anomalous role assignments across sites.</li> <li>Ticket Intelligence: Build automation that reads incoming Jira onboarding and offboarding tickets and generates structured, portal-specific action checklists reducing coordinator cognitive load and preventing missed steps across multi-portal provisioning workflows.</li> <li>Continuous Improvement: Monitor automation output quality over time, retrain or recalibrate models as portal structures change, and maintain a feedback loop with coordinators on false positives and missed detections.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> DCSC Portal Ownership & Tooling Roadmap</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Platform Stewardship: Own the DCSC Portal as the operational runtime for all automation and workflow tooling ensuring it remains stable, documented, and usable by coordinators without engineering support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or equivalent) against real-world web applications, including handling authentication flows, dynamic content, and anti-bot mitigations.</li> <li>TypeScript Proficiency: Strong skills for scripting, data wrangling, structured file I/O, and API integration. Ability to write maintainable, documented code that non-engineers can operate.</li> <li>LLM Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent) into production workflows for classification, drafting, summarization, or anomaly detection tasks.</li> <li>Data Engineering Fundamentals: Comfort working with structured and semi-structured data at scale, diffing datasets, normalizing inconsistent formats, and producing clean outputs for downstream audit use.</li> <li>API & Workflow Integration: Experience building integrations with ticketing or ITSM systems (Jira preferred) via REST API, including automated ticket creation, status updates, and attachment handling.</li> <li>Systems Thinking: Ability to map an end-to-end manual workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation insertion points, and ship incrementally without waiting for a perfect solution.</li> <li>Workflow Archaeology: Comfortable extracting process knowledge from subject-matter experts through structured interviews turning tribal knowledge into documented, automatable workflows.</li> <li>Bias Toward Simplicity: Strong product intuition for the minimum viable automation that delivers real time savings, rather than over-engineering for edge cases.</li> <li>Compliance Awareness: Appreciation for the stakes of accuracy in a compliance context, understanding that an incorrect ACL diff or a missing evidence artifact has real audit consequences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Communication: Able to explain automation design decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders including compliance coordinators and GRC partners.</li> <li>Ambiguity Tolerance: Vendor portals don't come with documentation. Workflows are passed down verbally. You need to be energized by figuring things out from scratch.</li> <li>Preferred Qualifications</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers or similar edge compute platforms</li> <li>Familiarity with GRC/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001) at an operational level — not as an auditor, but enough to understand why evidence integrity matters</li> <li>RPA tooling experience (UiPath, Power Automate) as fallback for portals that defeat headless browsers</li> <li>Prior work in infrastructure operations, data center, or physical security environments</li> <li>Experience building internal tooling or developer-facing portals (not just scripts)</li> </ul> <p></p> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1

structure</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Treasury team on the company’s broader capital markets strategy, including debt, convertible, and other structured transactions, and — models, trackers, and workflows that let a small team operate with speed and accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of experience</strong> across structured or project finance, infrastructure investing, private credit, equipment leasing, private equity, investment banking, and/or corporate capital markets — vendor financing, and debt or convertible capital markets — plus creativity in designing new structures to meet company goals.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling, credit analysis, and transaction documentation skills</strong>, including familiarity with credit agreements, master lease agreements, and related legal documentation.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of the accounting and tax implications</strong> of financing structures, and comfort partnering with Accounting, Tax, and Legal to get them right.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication Here at Cloudflare, stablecoin payments are a core initiative developing blockchain-based settlement systems, programmable agent wallets, and cryptographic primitives to make the web <strong>payable</strong> at machine scale. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that leverage Web3 wallets and decentralized rails to give domain owners and agents secure, scalable settlement options.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. This role is a great fit for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.</li> <li>You are technically credible with experienced blockchain and systems engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in smart contract security or decentralized architecture, and evaluate cryptographic protocols.</li> <li>You are comfortable managing a team working across specialized crypto topics (like decentralized settlement, programmable wallets, and key management systems).</li> <li>You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.</li> <li>You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.</li> <li>You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong technical grounding in blockchain architecture, smart contract environments, and cryptographic key management. Past experience working on consumer or enterprise cryptocurrency wallets is a plus.</li> <li>Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.</li> <li>A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.</li> <li>Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with decentralized payment protocols or blockchain frameworks (e.g., Bitcoin Lightning, Ethereum rollups).</li> <li>Experience building hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure, such as onramp/offramp providers or apps where cryptocurrencies are invisible to users.</li> <li>Familiarity with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, Durable Objects, KV) or edge computing architectures.</li> <li>Experience turning complex underlying systems into useful payment or commerce products for a broad audience.</li> <li>Experience with usage-based billing, metering engines, attribution systems, or complex commercial pricing models.</li> <li>Previous experience working in payments or on payments technology (fiat or crypto)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $200,000 - Every serious application will need access to many models across many providers, with reliability, observability, security, cost control, and routing built in from the start. AI Gateway is Cloudflare's bet that this layer belongs at the network edge: close to users, close to compute, and simple enough that a developer can adopt it with one API change.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Developers using AI Gateway need answers to two questions. Is the model I'm calling working the way you say it does? And which model should I be using at all? You'll lead the models team that answers both.</p> <p data-path-to-node="5">You'll start with model operations. That's the work behind every model in the catalog: provider integrations, capability testing, pricing and metering, capacity, security reviews, docs, health, and deprecations. Sometimes a launch needs to go live within minutes of a lab's announcement. Sometimes the right call is to hold it. Cloudflare is an infrastructure company at heart, so reliability and accuracy come first; speed comes from preparation and automation.</p> <p data-path-to-node="6">Then you'll bring model intelligence online. That means turning what we learn from Gateway traffic into decisions for customers: capability maps, per-task rankings, auto-routing profiles that pick the right model for each request, evals and regression detection, and market intelligence developers can trust.</p> <p data-path-to-node="7">This is a people-management role reporting to the AI Gateway Engineering Manager. You'll hire, develop, and lead the team, and you'll stay hands-on: writing code, building agent-driven workflows, and getting into the details of a failed launch or a suspicious eval SLO. Expect to manage people, projects, model stock, and operations all at once.</p> <h3 data-path-to-node="9">About the Role</h3> <ul> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Build and lead the models team:</strong> Hire, coach, and grow the people who run the catalog today and build its intelligence over time. Give people real ownership, give direct feedback, and grow leads who can run their own areas.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Run model launches end-to-end:</strong> Scope integrations, coordinate testing and evals, confirm pricing, metering, capacity, and security, and get docs and announcements ready. Prepare day-zero launches in advance so they can ship in minutes.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Keep the catalog true:</strong> Make sure what we publish (capabilities, limits, versions, prices) matches what developers actually get. Catch silent regressions, such as broken tool calling, truncated streams, quantization changes, or usage and pricing mismatches, before customers do.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Build model intelligence:</strong> As it comes online, own the evals, capability maps, and per-task rankings behind our auto-routing profiles and model recommendations. Make sure they measure what they claim to, and connect regressions to routing decisions so customers who chose "auto" aren't the ones who discover a problem.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Treat the catalog and intelligence as products:</strong> Have a point of view on which models belong in the catalog, which routing profiles to ship, and what market intelligence to publish. Base it on usage, quality, reliability, and cost data. Turn what you learn into roadmap input.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,5,0" data-index-in-node="0">Run a lightweight operating cadence:</strong> Keep one source of truth for what's in flight, who owns it, what's blocked, and what ships next. Keep Engineering, Product, Partnerships, and other stakeholders aligned and informed without status meetings.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="10,6,0" data-index-in-node="0">Automate relentlessly:</strong> Turn repeatable steps into scripts, tools, and agent workflows: endpoint validation, eval runs, catalog and pricing reconciliation, regression detection, and provider follow-ups. Manual effort per launch should fall as the catalog grows.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="12">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="13,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Day-Zero & Quality Launches:</strong> Ensure new models launch on day zero with tested capabilities, accurate pricing, docs, and a clear call on routing eligibility.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Catalog Reliability & Health:</strong> Ensure the catalog reflects reality, and proactively identify when a model or provider is underperforming before customers notice.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Auto-Routing & Optimization:</strong> Deliver auto-routing that measurably beats a fixed model choice on cost or quality for users.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Developer Trust & Methodology:</strong> Build and maintain trusted rankings and recommendations grounded in solid methodology.</li> <li data-path-to-node="13,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="13,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Partner & Stakeholder Management:</strong> Set clear expectations for providers, while keeping Engineering, Product, Partnerships, and other stakeholders aligned.</li> <li Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s Strategic Partnerships team operates at the intersection of technology, media, and emergent AI business models. We sit at the tip of the spear—bridging what Cloudflare builds with executive market needs, navigating complex ecosystem shifts, and driving "zero-to-one" commercial and strategic initiatives.</p> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Strategic Partnerships Operations Manager</strong> to bring structural rigor, operational efficiency, and scalable execution to our team. In this role, you will be the connective tissue between Strategic Partnerships and core internal functions like Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Product Marketing.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <p>You will design and run the team's operational backbone, build mechanisms to synthesize and scale external feedback back into our product roadmaps, and craft high-impact collateral for new solutions we bring to market. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical fluency, operates with high autonomy, and leverages modern AI tools to scale their impact.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>1. Operational Infrastructure & Rhythm</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Design & Scale Team Cadences:</strong> Establish project management frameworks, tracking systems, and operational rhythms for the Strategic Partnerships organization to ensure visibility across high-stakes initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Workflow Automation:</strong> Utilize modern AI tools and automated workflows to centralize partner data, streamline pipeline management, and reduce manual reporting overhead.</li> <li><strong>Resource & Initiative Management:</strong> Serve as the central point of operational contact, tracking partner milestones, pilot launches, and cross-functional commitments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. Cross-Functional Feedback Loops</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Synthesize Market Signals:</strong> Capture, structure, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights gathered from key executive partners, publishers, and AI platforms.</li> <li><strong>Bridge Strategy, Product, & Sales:</strong> Build repeatable feedback loops with Product Management and Engineering to inform product roadmaps based on partner requirements and emerging ecosystem trends.</li> <li><strong>Field & Enablement Alignment:</strong> Partner with Sales and Go-To-Market teams to ensure partner learnings, tactical objection handling, and market narratives are operationalized across customer-facing teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Product Collateral & Go-To-Market Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Collateral Architecture:</strong> Create executive-ready product collateral—such as message houses, solution one-sheets, presentation decks, and enablement briefs—to commercialize strategic initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Technical Storytelling:</strong> Translate complex technical infrastructure, AI Gateway mechanisms, crawler policies, and edge-computing capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for external partners and internal leaders.</li> <li><strong>Launch & Pilot Enablement:</strong> Coordinate pilot rollouts and partnership launches, ensuring marketing, product documentation, and collateral are aligned for external execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Execution-Driven & Structured:</strong> You bring order to ambiguous environment. You enjoy building processes from scratch and making team operations run like clockwork.</li> <li><strong>Technically Fluent:</strong> You understand modern internet infrastructure, APIs, web crawling, and the AI/LLM ecosystem. You can comfortably engage with product managers and engineers on technical nuances.</li> <li><strong>AI-Native Mindset:</strong> You actively use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, workflow automation agents) in your daily work to multiply your output, synthesize data, and automate routine tasks.</li> <li><strong>Master Communicator:</strong> You possess exceptional written and visual storytelling skills. You can distill dense technical details into crisp, polished executive collateral.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative & Proactive:</strong> You thrive in cross-functional matrixed environments. You don't wait for a playbook—you build it while collaborating seamlessly across teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years of experience in Business Operations, Strategic Partnerships, Product Marketing, Management Consulting, or Program Management within a high-growth tech environment.</li> <li><strong>Technical Aptitude:</strong> Demonstrated ability to comprehend complex technical products, platform infrastructure, or developer tools.</li> <li><strong>Track Record:</strong> Proven success in establishing cross-functional operating models and authoring external customer/partner collateral.</li> <li><strong>AI Tooling Proficiency:</strong> Experience leveraging AI platforms and automation tools to scale personal and team workflows.</li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> Based in or willing to work hybrid from Cloudflare’s <strong>San Francisco, CA,</strong> <strong>New York, NY </strong>or <strong>Austin, TX</strong> offices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $195,000 - $268,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $186,000 - $255,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Several of us maintain or regularly contribute to the Linux kernel, and our default is to fix problems in mainline rather than carry private patches. This role is built on that principle.</p> <p><strong>The problem you would own</strong></p> <p>Using memory efficiently is one of the highest-leverage problems we have. At our scale, how the kernel's memory-management subsystem behaves under pressure has direct consequences for both performance and cost. As DRAM prices climb, getting more out of the memory we already own is a real lever on infrastructure spend.</p> <p>Using custom low-overhead instrumentation on production servers, we have identified several scalability bottlenecks in the kernel memory layer that show up under real workloads.
