title: Director, Support (Bengaluru)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As Director, Support Engineering for our Bengaluru Center of Support, you'll build and manage GitLab's India-based regional support hub as a strategic peer to our Americas and Europe, Middle East, and Africa hubs. Reporting to the Vice President of Support Engineering, you'll own the hub's organizational design, headcount growth, management infrastructure, and operating standards while building a healthy team that delivers enterprise-grade technical support across Asia-Pacific and Europe, Middle East, and Africa time zones. This remote-friendly role is based in Bengaluru, India.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design and build the Bengaluru hub's organizational structure, including specialist and management roles, customer and product segmentation, and shift coverage models.</li> <li value="2">Establish the management infrastructure, operating rhythms, escalation frameworks, and quality standards needed to support sustainable headcount growth.</li> <li value="3">Manage hiring and retention in partnership with Talent Acquisition, including role profiles, interview panels, offer selections, career paths, internal mobility, recognition, and team culture.</li> <li value="4">Develop managers and support engineers, set clear performance expectations, provide transparent feedback, and create pathways into global Support Engineering management roles.</li> <li value="5">Own performance against service-level targets, customer satisfaction, ticket quality, resolution metrics, and transparent reporting against global key performance indicators.</li> <li value="6">Implement local escalation workflows, Request for Help integration, and shift handoff protocols across the Asia-Pacific, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Americas support hubs.</li> <li value="7"><strong>Guide</strong> the hub's use of GitLab's artificial intelligence toolchain and partner with Support Operations and Strategy on tooling, analytics, and process automation.</li> <li value="8">Work with regional Support Engineering managers, Product, Engineering, and the Vice President of Support Engineering on global strategy, customer insights, operating plans, headcount models, and the Support Engineering roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Experience managing technical support engineering or a closely related customer-facing technical function, including through a manager-of-managers structure.</li> <li value="2">A record of building or significantly scaling a support organization, including organizational design, hiring infrastructure, onboarding, and team culture.</li> <li value="3">Experience establishing a global delivery hub or Center of Support and coordinating service delivery across regions and time zones.</li> <li value="4">Deep knowledge of supporting enterprise software as a service, including managing service-level obligations, tiered support models, escalation frameworks, and operational metrics.</li> <li value="5">Experience working in a distributed environment that combines asynchronous and synchronous collaboration, with clear written and verbal communication.</li> <li value="6">Familiarity with AI-assisted support tooling and experience introducing new tools or automation at scale.</li> <li value="7">Demonstrated ability to retain and develop technical team members in a dynamic hiring market.</li> <li value="8">Knowledge of DevSecOps platforms, continuous integration and continuous delivery tooling, Kubernetes, or cloud-native infrastructure, along with experience using support platforms such as Zendesk, Salesforce, Decagon, or equivalent tools. Experience with GitLab as a user, administrator, or customer is helpful.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The GitLab Support Engineering team is distributed across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. Support engineers and managers work on tickets and help GitLab's customers. We also examine code and logs to find root causes. We solve complex problems collectively, participate in pairing sessions and one-on-ones, and stay in communication across time zones through deliberate asynchronous work habits. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.</li> <li value="2">Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.</li> <li value="3">Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.</li> <li value="4">Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.</li> <li value="5">Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.</li> <li value="6">Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.</li> <li value="7">Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.</li> <li value="2">Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.</li> <li value="3">A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.</li> <li value="4">Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.</li> <li value="5">Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.</li> <li value="6">Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.</p> <p>GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.</p> <p>Some of our projects include:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation</li> <li value="2">Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith</li> <li value="3">Building passkeys and passwordless authentication</li> <li value="4">Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI</li> <li value="5">Improving service accounts and secure automation</li> <li value="6">Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.</li> <li value="2">Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="3">Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.</li> <li value="4">Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="5">Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</li> <li value="6">Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.</li> <li value="7">Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.</li> <li value="8">Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.</li> <li value="9">Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.</li> <li value="9">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).</li> <li value="3">Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.</li> <li value="4">Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.</li> <li value="5">Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.</li> <li value="6">Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.</li> <li value="7">Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.</p> <p>Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you'll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges while running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You'll join the Engineering department and work directly with customers as they encounter edge cases. You'll dig into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source.</p> <p>You'll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you'll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed GitLab and GitLab.com software as a service, and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlab-detective">A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos">A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/sosparser">A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns</a></li> <li><a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/chatops/">A ChatOps feature that makes it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com</a></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as an escalation point for difficult customer interactions and lead the resolution of complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.</li> <li>Mentor and guide teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Advocate for and drive improvements to support practices, product quality, and reusable documentation and support content that directly influence team objectives.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmaps, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.</li> <li>Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations during daytime hours, providing emergency support for self-managed GitLab and software as a service customers and coordinating incident communications with the GitLab.com Production team.</li> <li>Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from initial contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, resolution, and clear customer communication, including difficult or escalated interactions.</li> <li>Strong experience with Linux systems administration, scripting, Git, and continuous integration and continuous delivery in production or customer environments, with the ability to investigate issues at both the infrastructure and application levels.</li> <li>Ability to mentor teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions, case reviews, and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to turn customer feedback into product fixes, feature improvements, and roadmap priorities.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless computing, and an understanding of how different GitLab implementations operate and affect customers.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to learn, collaborate across teams, and apply transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're a globally distributed group of Support Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis.<br><strong>Large Scale Operations Background: </strong>Experience supporting infrastructure for many customers or environments simultaneously. Comfortable managing isolation, scaling, monitoring, and incident response across diverse workloads.<br><strong>Architecture & Incident Response:</strong> Able to reason through complex systems and operational challenges. Brings on-call experience and can lead technical discussions and incident resolution efforts under pressure.<br><strong>Customer-Focused Collaboration: </strong>Proven ability to work across teams and with internal or external customers to solve technical problems while maintaining service commitments and clear communication.<br><strong>GitLab Platform Proficiency: </strong>Comfortable using GitLab as a daily tool for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and operational workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>GitLab’s Dedicated team, where the SRE Environment Automation role sits, is on a mission to deliver a fully managed, single-tenant GitLab experience through the GitLab Dedicated platform. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team, you'll set the technical direction for the telemetry, detection, and reconciliation tooling that identifies billing, data, and event anomalies across CustomersDot, Salesforce, and Zuora before they can affect revenue or the customer experience.</p> <p>This is a greenfield team. metrics, logs, and traces, using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="2">Implement automated detection for billing, data, and event anomalies, and route alerts to the responsible feature teams.</li> <li value="3">Develop reconciliation and data integrity checks across usage and billing pipelines.</li> <li value="4">Define and track service level objectives and service level it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Ruby on Rails, including building and operating applications such as CustomersDot.</li> <li value="2">Experience in site reliability or observability engineering, including monitoring, alerting, service level objectives and indicators, runbooks, and incident response.</li> <li monitoring, or risk management tooling.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.</li> <li value="6">Exposure to analytical data stores such as ClickHouse and the change data capture and event-streaming pipelines that feed them, including NATS JetStream.</li> <li value="7">Experience owning projects from concept through production, utilization workflows. description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin, Ireland | 💰€68,000 - €85,000, Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ benefits</p> <p><strong>⭐Our Regulatory Affairs team</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a pragmatic, organised and personable individual to strengthen our Regulatory Affairs team.</p> <p>The Regulatory Affairs team is the central team responsible for maintaining open and collaborative relationships with our regulators across the Monzo Group. In the Regulatory Affairs team, you’ll support and strengthen Monzo’s regulatory relationships and work closely with Executives to help shape our vision and regulatory affairs strategy as Monzo continues to grow. You’ll also work closely with our contacts at the Irish and European Regulators and support the wider Regulatory Affairs team with engagement with other relevant Regulators (PRA and FCA), responding to information requests, preparing for meetings and submitting regulatory submissions. </p> <p>We are on a mission to <em>Make Money Work for Everyone</em> and we’ve grown to over 15 million customers globally. For Regulatory Affairs this means ensuring our regulators are kept informed, managing regulatory requests and educating colleagues on the regulatory landscape. </p> <p>We operate a “three lines of defence” model of risk management at Monzo. You’ll be sitting in the second line as part of our Risk and Compliance team, working in the Regulatory Affairs Team.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Preparing for and facilitating regulator meetings, reviews and requests. Preparation includes working closely with Executives and stakeholders throughout the business to prepare and advise them on how best to meet regulatory expectations.</li> <li>Keeping our regulators up to date with proactive notifications on products and strategic initiatives, as well as leading on regulatory communications during an incident.</li> <li>Owning the governance and tracking of regulatory deliverables, deadlines and activities ensuring stakeholders are held accountable.</li> <li>Taking responsibility for the preparation, submission and management of technically complex regulatory submissions.</li> <li>Working with subject matter experts in Risk and Compliance and across the business to coordinate and prepare for regulatory visits.</li> <li>Preparing data driven reports for the Executives that are clear, concise and informative.</li> <li>Building and enhancing our policies and procedures for engaging with regulators.</li> <li>Being a champion of risk and compliance and building respectful and collaborative relationships with all levels of stakeholders across the business.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have proven experience in a regulatory affairs role at an Irish/European regulated financial services firm or at an Irish or European financial services regulator </li> <li>You have knowledge of CBI and/or ECB regulatory and supervisory obligations</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of managing relations with important external stakeholders</li> <li>You have excellent written and verbal communication</li> <li>You have an ability to lead and manage multiple projects to short deadlines</li> <li>You are a critical thinker and not afraid to challenge </li> <li>You are self-motivated, highly organised and focused on executing well</li> <li>You enjoy collaborating as a team and is able to work independently with changing priorities</li> <li>You have a genuine interest in the regulated financial services environment and how it is changing</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰A salary range of €68,000 - €85,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏥Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short video call with a member of the hiring team</li> <li>A take home task (practical written exercise)</li> <li>Follow up video call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>Final stage 2-part Role Specific and Behavioural interviews with members from the wider Risk and Compliance collective</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>#LI-ÉS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.</p></div>

We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy </li> <li>Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys</li> <li>Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions</li> <li>Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level</li> <li>Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models</li> <li>Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models</li> <li>You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in Munich. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. - Fluency in German. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €234,000 - €246,000 per year. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Storytelling and narrative lead
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are looking for an outstanding <strong>storytelling and narrative development lead</strong> to lead our content marketing team. Canonical has a robust portfolio of open source products and offers support for a wide range of open source technologies. This role is for someone who cares deeply about narrative quality and wants to elevate our brand positioning. It requires process discipline and creative smarts, leadership skills and performance-driven strategy to ensure our content aligns with our business objectives. </p> <p>The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, technology marketing and the use of technology in marketing. They would love to gain experience optimizing content processes, coaching others on their narrative skills and building brand authority. They enjoy learning and improving themselves, the team and the organization. They problem solve, get hands-on, experiment, measure and use automation to make daily life easier. To succeed in this role, the candidate must be metrics-driven, highly organized and skilled at team development, capacity planning and cross-functional collaboration.  </p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Communications. </p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home based in the EMEA region. </p> <h2>What your day will look like</h2> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a content strategy that aligns with our business goals, SEO and brand. </li> <li>Manage our content calendar end to end, ensuring content is efficiently produced with minimum friction and process clarity.</li> <li>Ensure content quality, consistency and brand alignment in everything we produce. </li> <li>Collaborate with our web and growth engineering teams to optimize content for search and AI engines, building on proven SEO or GEO expertise. </li> <li>Supervise quarterly content planning sessions and work closely with content specialists, product management and marketing to optimize content plans.</li> <li>Monitor and report on KPIs for our content program and use analytics tools to identify improvement opportunities. </li> <li>Align messaging to ensure integrated campaign support across channels, working closely with our marketing, product and brand teams.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of work experience in content or related roles, preferably at technology companies, with 2+ years of experience as a manager or team lead. </li> <li>Proven experience creating authoritative and engaging content. Portfolio of written work required.</li> <li>Applied knowledge of GEO and SEO, experience with relevant tools and SEO-driven content calendars. </li> <li>Excellent project management and interpersonal skills with the ability to create highly efficient processes for content production and reuse. </li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications or a relevant discipline. </li> <li>Someone who is passionate about technology and open source. </li> <li>A problem solver: you don’t shy away from taking on challenges and see projects through to completion. </li> <li>Attention to detail and appreciation for standards: you value quality and accuracy but can adapt quickly when the need arises.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  <br>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.</p> <p>🏠Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</p> <p>📚Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum</p> <p>💰Annual compensation review</p> <p>🏆Recognition rewards</p> <p>🏝 Annual holiday leave</p> <p>👶Parental Leave</p> <p>🧑‍💼Employee Assistance Programme</p> <p>🧳Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</p> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.</span><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</span></a></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-remote</span></p> <p> </p>

title: Customer Success  - Team Manager
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. </p> <p><strong>We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.</strong></p> <p>To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to support and drive our Customer Success teams regionally. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success management and an obvious passion for new technologies. </p> <p>You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you will provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You will play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. Comfortable dealing with ambiguity you will be equip to quickly adapt to change. Collaboration with other teams is also vital to this role to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility will be to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work in close collaboration with the Global Head of Customer Success to drive results.</p> <p>We engage with a diverse customer base and follow a diverse set of motions to provide the appropriate and required level of focus for every customer. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the ability to pivot right across this customer base regardless of culture, location or focus.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This opportunity is available in the APAC region and is remote.</p> <p><strong>The role entails:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic planning and analysis:</strong> preparing communication plans, team meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You will develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive up-sells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.</li> <li><strong>Customer interactions and support to your team:</strong> resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention ensuring timely resolution.</li> <li><strong>Team management:</strong> passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. Conducting regular performance reviews with team members you will also help identifying areas for improvement/development as well as celebrating excellence, recognising team achievements, and setting goals for individual growth. </li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration: </strong>collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You will establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.</li> <li><strong>Documentation and reporting: </strong>you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you will also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent academic results at school and university</li> <li>Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM subject</li> <li>Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries</li> <li>Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results</li> <li>Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific</li> <li>Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration</li> <li>Experience growing and developing a CSM team</li> <li>Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Whilst English is our business language, proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French will be valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Recruiting Coordinator, Tokyo

description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across many sectors.</p> <p>Canonical is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1,200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an<strong> Engineering Manager for Distributed Systems Testing </strong>to lead a team responsible for the quality engineering platform that enables deployment and validation of distributed systems across Canonical's cloud portfolio.</p> <p>We see quality engineering as a first-class engineering practice. Our Distributed Systems Testing team ensures the performance, correctness, resilience and interoperability of Canonical cloud solutions built with technologies such as Juju, Terraform, OpenStack and Kubernetes. These systems are deployed and tested across diverse environments, from bare-metal to the public cloud.</p> <p>As Engineering Manager, you will combine strong software engineering judgement with people leadership. You will develop engineering talent, establish effective engineering practices, shape technical direction with senior engineers, and ensure the team delivers high-quality testing infrastructure and automation that enables engineering teams across Canonical to ship software with confidence.</p> <p>We believe engineering managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. You should be comfortable reviewing patches, evaluating software design, debugging a distributed system, or discussing test architecture. You will contribute technically where appropriate to set a high standard, while recognizing that your greatest impact comes from shaping the direction, focus, effectiveness, and growth of the whole team.</p> <p>You will work closely with senior engineers and engineering leaders across Canonical to define priorities, improve testing capabilities, and advance how we validate increasingly complex cloud-native and distributed systems.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This is a globally remote role, typically leading a team concentrated within a major time zone such as EMEA or the Americas.</p> software testing processes, strategies, and automation</li> <li>Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) </li> <li>Strong technical judgement and the ability to engage meaningfully in code reviews, architecture discussions, and software design</li> <li>Experience working in an agile development environment with the ability to organize a team to deliver high-quality results</li> engineering workflows</li> <li>Deploying, operating, or debugging distributed systems</li> <li>Leading globally distributed teams</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h2> <p>We We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. You must be able to work independently, take a hands-on approach, and interface effectively with professionals at all levels. initiatives such as diversity and inclusion.</li> <li>Create, update and maintain corporate policies that have a global lens with local application.</li> <li>Ensure consistency of application of our HR policies and procedures.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> title: Talent Acquisition Strategist
description: <p>Canonical has re-imagined hiring. efficiencies. </li> <li>Advanced analytical ability to dissect and analyse data, using either SQL, Python and/or statistical analysis.</li> <li>Exceptional written and spoken English with strong presentation skills for a senior audience.</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally 2-4 times a year for company events.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Advanced psychometric title: Director, Talent Analytics
description: <p>Our Talent Science team ensures that we follow an objective, scientifically rigorous and efficient process to select the very best new colleagues regardless of location, culture or background. With a data centric approach, we examine hiring data to create talent analytics and business intelligence to fuel our decision making on hiring. Alternatively use Python, R, SPSS, or, possess the ability to run lookups, indexing, matching formulae with an appetite to learn SQL.</li> <li>Exposure to BI tools (Superset is our platform).</li> <li>Exemplary ability to lead and drive others to deliver, including exceptional project management and coaching to lead roadmap execution and delivery.</li> <li>Exceptional written and spoken English with strong presentation skills for a senior audience.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Advanced psychometric skills.</li> <li>A deep understanding of human behaviour, in particular intrinsic motivation.</li> <li>Experience of using Superset and/or Greenhouse</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. <strong>Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives</strong> such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our goal is to deliver the world's best long term OS stability commitment on PC, server and IoT hardware.</p> <p>We believe that Engineering Directors should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should be very comfortable reviewing a patch or a software design spec. We grow management skills, and train engineers who are interested in soft skills to be managers. Even though this is a director level position, managing managers, we expect Engineering Directors to be outstanding system software engineers with the confidence to lead by example across the full range of activities in their teams. You’ll need to know how to drive testing and benchmarking to improve the clarity in your teams around quality and performance. You’ll also need to be confident to set and defend high expectations of work ethic, consistency, focus and learning.</p> <p>In this Engineering Director role, you will lead the strategy and the team responsible for quality coordination and integration testing of our software stacks with hardware. We are looking for a quality expert with the ability to establish quality processes from the ground up. The candidate must understand today's PC and ARM IoT hardware, and be excited about the new generation of RISC-V hardware that is on the horizon. They should understand the board and device product lifecycle and know the tools and techniques used to introduce new products. They will work with teams across the company to drive quality improvements through the entire development cycle. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill combined with management experience.</p> <p>Today, most Linux certification is poor quality. Vendors run one set of tests and then declare that 'the hardware is certified'. But Linux is not a static platform. We make many more security fixes in the Linux world than people traditionally made in the proprietary OS world - all of these need to be tested on hardware which has been certified, even if that certification is 'old'. Also, Linux and open source evolve significantly every six months, and even more between major enterprise releases like the Ubuntu LTS versions. During the lifespan of an LTS, new kernel improvements will be available to users, and they want to be sure that their hardware will work. Today's Linux certification programs do not meet the needs of its users, and we want to change that.</p> <p>Our intention is to deliver <strong>continuous quality and certification</strong> across the entire portfolio of certified hardware. Once we have enabled and certified a device, we intend to keep testing it to ensure that every single change we deliver to Ubuntu users globally is verified on all the hardware we know about. We also intend to <strong>measure energy consumption</strong> on a continuous process, as part of our commitment to <strong>measure, manage and drive down the carbon footprint of Ubuntu</strong> usage around the planet. We are building the world's largest and best-equipped Linux device certification facility in Taipei, which will enable this continuous testing. We are also structuring our renewed partnership and customer agreements to facilitate this process going forward.</p> <p>We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. certification lab.</p> <h3>Key responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Manage, mentor and grow the software engineering teams addressing hardware enablement quality assurance and testing</li> <li>Lead the OEM Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an <strong>Engineering Manager for IAM (Identity and Access Management)</strong> to <span style="font-weight: 400;">build high-performing Go and Python services and secure identity and access management solutions that will be used across all company products. From</span><a href="https://login.ubuntu.com/"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ubuntu One SSO</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to</span><a href="https://juju.is/"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Juju</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">,</span><a href="https://linuxcontainers.org/"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">LXD</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">and</span><a href="https://maas.io/"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">MAAS</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> your team will define the way Canonical users, clients and community members access their favorite open source applications.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This is an opportunity for a software engineering manager with a passion for distributed systems operations to help us transform the future of identity management at Canonical. Experience in the identity and access management (IAM) field is desirable but not required. You will work with upstream open source projects, alongside internal teams to deliver high quality software that can be deployed on bare metal, public cloud and Kubernetes.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As the identity team engineering manager you will bring significant software development experience, Kubernetes knowledge and a keen eye for software design, performance and security. You will be responsible for working with product management to define the technical vision for the products, managing the team backlog, reviewing code and coaching younger team members.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You will also be involved in all the aspects of the software development process: you will design software, write high-quality code and tests, provide insightful code reviews, write documentation and help to troubleshoot issues.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">In addition to the engineering behind the project itself, you'll have the chance to work with industry-leading teams inside Canonical, ensuring your work is backed by rock-solid data stores, and highly observable using our Kubernetes-based Observability stack. You'll work with broader open source communities, participating in "hackfest" events, webinars and conferences.</span></p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or AMER regions.</em></p> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Proven experience hiring and leading a high performance software engineering team</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with Go and Python software development</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ability to design and implement complex, distributed system</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience working with container technology and Kubernetes</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strong understanding of software/infrastructure security and performance</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience designing and/or operating large scale distributed systems </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Knowledge of identity and access management technologies and standards is desirable but not essential</span></li> </ul> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.</p> <p>We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities.</p> <p>Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. We discuss strategy, plan product development, drive engagement, and promote the open source way. We oversee the entire product lifecycle from conception to delivery, blending technical expertise, strategic thinking, analytics, project management skills and effective communication to ensure products meet both user needs and business objectives.</p> <p>We have open product manager roles across a wide range of product domains, including:</p> <ul> <li>Ubuntu Platform - Our Ubuntu experience on Desktop, Server, Windows (WSL), Multipass, Gaming, Enterprise, & Hardware Enablement</li> <li>Ubuntu Pro Services - Our key commercial offerings Ubuntu Pro, Compliance, Standards, Security Engineering, and Managed Services on cloud and on prem</li> <li>AI/ML & MLOps - Open source AI/ML solutions, AIOps automation, model lifecycle management, Kubeflow, MLFlow, KServe, and AI infrastructure on cloud and edge</li> <li>IoT - Ubuntu on embedded devices and/or edge servers, device management, and robotics</li> <li>Cloud - Ubuntu in public and private clouds, promoting automation frameworks, and including technologies such as Kubernetes, MAAS, and LXD</li> <li>Telco - Open source for Telco's including technologies and standards related to Core Network, RAN/vRAN, SoNIC, DENT, and SmartNICs</li> <li>Finance - Open source solutions for financial institutions including trading platforms, blockchain technologies, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven analytics</li> <li>Automotive - Open source solutions for autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, connected vehicles, and compliance with automotive industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO 21434</li> <li>Application Management - Open source solutions in the enterprise including Observability, IAM, App Stores and technologies such Grafana, GitOps, and Juju Charms</li> </ul> <p>If your domain of expertise isn’t listed above, yet you feel it’s relevant to Canonical, then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> These roles are home based in the EMEA time zone. You will be expected to be located in this region.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Lead the product development lifecycle, reviewing the priorities and goals for your product</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as engineering, design, marketing, and sales</li> <li>Address common challenges across projects, align on priorities, enable informed decisions, and keep business execution on track</li> <li>Conduct market research, analyse industry trends, and gather customer feedback to identify opportunities</li> <li>Communicate your product vision, status updates, and key decisions to ensure alignment and manage expectations</li> <li>Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and iterate on the product to improve the user experience</li> <li>Collaborate with marketing, sales, and support teams to develop go-to-market strategies, create product documentation, and provide training</li> <li>Contribute to the success of our sales team in winning new opportunities, reviewing customer feedback and participating in customer meetings</li> <li>Oversee the work of a product line, ensuring consistency in strategy and execution across different teams</li> <li>Facilitate collaboration and resolve conflicts within different teams and across other departments</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic results at high school and university</li> <li>Understanding of Linux and the wider open source software community</li> <li>Understanding of computer architecture, application development, datacenters, cloud or devices</li> <li>Passion to write about technologies and the tech landscape</li> <li>A strong work ethic, and personal interests aligned with the open source movement</li> <li>Curiosity, and the habit of continuous learning</li> <li>A strong sense of ownership</li> <li>Problem solving and the ability to innovate</li> <li>Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written</li> <li>For more senior positions, product management experience in the software industry</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple projects or product lines while maintaining focus on key priorities</li> <li>Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse teams and driving consensus around product strategies</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Additional skills that we value</h3> <ul> <li>Familiarity with a particular verticals (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive)</li> <li>Familiarity with the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channel</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud native technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker containers & Snaps</li> <li>Familiarity with embedded and connected device technology and ecosystems</li> <li>Familiarity with networking technologies - ethernet, IPv4 and IPv6, routing, firewalling, overlays such as OVN/OVS, VPNs, SR-IOV, infiniband</li> <li>Familiarity with telco networking - RAN, Core, CPE</li> <li>Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to foster collaboration and innovation in team settings</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping title: Python Software Engineer - Ubuntu Hardware Certification Team
description: <p>Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. Canonical offers a fun, fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities. This team is centered in EMEA time zones, and works with colleagues on related teams in both the Americas and APAC.</p> <p>We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices.</p> <h3>Role description</h3> <p>We are looking for a self-motivated software engineer with experience developing in Python, to work on test automation tools or Linux based embedded hardware. This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage.</p> <p>The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical’s open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes.
